TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n    }\n\n    /** 对表达式求值，得到通用值。 */\n    public Value eval(Expr e, Value[] row) {\n        if (e instanceof LiteralExpr) {\n            return evalLiteral((LiteralExpr) e);\n        }\n        if (e instanceof ColumnExpr) {\n            return evalColumn((ColumnExpr) e, row);\n        }\n        if (e instanceof UnaryMinusExpr) {\n            UnaryMinusExpr u = (UnaryMinusExpr) e;\n            Value v = eval(u.operand, row);\n            if (v.isNull()) {\n                return Value.NULL;\n            }\n            return Value.ofInteger(negateExact(v.integer()));\n        }\n        if (e instanceof NotExpr) {\n            NotExpr n = (NotExpr) e;\n            TriBool tb = evalFilter(n.operand, row);\n            return Value.ofBoolean(tb.not() == TriBool.TRUE);\n            // 注意：NOT UNKNOWN = UNKNOWN，需要保留三值\n        }\n        if (e instanceof IsNullExpr) {\n            IsNullExpr i = (IsNullExpr) e;\n            Value v = eval(i.operand, row);\n            boolean isNull = v.isNull();\n            return Value.ofBoolean(i.negated ? !isNull : isNull);\n        }\n        if (e instanceof BinaryExpr) {\n            return evalBinary((BinaryExpr) e, row);\n        }\n        throw new IllegalStateException(\"未知表达式节点：\" + e.getClass());\n    }\n\n    // NOT 必须返回三值，上面用 Boolean 无法表达 UNKNOWN，\n    // 因此单独提供一个返回 TriBool 的逻辑表达式求值入口。\n    private Value notResult(NotExpr n, Value[] row) {\n        TriBool tb = evalLogicOperand(n.operand, row);\n        TriBool r = tb.not();\n        return triboolToValue(r);\n    }\n\n    /** 求一个“逻辑类”表达式（AND/OR/NOT/比较/IS NULL/布尔列）的三值。 */\n    private TriBool evalLogicOperand(Expr e, Value[] row) {\n        if (e instanceof NotExpr) {\n            return triFromValue(notResult((NotExpr) e, row));\n        }\n        if (e instanceof BinaryExpr) {\n            BinaryExpr b = (BinaryExpr) e;\n            if (b.isLogic()) {\n                return triFromValue(evalBinary(b, row));\n            }\n        }\n        Value v = eval(e, row);\n        if (v.isNull()) {\n            return TriBool.UNKNOWN;\n        }\n        return v.bool() ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n    }\n\n    private TriBool triFromValue(Value v) {\n        if (v.isNull()) {\n            return TriBool.UNKNOWN;\n        }\n        return v.bool() ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n    }\n\n    private Value triboolToValue(TriBool t) {\n        if (t == TriBool.UNKNOWN) {\n            return Value.NULL;\n        }\n        return Value.ofBoolean(t == TriBool.TRUE);\n    }\n\n    private Value evalLiteral(LiteralExpr e) {\n        switch (e.kind) {\n            case INTEGER: return Value.ofInteger((Long) e.value);\n            case STRING:  return Value.ofString((String) e.value);\n            case BOOLEAN: return Value.ofBoolean((Boolean) e.value);\n            case NULL:    return Value.NULL;\n            default: throw new IllegalStateException();\n        }\n    }\n\n    private Value evalColumn(ColumnExpr e, Value[] row) {\n        for (int i = 0; i < columns.length; i++) {\n            if (columns[i].equals(e.name)) {\n                return row[indexes[i]];\n            }\n        }\n        // 类型检查阶段已保证列存在\n        throw new EvalException(\"UNKNOWN_COLUMN\", \"未知列：\" + e.name);\n    }\n\n    private Value evalBinary(BinaryExpr e, Value[] row) {\n        // ---- 逻辑运算：三值 + 短路 ----\n        if (e.op.name().equals(\"AND\")) {\n            TriBool l = evalLogicOperand(e.left, row);\n            if (l == TriBool.FALSE) {\n                return Value.ofBoolean(false); // 短路：不求右值\n            }\n            TriBool r = evalLogicOperand(e.right, row);\n            return triboolToValue(l.and(r));\n        }\n        if (e.op.name().equals(\"OR\")) {\n            TriBool l = evalLogicOperand(e.left, row);\n            if (l == TriBool.TRUE) {\n                return Value.ofBoolean(true); // 短路：不求右值\n            }\n            TriBool r = evalLogicOperand(e.right, row);\n            return triboolToValue(l.or(r));\n        }\n\n        // ---- 算术：严格求值（NULL 传播） ----\n        if (e.isArithmetic()) {\n            Value l = eval(e.left, row);\n            Value r = eval(e.right, row);\n            if (l.isNull() || r.isNull()) {\n                return Value.NULL;\n            }\n            return Value.ofInteger(arith(e, l.integer(), r.integer()));\n        }\n\n        // ---- 比较：任一为 NULL -> UNKNOWN ----\n        Value l = eval(e.left, row);\n        Value r = eval(e.right, row);\n        if (l.isNull() || r.isNull()) {\n            return Value.NULL;\n        }\n        return Value.ofBoolean(compare(e, l, r));\n    }\n\n    private long arith(BinaryExpr e, long a, long b) {\n        switch (e.op) {\n            case PLUS:  return addExact(a, b);\n            case MINUS: return subExact(a, b);\n            case STAR:  return mulExact(a, b);\n            case SLASH:\n                if (b == 0L) {\n                    throw new EvalException(\"DIVISION_BY_ZERO\",\n                            \"整数除以零（被除数 \" + a + \"）\");\n                }\n                // SQL 风格整除：向零截断；Java 的 / 对 long 正是向零截断。\n                // MIN_VALUE / -1 在 Java 中会得到 MIN_VALUE 自身（溢出），\n                // 这里显式报溢出错误。\n                if (a == Long.MIN_VALUE && b == -1L) {\n                    throw new EvalException(\"INTEGER_OVERFLOW\",\n                            \"整数除法溢出：\" + a + \" / \" + b\n                                    + \" 超出 64 位有符号整数范围\");\n                }\n                return a / b;\n            default:\n                throw new IllegalStateException();\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 通用比较入口，按两侧类型分派（此时均非 NULL）。 */\n    private boolean compare(BinaryExpr e, Value l, Value r) {\n        int cmp;\n        if (l.type() == DataType.STRING && r.type() == DataType.STRING) {\n            cmp = l.string().compareTo(r.string());\n        } else {\n            long a = l.integer();\n            long b = r.integer();\n            cmp = Long.compare(a, b);\n        }\n        switch (e.op) {\n            case EQ: return cmp == 0;\n            case NE: return cmp != 0;\n            case LT: return cmp < 0;\n            case LE: return cmp <= 0;\n            case GT: return cmp > 0;\n            case GE: return cmp >= 0;\n            default: throw new IllegalStateException();\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 显式溢出检测（不依赖 Math，便于给出明确错误码） ----------\n\n    private static long addExact(long a, long b) {\n        long r = a + b;\n        if (((a ^ r) & (b ^ r)) < 0) {\n            throw overflow(a, b, \"+\");\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private static long subExact(long a, long b) {\n        long r = a - b;\n        if (((a ^ b) & (a ^ r)) < 0) {\n            throw overflow(a, b, \"-\");\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private static long mulExact(long a, long b) {\n        long r = a * b;\n        long ax = Math.abs(a);\n        long bx = Math.abs(b);\n        if ((ax | bx) >>> 31 != 0) {\n            if (b != 0 && r / b != a) {\n                throw overflow(a, b, \"*\");\n            }\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private static long negateExact(long a) {\n        if (a == Long.MIN_VALUE) {\n            throw new EvalException(\"INTEGER_OVERFLOW\",\n                    \"一元负号导致整数溢出：-\" + a + \" 超出 64 位有符号整数范围\");\n        }\n        return -a;\n    }\n\n    private static EvalException overflow(long a, long b, String op) {\n        return new EvalException(\"INTEGER_OVERFLOW\",\n                \"整数运算溢出：\" + a + \" \" + op + \" \" + b\n                        + \" 的结果超出 64 位有符号整数范围（\"\n                        + Long.MIN_VALUE + \" ~ \" + Long.MAX_VALUE + \"）\");\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_7bfc3fe3edcf11674f82ba2a","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2444,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":47928,"output_tokens":2827,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_pq0xxc6940780lrf6l28xq4e":{"content":"package {"parentUuid":"24b7ee89-5f2e-401e-a4f5-9d4810de66e2","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_lhtp56ur1rdgjrr55ae60ct5","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp11/a/src/main/java/tvl/eval/Evaluator.java","content":"package tvl.eval;\n\nimport java.util.List;\n\nimport tvl.core.DataType;\nimport tvl.core.EvalException;\nimport tvl.core.TriBool;\nimport tvl.core.Value;\nimport tvl.parser.BinaryExpr;\nimport tvl.parser.ColumnExpr;\nimport tvl.parser.Expr;\nimport tvl.parser.IsNullExpr;\nimport tvl.parser.LiteralExpr;\nimport tvl.parser.NotExpr;\nimport tvl.parser.UnaryMinusExpr;\n\n/**\n * 表达式求值器：对一行数据求一个已通过类型检查的 AST。\n *\n * 两条求值路径：\n *  - {@link #eval} 求“值”，返回 {@link Value}（可以是任意类型，含 NULL）。\n *  - {@link #evalLogic} 求“逻辑条件”，返回 {@link TriBool}。\n *    布尔值 NULL 在逻辑语境下解释为 UNKNOWN（SQL 3VL）。\n *\n * AND/OR 使用 Kleene 三值逻辑并真正短路：未选择的分支中的\n * 除零、溢出都不会发生（短路测试的核心保证）。\n */\npublic final class Evaluator {\n\n    private final String[] columns;\n\n    public Evaluator(List<String> columns) {\n        this(columns.toArray(new String[0]));\n    }\n\n    public Evaluator(String[] columns) {\n        this.columns = columns.clone();\n    }\n\n    /** WHERE 过滤：只选中结果为 TRUE 的行（FALSE、UNKNOWN 均不选中）。 */\n    public boolean selected(Expr e, Value[] row) {\n        return evalLogic(e, row) == TriBool.TRUE;\n    }\n\n    /** 把逻辑表达式求值为三值。 */\n    public TriBool evalLogic(Expr e, Value[] row) {\n        if (e instanceof NotExpr) {\n            NotExpr n = (NotExpr) e;\n            return evalLogic(n.operand, row).not();\n        }\n        if (e instanceof BinaryExpr) {\n            BinaryExpr b = (BinaryExpr) e;\n            if (b.op.name().equals(\"AND\")) {\n                TriBool l = evalLogic(b.left, row);\n                if (l == TriBool.FALSE) {\n                    return TriBool.FALSE; // 短路：右分支不求值\n                }\n                return l.and(evalLogic(b.right, row));\n            }\n            if (b.op.name().equals(\"OR\")) {\n                TriBool l = evalLogic(b.left, row);\n                if (l == TriBool.TRUE) {\n                    return TriBool.TRUE; // 短路：右分支不求值\n                }\n                return l.or(evalLogic(b.right, row));\n            }\n        }\n        if (e instanceof IsNullExpr) {\n            IsNullExpr i = (IsNullExpr) e;\n            boolean isNull = eval(i.operand, row).isNull();\n            TriBool tb = isNull ?  throw overflow(a, b, \"*\");","         }","         return r;","     }"]}],"originalFile":"package tvl.eval;\n\nimport java.util.List;\n\nimport tvl.core.DataType;\nimport tvl.core.EvalException;\nimport tvl.core.TriBool;\nimport tvl.core.Value;\nimport tvl.parser.BinaryExpr;\nimport tvl.parser.ColumnExpr;\nimport tvl.parser.Expr;\nimport tvl.parser.IsNullExpr;\nimport tvl.parser.LiteralExpr;\nimport tvl.parser.NotExpr;\nimport tvl.parser.UnaryMinusExpr;\n\n/**\n * 表达式求值器：对一行数据求一个已类型检查的 AST。\n *\n * 关键点：\n *  - 结果统一为 {@link Value}；布尔结果只可能取 TRUE/FALSE，\n *    但“是否选中本行”由 {@link #evalFilter} 按 3VL 判定\n *    （仅 TRUE 选中，FALSE 与 UNKNOWN 均不选中）。\n *  - AND/OR 使用 Kleene 三值逻辑并真正短路：未被选择的分支\n *    中的除零、溢出都不会发生。\n *  - 整数运算使用 long 并显式检测溢出；除零（含 0 整除）抛错。\n */\npublic final class Evaluator {\n\n    /** 列名在行中的下标映射。 */\n    private final int[] indexes;\n    private final String[] columns;\n\n    public Evaluator(String[] columns) {\n        this.columns = columns.clone();\n        this.indexes = new int[this.columns.length];\n        for (int i = 0; i < this.columns.length; i++) {\n            this.indexes[i] = i;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public Evaluator(List<String> columns) {\n        this(columns.toArray(new String[0]));\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 把表达式作为 WHERE 条件求值：返回三值。\n     * NULL 结果按 SQL 语义映射为 UNKNOWN。\n     */\n    public TriBool evalFilter(Expr e, Value[] row) {\n        Value v = eval(e, row);\n        if (v.isNull()) {\n            return TriBool.UNKNOWN;\n        }\n        return v.bool() ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n    }\n\n    /** 对表达式求值，得到通用值。 */\n    public Value eval(Expr e, Value[] row) {\n        if (e instanceof LiteralExpr) {\n            return evalLiteral((LiteralExpr) e);\n        }\n        if (e instanceof ColumnExpr) {\n            return evalColumn((ColumnExpr) e, row);\n        }\n        if (e instanceof UnaryMinusExpr) {\n            UnaryMinusExpr u = (UnaryMinusExpr) e;\n            Value v = eval(u.operand, row);\n            if (v.isNull()) {\n                return Value.NULL;\n            }\n            return Value.ofInteger(negateExact(v.integer()));\n        }\n        if (e instanceof NotExpr) {\n            NotExpr n = (NotExpr) e;\n            TriBool tb = evalFilter(n.operand, row);\n            return Value.ofBoolean(tb.not() == TriBool.TRUE);\n            // 注意：NOT UNKNOWN = UNKNOWN，需要保留三值\n        }\n        if (e instanceof IsNullExpr) {\n            IsNullExpr i = (IsNullExpr) e;\n            Value v = eval(i.operand, row);\n            boolean isNull = v.isNull();\n            return Value.ofBoolean(i.negated ? !isNull : isNull);\n        }\n        if (e instanceof BinaryExpr) {\n            return evalBinary((BinaryExpr) e, row);\n        }\n        throw new IllegalStateException(\"未知表达式节点：\" + e.getClass());\n    }\n\n    // NOT 必须返回三值，上面用 Boolean 无法表达 UNKNOWN，\n    // 因此单独提供一个返回 TriBool 的逻辑表达式求值入口。\n    private Value notResult(NotExpr n, Value[] row) {\n        TriBool tb = evalLogicOperand(n.operand, row);\n        TriBool r = tb.not();\n        return triboolToValue(r);\n    }\n\n    /** 求一个“逻辑类”表达式（AND/OR/NOT/比较/IS NULL/布尔列）的三值。 */\n    private TriBool evalLogicOperand(Expr e, Value[] row) {\n        if (e instanceof NotExpr) {\n            return triFromValue(notResult((NotExpr) e, row));\n        }\n        if (e instanceof BinaryExpr) {\n            BinaryExpr b = (BinaryExpr) e;\n            if (b.isLogic()) {\n                return triFromValue(evalBinary(b, row));\n            }\n        }\n        Value v = eval(e, row);\n        if (v.isNull()) {\n            return TriBool.UNKNOWN;\n        }\n        return v.bool() ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n    }\n\n    private TriBool triFromValue(Value v) {\n        if (v.isNull()) {\n            return TriBool.UNKNOWN;\n        }\n        return v.bool() ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n    }\n\n    private Value triboolToValue(TriBool t) {\n        if (t == TriBool.UNKNOWN) {\n            return Value.NULL;\n        }\n        return Value.ofBoolean(t == TriBool.TRUE);\n    }\n\n    private Value evalLiteral(LiteralExpr e) {\n        switch (e.kind) {\n            case INTEGER: return Value.ofInteger((Long) e.value);\n            case STRING:  return Value.ofString((String) e.value);\n            case BOOLEAN: return Value.ofBoolean((Boolean) e.value);\n            case NULL:    return Value.NULL;\n            default: throw new IllegalStateException();\n        }\n    }\n\n    private Value evalColumn(ColumnExpr e, Value[] row) {\n        for (int i = 0; i < columns.length; i++) {\n            if (columns[i].equals(e.name)) {\n                return row[indexes[i]];\n            }\n        }\n        // 类型检查阶段已保证列存在\n        throw new EvalException(\"UNKNOWN_COLUMN\", \"未知列：\" + e.name);\n    }\n\n    private Value evalBinary(BinaryExpr e, Value[] row) {\n        // ---- 逻辑运算：三值 + 短路 ----\n        if (e.op.name().equals(\"AND\")) {\n            TriBool l = evalLogicOperand(e.left, row);\n            if (l == TriBool.FALSE) {\n                return Value.ofBoolean(false); // 短路：不求右值\n            }\n            TriBool r = evalLogicOperand(e.right, row);\n            return triboolToValue(l.and(r));\n        }\n        if (e.op.name().equals(\"OR\")) {\n            TriBool l = evalLogicOperand(e.left, row);\n            if (l == TriBool.TRUE) {\n                return Value.ofBoolean(true); // 短路：不求右值\n            }\n            TriBool r = evalLogicOperand(e.right, row);\n            return triboolToValue(l.or(r));\n        }\n\n        // ---- 算术：严格求值（NULL 传播） ----\n        if (e.isArithmetic()) {\n            Value l = eval(e.left, row);\n            Value r = eval(e.right, row);\n            if (l.isNull() || r.isNull()) {\n                return Value.NULL;\n            }\n            return Value.ofInteger(arith(e, l.integer(), r.integer()));\n        }\n\n        // ---- 比较：任一为 NULL -> UNKNOWN ----\n        Value l = eval(e.left, row);\n        Value r = eval(e.right, row);\n        if (l.isNull() || r.isNull()) {\n            return Value.NULL;\n        }\n        return Value.ofBoolean(compare(e, l, r));\n    }\n\n    private long arith(BinaryExpr e, long a, long b) {\n        switch (e.op) {\n            case PLUS:  return addExact(a, b);\n            case MINUS: return subExact(a, b);\n            case STAR:  return mulExact(a, b);\n            case SLASH:\n                if (b == 0L) {\n                    throw new EvalException(\"DIVISION_BY_ZERO\",\n                            \"整数除以零（被除数 \" + a + \"）\");\n                }\n                // SQL 风格整除：向零截断；Java 的 / 对 long 正是向零截断。\n                // MIN_VALUE / -1 在 Java 中会得到 MIN_VALUE 自身（溢出），\n                // 这里显式报溢出错误。\n                if (a == Long.MIN_VALUE && b == -1L) {\n                    throw new EvalException(\"INTEGER_OVERFLOW\",\n                            \"整数除法溢出：\" + a + \" / \" + b\n                                    + \" 超出 64 位有符号整数范围\");\n                }\n                return a / b;\n            default:\n                throw new IllegalStateException();\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 通用比较入口，按两侧类型分派（此时均非 NULL）。 */\n    private boolean compare(BinaryExpr e, Value l, Value r) {\n        int cmp;\n        if (l.type() == DataType.STRING && r.type() == DataType.STRING) {\n            cmp = l.string().compareTo(r.string());\n        } else {\n            long a = l.integer();\n            long b = r.integer();\n            cmp = Long.compare(a, b);\n        }\n        switch (e.op) {\n            case EQ: return cmp == 0;\n            case NE: return cmp != 0;\n            case LT: return cmp < 0;\n            case LE: return cmp <= 0;\n            case GT: return cmp > 0;\n            case GE: return cmp >= 0;\n            default: throw new IllegalStateException();\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 显式溢出检测（不依赖 Math，便于给出明确错误码） ----------\n\n    private static long addExact(long a, long b) {\n        long r = a + b;\n        if (((a ^ r) & (b ^ r)) < 0) {\n            throw overflow(a, b, \"+\");\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private static long subExact(long a, long b) {\n        long r = a - b;\n        if (((a ^ b) & (a ^ r)) < 0) {\n            throw overflow(a, b, \"-\");\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private static long mulExact(long a, long b) {\n        long r = a * b;\n        long ax = Math.abs(a);\n        long bx = Math.abs(b);\n        if ((ax | bx) >>> 31 != 0) {\n            if (b != 0 && r / b != a) {\n                throw overflow(a, b, \"*\");\n            }\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private static long negateExact(long a) {\n        if (a == Long.MIN_VALUE) {\n            throw new EvalException(\"INTEGER_OVERFLOW\",\n                    \"一元负号导致整数溢出：-\" + a + \" 超出 64 位有符号整数范围\");\n        }\n        return -a;\n    }\n\n    private static EvalException overflow(long a, long b, String op) {\n        return new EvalException(\"INTEGER_OVERFLOW\",\n                \"整数运算溢出：\" + a + \" \" + op + \" \" + b\n                        + \" 的结果超出 64 位有符号整数范围（\"\n                        + Long.MIN_VALUE + \" ~ \" + Long.MAX_VALUE + \"）\");\n    }\n}\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"763dae22-8043-487b-a9db-d5653f4e3197","session_id":"e005d12a-a1e6-4b8e-a696-90144e423ae2","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp11/a","sessionId":"e005d12a-a1e6-4b8e-a696-90144e423ae2","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp11-a","slug":"warm-stargazing-music"}

tvl.json;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 零依赖 JSON 解析器与序列化器。\n *\n * 解析结果只使用标准 Java 类型：\n *  Map(String,Object) / List(Object) / String / Double(仅语法允许) /\n *  Long / Boolean / null。\n *\n * 注意：查询引擎只接受 JSON 整数（解析为 Long）；遇到带小数点/指数的数\n * 会保留为 Double，但在装载 INTEGER 列时会被拒绝并报错。\n */\npublic final class Json {\n\n    private Json() {}\n\n    // ================= 解析 =================\n\n    public static Object parse(String text) {\n        Parser p = new Parser(text);\n    p.skipWs();\n        Object v = p.readValue();\n        p.skipWs();\n        if (!p.eof()) {\n            throw new JsonParseException(\"JSON 结束后仍有多余内容\", p.line, p.col);\n        }\n        return v;\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    public static Map<String, Object> parseObject(String text) {\n        Object v = parse(text);\n        if (!(v instanceof Map)) {\n            throw new JsonParseException(\"期望 JSON 对象 { ... }\", 1, 1);\n        }\n        return (Map<String, Object>) v;\n    }\n\n    private static final class Parser {\n        final String s;\n        int i = 0;\n        int line = 1, col = 1;\n\n        Parser(String s) {\n            this.s = s == null ? \"\" : s;\n        }\n\n        boolean eof() {\n            return i >= s.length();\n        }\n\n        char peek() {\n            return s.charAt(i);\n        }\n\n        void skipWs() {\n            while (!eof()) {\n                char c = peek();\n                if (c == ' ' || c == '\\t' || c == '\\r') {\n                    advance();\n                } else if (c == '\\n') {\n                    advance();\n                } else {\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        void advance() {\n            if (!eof()) {\n                if (s.charAt(i) == '\\n') { line++; col = 1; } else { col++; }\n                i++;\n            }\n        }\n\n        Object readValue() {\n            skipWs();\n            if (eof()) {\n                throw new JsonParseException(\"意外结束：期望一个 JSON 值\", line, col);\n            }\n            char c = peek();\n            switch (c) {\n                case '{': return readObject();\n                case '[': return readArray();\n                case '\"': return readString();\n                case 't': case 'f': return readBoolean();\n                case 'n': return readNull();\n                default:\n                    if (c == '-' || c == '+') {\n                        if (c == '+') {\n                            throw new JsonParseException(\"数字不允许以 '+' 开头\", line, col);\n                        }\n                    }\n                    if (c == '-' || (c >= '0' && c <= '9')) {\n                        return readNumber();\n                    }\n                    throw new JsonParseException(\"无法识别的 JSON 值，起始字符 '\"\n                            + c + \"'\", line, col);\n            }\n        }\n\n        Map<String, Object> readObject() {\n            expect('{');\n            Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            skipWs();\n            if (consume('}')) {\n                return m;\n            }\n            while (true) {\n                skipWs();\n                if (peek() != '\"') {\n                    throw new JsonParseException(\"对象键必须是字符串\", line, col);\n                }\n                String key = readString();\n                skipWs();\n                expect(':');\n                Object val = readValue();\n                m.put(key, val);\n                skipWs();\n                if (consume(',')) {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                expect('}');\n                return m;\n            }\n        }\n\n        List<Object> readArray() {\n            expect('[');\n            List<Object> list = new ArrayList<>();\n            skipWs();\n            if (consume(']')) {\n                return list;\n            }\n            while (true) {\n                list.add(readValue());\n                skipWs();\n                if (consume(',')) {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                expect(']');\n                return list;\n            }\n        }\n\n        String readString() {\n            expect('\"');\n            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();\n            while (!eof()) {\n                char c = peek();\n                if (c == '\"') {\n                    advance();\n                    return sb.toString();\n                }\n                if (c == '\\\\') {\n                    advance();\n                    if (eof()) {\n                        throw new JsonParseException(\"未结束的转义序列\", line, col);\n                    }\n                    char esc = peek();\n                    switch (esc) {\n                        case '\"': sb.append('\"'); break;\n                        case '\\\\': sb.append('\\\\'); break;\n                        case '/': sb.append('/'); break;\n                        case 'b': sb.append('\\b'); break;\n                        case 'f': sb.append('\\f'); break;\n                        case 'n': sb.append('\\n'); break;\n                        case 'r': sb.append('\\r'); break;\n                        case 't': sb.append('\\t'); break;\n                        case 'u': {\n                            advance();\n                            int code = 0;\n                            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {\n                                if (eof()) {\n                                    throw new JsonParseException(\"不完整的 \\\\u 转义\", line, col);\n                                }\n                                char h = peek();\n                                int d = hexDigit(h);\n                                if (d < 0) {\n                                    throw new JsonParseException(\"\\\\u 后需要 4 位十六进制数字\", line, col);\n                                }\n                                code = code * 16 + d;\n                                advance();\n                            }\n                            sb.append((char) code);\n                            continue;\n                        }\n                        default:\n                            throw new JsonParseException(\"非法转义字符 \\\\\" + esc, line, col);\n                    }\n                    advance();\n                } else {\n                    sb.append(c);\n                    advance();\n                }\n            }\n            throw new JsonParseException(\"字符串未结束（缺少 \\\"）\", line, col);\n        }\n\n        Boolean readBoolean() {\n            if (matchLiteral(\"true\")) {\n                return Boolean.TRUE;\n            }\n            if (matchLiteral(\"false\")) {\n                return Boolean.FALSE;\n            }\n            throw new JsonParseException(\"非法的字面量（期望 true/false/null）\", line, col);\n        }\n\n        Object readNull() {\n            if (matchLiteral(\"null\")) {\n                return null;\n            }\n            throw new JsonParseException(\"非法的字面量（期望 null）\", line, col);\n        }\n\n        boolean matchLiteral(String lit) {\n            if (s.regionMatches(i, lit, 0, lit.length())) {\n                for (int k = 0; k < lit.length(); k++) {\n                    advance();\n                }\n                return true;\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        Object readNumber() {\n            int startLine = line, startCol = col;\n            int begin = i;\n            boolean isDouble = false;\n            if (peek() == '-') {\n                advance();\n            }\n            readIntDigits();\n            if (!eof() && peek() == '.') {\n                isDouble = true;\n                advance();\n                readIntDigits();\n            }\n            if (!eof() && (peek() == 'e' || peek() == 'E')) {\n                isDouble = true;\n                advance();\n                if (!eof() && (peek() == '+' || peek() == '-')) {\n                    advance();\n                }\n                readIntDigits();\n            }\n            String text = s.substring(begin, i);\n            if (isDouble) {\n                try {\n                    return Double.valueOf(text);\n                } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {\n                    throw new JsonParseException(\"非法数字：\" + text, startLine, startCol);\n                }\n            }\n            try {\n                return Long.valueOf(text);\n            } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {\n                throw new JsonParseException(\"整数超出范围：\" + text, startLine, startCol);\n            }\n        }\n\n        void readIntDigits() {\n            if (eof() || !(peek() >= '0' && peek() <= '9')) {\n                throw new JsonParseException(\"数字此处应有一位数字\", line, col);\n            }\n            while (!eof() && peek() >= '0' && peek() <= '9') {\n                advance();\n            }\n        }\n\n        void expect(char c) {\n            if (eof() || peek() != c) {\n                throw new JsonParseException(\"期望字符 '\" + c + \"'\"\n                        + (eof() ? \"，但输入已结束\" : \"，实际为 '\" + peek() + \"'\"),\n                        line, col);\n            }\n            advance();\n        }\n\n        boolean consume(char c) {\n            if (!eof() && peek() == c) {\n                advance();\n                return true;\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        int hexDigit(char c) {\n            if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {\n                return c - '0';\n            }\n            if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') {\n                return c - 'a' + 10;\n            }\n            if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') {\n                return c - 'A' + 10;\n            }\n            return -1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ================= 序列化 =================\n\n    /** 紧凑输出。 */\n    public static String stringify(Object v) {\n        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();\n        write(sb, v);\n        return sb.toString();\n    }\n\n    /** 两空格缩进的美观输出。 */\n    public static String pretty(Object v) {\n        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();\n        writePretty(sb, v, 0);\n        sb.append('\\n');\n        return sb.toString();\n    }\n\n    private static void write(StringBuilder sb, Object v) {\n        if (v == null) {\n            sb.append(\"null\");\n        } else if (v instanceof Boolean) {\n            sb.append(v);\n        } else if (v instanceof Number) {\n            sb.append(v);\n        } else if (v instanceof String) {\n            writeString(sb, (String) v);\n        } else if (v instanceof Map) {\n            sb.append('{');\n            boolean first = true;\n            for (Map.Entry<?, ?> e : ((Map<?, ?>) v).entrySet()) {\n                if (!first) { sb.append(','); }\n                first = false;\n                writeString(sb, String.valueOf(e.getKey()));\n                sb.append(':');\n                write(sb, e.getValue());\n            }\n            sb.append('}');\n        } else if (v instanceof List) {\n            sb.append('[');\n            boolean first = true;\n            for (Object o : (List<?>) v) {\n                if (!first) { sb.append(','); }\n                first = false;\n                write(sb, o);\n            }\n            sb.append(']');\n        } else {\n            writeString(sb, String.valueOf(v));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void writePretty(StringBuilder sb, Object v, int indent) {\n        if (v == null || v instanceof Boolean || v instanceof Number) {\n            sb.append(v == null ? \"null\" : String.valueOf(v));\n        } else if (v instanceof String) {\n            writeString(sb, (String) v);\n        } else if (v instanceof Map) {\n            Map<?, ?> m = (Map<?, ?>) v;\n            if (m.isEmpty()) {\n                sb.append(\"{}\");\n                return;\n            }\n            sb.append(\"{\\n\");\n            boolean first = true;\n            for (Map.Entry<?, ?> e : m.entrySet()) {\n                if (!first) { sb.append(\",\\n\"); }\n                first = false;\n                pad(sb, indent + 1);\n                writeString(sb, String.valueOf(e.getKey()));\n                sb.append(\": \");\n                writePretty(sb, e.getValue(), indent + 1);\n            }\n            sb.append('\\n');\n            pad(sb, indent);\n            sb.append('}');\n        } else if (v instanceof List) {\n            List<?> list = (List<?>) v;\n            if (list.isEmpty()) {\n                sb.append(\"[]\");\n                return;\n            }\n            sb.append(\"[\\n\");\n            for (int k = 0; k < list.size(); k++) {\n                if (k > 0) { sb.append(\",\\n\"); }\n                pad(sb, indent + 1);\n                writePretty(sb, list.get(k), indent + 1);\n            }\n            sb.append('\\n');\n            pad(sb, indent);\n            sb.append(']');\n        } else {\n            writeString(sb, String.valueOf(v));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void pad(StringBuilder sb, int level) {\n        for (int k = 0; k < level * 2; k++) {\n            sb.append(' ');\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void writeString(StringBuilder sb, String s) {\n        sb.append('\"');\n        for (int k = 0; k < s.length(); k++) {\n            char c = s.charAt(k);\n            switch (c) {\n                case '\"': sb.append(\"\\\\\\\"\"); break;\n                case '\\\\': sb.append(\"\\\\\\\\\"); break;\n                case '\\n': sb.append(\"\\\\n\"); break;\n                case '\\r': sb.append(\"\\\\r\"); break;\n                case '\\t': sb.append(\"\\\\t\"); break;\n                case '\\b': sb.append(\"\\\\b\"); break;\n                case '\\f': sb.append(\"\\\\f\"); break;\n                default:\n                    if (c < 0x20) {\n                        sb.append(String.format(\"\\\\u%04x\", (int) c));\n                    } else {\n                        sb.append(c);\n                    }\n            }\n        }\n        sb.append('\"');\n    }\n\n    // ================= 便捷取值（带类型错误提示） =================\n\n    public static String requireString(Map<String, Object> m, String key) {\n        Object v = m.get(key);\n        if (!(v instanceof String)) {\n            throw new BadRequestException(\"字段 '\" + key + \"' 必须是字符串\");\n        }\n        return (String) v;\n    }\n\n    public static String optionalString(Map<String, Object> m, String key, String dflt) {\n        Object v = m.get(key);\n        if (v == null) {\n            return dflt;\n        }\n        if (!(v instanceof String)) {\n            throw new BadRequestException(\"字段 '\" + key + \"' 必须是字符串\");\n        }\n        return (String) v;\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    public static Map<String, Object> requireObject(Object v, String what) {\n        if (!(v instanceof Map)) {\n            throw new BadRequestException(what + \" 必须是 JSON 对象\");\n        }\n        return (Map<String, Object>) v;\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    public static List<Object> requireArray(Object v, String what) {\n        if (!(v instanceof List)) {\n            throw new BadRequestException(what + \" 必须是 JSON 数组\");\n        }\n        return (List<Object>) v;\n private final String name;\n    private final List<Column> columns;\n    private final List<Value[]> rows;\n    private final Map<String, Integer> index = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n\n    public    }\n\n    /** 列名 -> 类型（顺序与列定义一致）。 */\n    public Map<String, DataType> schemaMap() {\n        Map<String, DataType> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (Column c : columns) {\n tvl.engine;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\nimport tvl.core.TriBool;\nimport tvl.core.Value;\nimport tvl.eval.Evaluator;\nimport tvl.parser.Expr;\n\n/**\n * 查询执行器：对一张内存表逐行执行已编译的过滤表达式。\n *\n * 三值逻辑过滤语义：仅表达式结果为 TRUE 的行被选中；\n * FALSE 与 UNKNOWN（NULL 参与比较等情况）均被排除，\n * 同时在结果中给出每行的三值判定，便于核对 3VL 行为。\n *\n * 执行结果包含一个可导出的执行计划：扫描节点 + 过滤 AST。\n */\npublic final class QueryEngine {\n\n    private final Table table;\n    private final Expr filter;\n    private final Evaluator evaluator;\n\n    public QueryEngine(Table table, Expr filter) {\n        this.table = table;\n        this.filter = filter;\n        this.evaluator = new Evaluator(table.columnNames());\n    }\n\n    /** 单行求值结果：三值判定 + 是否选中。 */\n    public static final class RowOutcome {\n        public final int rowIndex;\n        public final TriBool tri;\n        public final boolean selected;\n\n        RowOutcome(int rowIndex, TriBool tri) {\n            this.rowIndex = rowIndex;\n            this.tri = tri;\n            this.selected = tri == TriBool.TRUE;\n        }\n\n        public Map<String, Object> toJson(Value[] row) {\n            Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            m.put(\"rowIndex\", rowIndex);\n            m.put(\"triValue\", tri.name());\n            m.put(\"selected\", selected);\n            List<Object> r = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Value v : row) {\n                r.add(v.toJson());\n            }\n            m.put(\"row\", r);\n            return m;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 执行结果：选中行 + 全部行的三值判定 + 统计。 */\n    public static final class QueryResult {\n        public final List<Value[]> selectedRows;\n        public final List<RowOutcome> outcomes;\n\n        QueryResult(List<Value[]> selectedRows, List<RowOutcome> outcomes) {\n            this.selectedRows = selectedRows;\n            this.outcomes = outcomes;\n        }\n\n tvl.engine;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\nimport tvl.core.CompileException;\nimport tvl.core.DataType;\nimport tvl.core.EvalException;\nimport tvl.core.Value;\nimport tvl.json.BadRequestException;\nimport tvl.json.Json;\nimport tvl.parser.Expr;\nimport tvl.parser.Parser;\nimport tvl.parser.TypeChecker;\n\n/**\n * JSON 请求入口：解析请求 → 构造内存表 → 解析+类型检查表达式 →\n * 生成执行计划 → 执行查询 → 装配响应。\n *\n * 请求结构见 samples/ 与 README。\n */\npublic final class RequestHandler {\n\n    public static final class Response {\n        public final boolean ok;\n        public final Map<String, Object> body;\n\n        Response(boolean ok, Map<String, Object> body) {\n            this.ok = ok;\n            this.body = body;\n        }\n\n        public String toJson() {\n            return Json.pretty(body);\n        }\n    }\n\n    public Response handle(String requestJson) {\n        Map<String, Object> req;\n        try {\n            req = Json.parseObject(requestJson);\n        } catch (RuntimeException ex) {\n            return error(\"INVALID_JSON\", \"请求不是合法 JSON：\" + ex.getMessage(),\n                    null, null);\n        }\n\n        try {\n            return doHandle(req);\n        } catch (BadRequestException ex) {\n            return error(\"BAD_REQUEST\", ex.getMessage(), null, null);\n        } catch (CompileException ex) {\n            return error(ex.code(), ex.getMessage(), ex.pos(), ex.length());\n        } catch (EvalException ex) {\n            return error(ex.code(), ex.getMessage(), null, null);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private Response doHandle(Map<String, Object> req) {\n        Object exprField = req.get(\"expression\");\n        if (exprField == null) {\n            throw new BadRequestException(\"缺少字段 'expression'（过滤表达式）\");\n        }\n        if (!(exprField instanceof String)) {\n            throw new BadRequestException(\"字段 'expression' 必须是字符串\");\n        }\n        String source = (String) exprField;\n\n        Table table;\n        Object tableField = req.get(\"table\");\n        if (tableField == null) {\n tvl.engine;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\nimport tvl.core.CompileException;\nimport tvl.core.DataType;\nimport tvl.core.EvalException;\nimport tvl.core.Pos;\nimport tvl.core.Value;\nimport tvl.eval.Evaluator;\nimport tvl.core.TriBool;\nimport tvl.json.BadRequestException;\nimport tvl.json.Json;\nimport tvl.parser.Expr;\nimport tvl.parser.Parser;\nimport tvl.parser.TypeChecker;\n\n/**\n * JSON 请求入口：解析请求 → 构造内存表 → 解析+类型检查表达式 →\n * 生成执行计划 → 执行查询 → 装配响应。\n *\n * 请求结构（字段大小写敏感）：\n * <pre>\n * {\n *   \"expression\": \"a > 1 AND b IS NOT NULL\",\n *   \"table\": {\n *     \"name\": \"t\",\n *     \"columns\": [{\"name\":\"a\",\"type\":\"INTEGER\"}, ...],\n *     \"rows\": [[1, null], ...]\n *   },\n *   \"includeTable\": true\n * }\n * </pre>\n * 无 table 字段时按纯表达式处理：编译通过后对“空行”求值一次，\n * 返回表达式自身的标量结果与（对布尔表达式的）三值判定。\n */\npublic final class RequestHandler {\n\n    public static final class Response {\n        public final boolean ok;\n        public final Map<String, Object> body;\n\n        Response(boolean ok, Map<String, Object> body) {\n            this.ok = ok;\n            this.body = body;\n        }\n\n        public String toJson() {\n            return Json.pretty(body);\n        }\n    }\n\n    public Response handle(String requestJson) {\n        Map<String, Object> req;\n        try {\n            req = Json.parseObject(requestJson);\n        } catch (RuntimeException ex) {\n            return error(\"INVALID_JSON\", \"请求不是合法 JSON：\" + ex.getMessage(),\n                    null, null);\n        }\n\n        try {\n            return doHandle(req);\n        } catch (BadRequestException ex) {\n            return error(\"BAD_REQUEST\", ex.getMessage(), null, null);\n        } catch (CompileException ex) {\n            return error(ex.code(), ex.getMessage(), ex.pos(), ex.length());\n        } catch (EvalException ex) {\n            return error(ex.code(), ex.getMessage(), null, null);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private Response doHandle(Map<String, Object> req) {\n        Object exprField = req.get(\"expression\");\n        if (exprField == null) {\n            throw new BadRequestException(\"缺少字段 'expression'（过滤表达式）\");\n        }\n        if (!(exprField instanceof String)) {\n            throw new BadRequestException(\"字段 'expression' 必须是字符串\");\n        }\n        String source = (String) exprField;\n\n        boolean hasTable = req.containsKey(\"table\") && req.get(\"table\") != null;\n        Table table = hasTable\n                ? buildTable(Json.requireObject(req.get(\"table\"), \"字段 'table'\"))\n                : new Table(\"(inline)\", new ArrayList<>());\n        boolean includeTable = Boolean.TRUE.equals(req.get(\"includeTable\"));\n\n        // 1) 语法解析\n        Expr ast = Parser.parse(source);\n\n        // 2) 类型检查\n        TypeChecker checker = new TypeChecker(table.schemaMap());\n        checker.check(ast);\n\n        // 3) 执行计划\n        QueryEngine engine = new QueryEngine(table, ast);\n        Map<String, Object> plan = engine.explain();\n\n        // 4) 执行\n        Map<String, Object> result;\n        if (hasTable) {\n            result = engine.execute().toJson(table);\n        } else {\n            result = evalStandalone(ast);\n        }\n\n        Map<String, Object> body = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        body.put(\"ok\", true);\n        body.put(\"expression\", source);\n        body.put(\"ast\", ast.toJson());\n        body.put(\"plan\", plan);\n        body.put(\"result\", result);\n        if (includeTable && hasTable) {\n            body.put(\"table\", table.toJson());\n        }\n        return new Response(true, body);\n    }\n\n    /** 无表纯表达式：编译通过后对空行求值一次，返回标量值/三值。 */\n    private Map<String, Object> evalStandalone(Expr ast) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        Evaluator evaluator = new Evaluator(new String[0]);\n        Value v = evaluator.eval(ast, new Value[0]);\n\n        m.put(\"mode\", \"standaloneExpression\");\n        m.put(\"value\", v.describe());\n\n        if (v.type() == DataType.BOOLEAN || v.isNull()) {\n            TriBool tri = evaluator.evalLogic(ast, new Value[0]);\n            m.put(\"triValue\", tri.name());\n        }\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 表装载 ----------\n\n    private Table buildTable(Map<String, Object> tableNode) {\n        String tableName = Json.optionalString(tableNode, \"name\", \"t\");\n\n        Object colsNode = tableNode.get(\"columns\");\n        if (colsNode == null) {\n            throw new BadRequestException(\"table 中缺少 'columns'（列定义数组）\");\n        }\n        List<Object> cols = Json.requireArray(colsNode, \"table.columns\");\n        List<Table.Column> columns = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < cols.size(); i++) {\n            Map<String, Object> c = Json.requireObject(cols.get(i),\n                    \"table.columns[\" + i + \"]\");\n            String name = Json.requireString(c, \"name\");\n            String typeStr = Json.requireString(c, \"type\").toUpperCase();\n            DataType type;\n            try {\n                type = DataType.valueOf(typeStr);\n            } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {\n                throw new BadRequestException(\"不支持的列类型 '\" + typeStr\n                        + \"'（支持 INTEGER / BOOLEAN / STRING）\");\n            }\n            if (type == DataType.NULL) {\n                throw new BadRequestException(\"列类型不能为 NULL（NULL 只是取值）\");\n            }\n            if (names.contains(name)) {\n                throw new BadRequestException(\"列名重复：\" + name);\n            }\n            names.add(name);\n            columns.add(new Table.Column(name, type));\n        }\n\n        Object rowsNode = tableNode.get(\"rows\");\n        List<Object> rawRows = rowsNode == null\n                ? new ArrayList<>()\n                : Json.requireArray(rowsNode, \"table.rows\");\n\n        Table table = new Table(tableName, columns);\n        for (int i = 0; i < rawRows.size(); i++) {\n            List<Object> rawRow = Json.requireArray(rawRows.get(i),\n                    \"table.rows[\" + i + \"]\");\n            if (rawRow.size() != columns.size()) {\n                throw new BadRequestException(\"table.rows[\" + i\n                        + \"] 列数不匹配：期望 \" + columns.size()\n                        + \"，实际 \" + rawRow.size());\n            }\n            Value[] row = new Value[columns.size()];\n            for (int j = 0; j < columns.size(); j++) {\n                row[j] = convertCell(rawRow.get(j), columns.get(j), i, j);\n            }\n            table.addRow(row);\n        }\n        return table;\n    }\n\n    private Value convertCell(Object v, Table.Column col, int rowIdx, int colIdx) {\n        String where = \"table.rows[\" + rowIdx + \"][\" + colIdx + \"]（列 \"\n                + col.name + \"）\";\n        if (v == null) {\n            return Value.NULL;\n        }\n        switch (col.type) {\n            case INTEGER:\n                if (v instanceof Long) {\n                    return Value.ofInteger((Long) v);\n                }\n                if (v instanceof Integer) {\n                    return Value.ofInteger(((Integer) v).longValue());\n                }\n                if (v instanceof Double || v instanceof Float) {\n                    throw new BadRequestException(where\n                            + \" 必须是 JSON 整数，不接受小数 \" + v);\n                }\n                throw new BadRequestException(where + \" 必须是整数，实际为 \"\n                        + v.getClass().getSimpleName());\n            case BOOLEAN:\n                if (v instanceof Boolean) {\n                    return Value.ofBoolean((Boolean) v);\n                }\n                throw new BadRequestException(where + \" 必须是布尔值 true/false\");\n            case STRING:\n                if (v instanceof String) {\n                    return Value.ofString((String) v);\n                }\n                throw new BadRequestException(where + \" 必须是字符串\");\n            default:\n                throw new BadRequestException(where + \" 不支持的列类型\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 错误响应 ----------\n\n    private Response error(String code, String message, Pos pos, Integer length) {\n        Map<String, Object> body = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        body.put(\"ok\", false);\n        Map<String, Object> err = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        err.put(\"code\", message == null ? code : code);\n        err.put(\"code\", code);\n        err.put(\"message\", message);\n        if (pos != null) {\n            err.put(\"position\", pos.toJson());\n            if (length != null) {\n                err.put(\"length\", length);\n            }\n        }\n        body.put(\"error\", err);\n        return new Response(false, body);\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_601d573b1ff66059e247cec2","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":3349,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":61240,"output_tokens":2356,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_b7afc7rgwm6drbay2cs2pl2t":{"content":"package },\n *   \"includeTable\": true\n * }\n * </pre>\n * 无 table 字段时按纯表达式处理：编译通过后对“空行”求值一次，\n * 返回表达式自身的标量结果与（对布尔表达式的）三值判定。\n */\npublic final class RequestHandler {\n\n    public static final class Response {\n        public final boolean ok;\n        public final Map<String, Object> body;\n\n        Response(boolean ok, Map<String, Object> body) {\n            this.ok = ok;\n            this.body = body;\n        }\n\n        public String toJson() {\n            return Json.pretty(body);\n        }\n    }\n\n    public Response handle(String requestJson) {\n        Map<String, == null) {\n            throw new BadRequestException(\"缺少字段 'expression'（过滤表达式）\");\n        }\n        if (!(exprField instanceof String)) {\n            throw new BadRequestException(\"字段 hasTable\n                ? buildTable(Json.requireObject(req.get(\"table\"), \"字段 'table'\"))\n                : new Table(\"(inline)\", new ArrayList<>());\n        boolean includeTable =       // 4) 执行\n        Map<String, Object> result;\n        if (hasTable) {\n            result = engine.execute().toJson(table);\n        } else {\n            result = evalStandalone(ast);\n        }\n\n        Map<String, Object> body = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        body.put(\"ok\", true);\n        body.put(\"expression\", source);\n        body.put(\"ast\", ast.toJson());\n        body.put(\"plan\", plan);\n        body.put(\"result\", result);\n        if (includeTable && hasTable) {\n            body.put(\"table\", table.toJson());\n        }\n        return new Response(true, body);\n    }\n\n    /** 无表纯表达式：编译通过后对空行求值一次，返回标量值/三值。 */\n    private Map<String, Object> evalStandalone(Expr ast) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        Evaluator evaluator = new Evaluator(new String[0]);\n        Value v = evaluator.eval(ast, new Value[0]);\n\n        m.put(\"mode\", \"standaloneExpression\");\n        m.put(\"value\", }\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 表装载 ----------\n\n    private Table buildTable(Map<String, Object> tableNode) {\n        String tableName = Json.optionalString(tableNode, \"name\", \"t\");\n\n        Object colsNode = tableNode.get(\"columns\");\n        if (colsNode == null) {\n            throw new BadRequestException(\"table 中缺少 'columns'（列定义数组）\");\n        }\n        List<Object> cols = Json.requireArray(colsNode, \"table.columns\");\n        List<Table.Column> columns = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < cols.size(); i++) {\n            Map<String, Object> c = Json.requireObject(cols.get(i),\n                    \"table.columns[\" + i + \"]\");\n            String name = Json.requireString(c, \"name\");\n            String typeStr = Json.requireString(c, \"type\").toUpperCase();\n            DataType type;\n            try {\n                type = DataType.valueOf(typeStr);\n            } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {\n                throw new BadRequestException(\"不支持的列类型 '\" + typeStr\n                        + \"'（支持 INTEGER / BOOLEAN / STRING）\");\n            }\n BadRequestException(\"列名重复：\" + name);\n            }\n            names.add(name);\n            columns.add(new Table.Column(name, type));\n        }\n\n        Object rowsNode = tableNode.get(\"rows\");\n        List<Object> rawRows = rowsNode == null\n                ? new ArrayList<>()\n                : Json.requireArray(rowsNode, \"table.rows\");\n\n        Table table = new Table(tableName, columns);\n        for (int i = 0; i < rawRows.size(); i++) {\n            List<Object> rawRow = Json.requireArray(rawRows.get(i),\n                    \"table.rows[\" + i + \"]\");\n            if (rawRow.size() != columns.size()) {\n                throw new BadRequestException(\"table.rows[\" + i\n                        + \"] 列数不匹配：期望 \" + columns.size()\n convertCell(rawRow.get(j), columns.get(j), i, j);\n            }\n            table.addRow(row);\n        }\n        return table;\n    }\n\n    private Value convertCell(Object v, Table.Column col, int rowIdx, int colIdx) {\n        String where = \"table.rows[\" + rowIdx + \"][\" + colIdx + \"]（列 \"\n                + col.name + \"）\";\n        if (v == null) {\n            return Value.NULL;\n }\n\n    // ---------- 错误响应 ----------\n\n    private Response error(String code, String message, Pos pos, Integer length) {\n        Map<String, Object> body = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n tvl.cli;\n\nimport java.io.IOException;\nimport java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;\nimport java.nio.file.Files;\nimport java.nio.file.Paths;\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\nimport tvl.core.TriBool;\nimport tvl.engine.RequestHandler;\nimport tvl.eval.Evaluator;\nimport tvl.core.Value;\nimport tvl.json.Json;\nimport tvl.parser.Expr;\nimport tvl.parser.Parser;\nimport tvl.parser.TypeChecker;\n\n/**\n * 命令行入口（无网络服务，仅处理 JSON 请求文本）：\n *\n *  java tvl.cli.Main query [request.json]          不提供文件则从标准输入读取\n *  java tvl.cli.Main parse \"expr\"                  解析并输出 AST\n *  java tvl.cli.Main truth-table                  输出 NOT/AND/OR 穷举真值表\n *\n * 退出码：0 成功；2 请求/表达式错误；1 用法或 IO 错误。\n */\npublic final class Main {\n\n    public static void main(String[] args) {\n        if (args.length == 0) {\n            usage();\n            System.exit(1);\n        }\n        try {\n            switch (args[0]) {\n                case \"query\":\n                    doQuery(args.length > 1 ? args[1] : null);\n                    break;\n                case \"parse\":\n                    doParse(args);\n                    break;\n                case \"truth-table\":\n                    doTruthTable();\n                    break;\n                case \"--help\":\n                case \"-h\":\n                case \"help\":\n                    usage();\n                    break;\n                default:\n                    System.err.println(\"未知子命令：\" + args[0]);\n                    usage();\n                    System.exit(1);\n            }\n        } catch (IOException ex) {\n            System.err.println(\"IO 错误：\" + ex.getMessage());\n            System.exit(1);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void doQuery(String file) throws IOException {\n        String request = file == null\n                ? readAll(System.in)\n                : tvl.eval.Evaluator;\nimport tvl.parser.Expr;\nimport tvl.parser.Parser;\nimport tvl.parser.TypeChecker;\n\n/** 测试辅助：编译表达式、对单行求值、发送 JSON 请求。 */\npublic final class Harness {\n\n    private Harness() {}\n\n    public static Map<String, DataType> schema(Object... nameType) {\n        Map<String, DataType> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < nameType.length; i += 2) {\n            m.put((String) nameType[i], (DataType) nameType[i + 1]);\n        }\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    public static Expr compile(String source, Map<String, DataType> schema) {\n        Expr ast = Parser.parse(source);\n        new TypeChecker(schema).check(ast);\n        return ast;\n    }\n\n    public static Expr compile(String source) {\n        return compile(source, new LinkedHashMap<>());\n    }\n\n    /** Object[] 转 Value[]：Long/Integer→INTEGER，Boolean→BOOLEAN，String→STRING，null→NULL。 */\n    public static Value[] row(Object... cells) {\n        Value[] vs = new Value[cells.length];\n        for (int i = 0; i < cells.length; i++) {\n            Object o = cells[i];\n            if (o == null) {\n                vs[i] = Value.NULL;\n            } else if (o instanceof Long || o instanceof Integer) {\n                vs[i] = Value.ofInteger(((Number) o).longValue());\n            } else if (o instanceof Boolean) {\n                vs[i] = Value.ofBoolean((Boolean) o);\n            } else if (o instanceof String) {\n                vs[i] = Value.ofString((String) o);\n            } else if (o instanceof Value) {\n                vs[i] = (Value) o;\n            } else {\n                throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"不支持的测试值：\" + o);\n            }\n        }\n        return vs;\n    }\n\n    public static Value[] rowV(Value... cells) {\n        return cells;\n    }\n\n    public static TriBool logic(String source, Map<String, DataType> schema,\n                                String[] colNames, Value[] row) {\n        Expr ast = compile(source, schema);\n        return new Evaluator(colNames).evalLogic(ast, row);\n    }\n\n    /** 单列便捷求值。 */\n    public static TriBool logic1(String source, String col, DataType type, Value v) {\n        return logic(source, schema(col, type), new String[]{col}, rowV(v));\n    }\n\n    public static Value value(String source, Map<String, DataType> schema,\n                              String[] colNames, Value[] row) {\n        Expr ast = compile(source, schema);\n        return new Evaluator(colNames).eval(ast, row);\n    }\n\n    public static Value value(String source) {\n        Expr ast = compile(source);\n        return new Evaluator(new String[0]).eval(ast, new Value[0]);\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    public static Map<String, Object> request(String json) {\n        RequestHandler.Response resp = new RequestHandler().handle(json);\n        return (Map<String, Object>) (Map<?, ?>) resp.body;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_bdc71874582c2cd65406a28d","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":428,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":69432,"output_tokens":4603,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_r7fpkzwtv9k6bst1ixj2rxzr":{"content":"package {}\n\n    public static Map<String, DataType> schema(Object... nameType) {\n        Map<String, DataType> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < nameType.length; i += 2) {\n            m.put((String) nameType[i], (DataType) nameType[i + 1]);\n        }\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    public static Expr compile(String source, Map<String, DataType> schema) {\n        Expr ast = Parser.parse(source);\n        new TypeChecker(schema).check(ast);\n        return ast;\n    }\n\n    public static Expr compile(String source) {\n        return compile(source, new LinkedHashMap<>());\n    }\n\n    /** Object[] 转 Value[]：Long/Integer→INTEGER，Boolean→BOOLEAN，String→STRING，null→NULL。 */\n    public static Value[] row(Object... cells) {\n        Value[] vs = new (Value) o;\n            } else {\n                throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"不支持的测试值：\" + o);\n            }\n        }\n        return vs;\n    }\n\n    public static Value[] rowV(Value...     String[] colNames, Value[] row) {\n        Expr ast = compile(source, schema);\n        return new Evaluator(colNames).eval(ast, row);\n    }\n\n    public static Value value(String source) {\n        Expr ast = compile(source);\n        return new Evaluator(new String[0]).eval(ast, new Value[0]);\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    public static Map<String, Object> {"parentUuid":"a8e069d6-425a-4e3c-b00d-ce935bacfb89","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_zijik00fv8whytbescht82pc","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp11/a/src/test/java/tvl/TruthTableTest.java","content":"package tvl;\n\nimport java.util.Map;\n\nimport tvl.core.DataType;\nimport tvl.core.TriBool;\nimport tvl.core.Value;\n\n/**\n * 验收点：穷举三值真值表。\n *\n * 真值集合 {TRUE, FALSE, UNKNOWN}，用数值编码 T=1, U=0, F=-1；\n * Kleene 逻辑的独立参照定义（不使用被测的 TriBool.and/or）：\n *   a AND b = min(a,b)，a OR b = max(a,b)，NOT a = -a。\n *\n * 每条取值组合都通过完整管线（解析 -> 类型检查 -> 求值器，\n * 且操作数来自真实布尔列而非字面量）验证，共：\n *   NOT 3 种 + AND 3x3=9 种 + OR 3x3=9 种 = 21 种，全部穷举。\n */\npublic class TruthTableTest {\n\n    private static final TriBool[] TRIS = {TriBool.TRUE, TriBool.UNKNOWN, TriBool.FALSE};\n\n    public static void run() {\n        Map<String, DataType> schema = Harness.schema(\n                \"a\", DataType.BOOLEAN, \"b\", DataType.BOOLEAN);\n        String[] cols = {\"a\", \"b\"};\n\n        // ---- NOT：3 种穷举 ----\n        String[] notSrc = {\"NOT a\", \"NOT (NOT a)\"};\n        for (TriBool a : TRIS) {\n            Value[] row = Harness.rowV(triToValue(a));\n            TriBool got = Harness.logic(notSrc[0],\n                    Harness.schema(\"a\", DataType.BOOLEAN),\n                    new String[]{\"a\"}, row);\n            TF.assertEquals(oracleNot(a), got);\n\n            // 双重否定等于自身\n            TriBool got2 = Harness.logic(notSrc[1],\n                    Harness.schema(\"a\", DataType.BOOLEAN),\n                    new String[]{\"a\"}, row);\n            TF.assertEquals(a, got2);\n        }\n\n        // ---- AND / OR：3x3 = 9 种穷举（各一遍） ----\n        for (TriBool a : TRIS) {\n            for (TriBool b : TRIS) {\n                Value[] row = Harness.rowV(triToValue(a), triToValue(b));\n\n                TriBool andGot = Harness.logic(\"a AND b\", schema, cols, row);\n                TF.assertEquals(oracleAnd(a, b), andGot);\n\n                TriBool orGot = Harness.logic(\"a OR b\", schema, cols, row);\n                TF.assertEquals(oracleOr(a, b), orGot);\n\n                // 德摩根定律：NOT(a AND b) == NOT a OR NOT b\n                TriBool dm1 = Harness.logic(\"NOT (a AND b)\", schema, cols, row);\n                TriBool dm2 = Harness.logic(\"NOT a OR NOT b\", schema, cols, row);\n                TF.assertEquals(dm1, dm2);\n\n                // 排中律/矛盾律在 3VL 下不成立的经典反例：\n                // U OR U = U（不是 TRUE），U AND U = U（不是 FALSE）\n                if (a == TriBool.UNKNOWN && b == TriBool.UNKNOWN) {\n                    TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN, andGot);\n                    TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN, orGot);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // ---- 与 SQL 规格逐条核对的关键单元格 ----\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN, TriBool.TRUE.and(TriBool.UNKNOWN));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE, TriBool.FALSE.and(TriBool.UNKNOWN));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, TriBool.TRUE.or(TriBool.UNKNOWN));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN, TriBool.FALSE.or(TriBool.UNKNOWN));\n    }\n\n    // ---- 独立 oracle：数值编码 + min/max/取负 ----\n\n    private static int code(TriBool t) {\n        return t == TriBool.TRUE ? 1 : t == TriBool.FALSE ? -1 : 0;\n    }\n\n    private static TriBool ofCode(int c) {\n        return c > 0 ? TriBool.TRUE : c < 0 ? TriBool.FALSE : TriBool.UNKNOWN;\n    }\n\n    private static TriBool oracleAnd(TriBool a, TriBool b) {\n        return ofCode(Math.min(code(a), code(b)));\n    }\n\n    private static TriBool oracleOr(TriBool a, TriBool b) {\n        return ofCode(Math.max(code(a), code(b)));\n    }\n\n    private static TriBool oracleNot(TriBool a) {\n        return ofCode(-code(a));\n    }\n\n    private static Value triToValue(TriBool t) {\n        return t == TriBool.UNKNOWN ? Value.NULL\n                : Value.ofBoolean(t == TriBool.TRUE);\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_d645ecef5555cdae9a5ba44e","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2778,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":69432,"output_tokens":1277,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_zijik00fv8whytbescht82pc":{"content":"package {"parentUuid":"6688be8c-5e45-40b1-bfdd-d29808fb51b4","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_8hntt4vu7zcly8hzg2xg8lqk","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp11/a/src/test/java/tvl/PrecedenceTest.java","content":"package tvl;\n\nimport tvl.core.DataType;\nimport tvl.core.TriBool;\nimport tvl.core.Value;\n\n/**\n * 验收点：运算符优先级、结合性与括号。\n *\n * 优先级（低 -> 高）：OR < AND < NOT < 比较 < + - < * / < 一元 - < 原子。\n * 这与 SQL 的惯例一致（比较紧于 NOT；NOT 紧于 AND；AND 紧于 OR）。\n */\npublic class PrecedenceTest {\n\n    public static void run() {\n        arithmetic();\n        comparisonVsArithmetic();\n        logicPrecedence();\n        notPrecedence();\n        isNullPrecedence();\n        parentheses();\n        unaryMinus();\n        keywordsCaseInsensitive();\n        comments();\n    }\n\n    private static void arithmetic() {\n        // 乘除高于加减\n        TF.assertEquals(14L, Harness.value(\"2 + 3 * 4\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(20L, Harness.value(\"(2 + 3) * 4\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(-5L, Harness.value(\"10 / 2 - 10\").integer());\n        // 左结合\n        TF.assertEquals(5L, Harness.value(\"10 - 2 - 3\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(1L, Harness.value(\"20 / 4 / 5\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(14L, Harness.value(\"2 * 3 + 4 * 2\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(2L, Harness.value(\"7 / 3\").integer());          // 整除向零\n        TF.assertEquals(-2L, Harness.value(\"-7 / 3\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(2L, Harness.value(\"7 / -3\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void comparisonVsArithmetic() {\n        TF.assertEquals(true, Harness.value(\"2 + 3 = 5\").bool());\n        TF.assertEquals(true, Harness.value(\"2 * 3 > 2 + 1\").bool());\n        TF.assertEquals(false, Harness.value(\"10 - 2 * 3 = 24\").bool()); // 4 = 24 -> false\n        TF.assertEquals(true, Harness.value(\"10 - 2 * 3 = 4\").bool());\n        // != 与 <> 等价\n        TF.assertEquals(true, Harness.value(\"1 <> 2\").bool());\n        TF.assertEquals(true, Harness.value(\"1 != 2\").bool());\n        TF.assertEquals(false, Harness.value(\"1 <> 1\").bool());\n        TF.assertEquals(true, Harness.value(\"3 >= 3\").bool());\n        TF.assertEquals(false, Harness.value(\"3 > 3\").bool());\n        TF.assertEquals(true, Harness.value(\"'b' >= 'a'\").bool());\n        TF.assertEquals(true, Harness.value(\"'abc' < 'abd'\").bool());\n    }\n\n    private static void logicPrecedence() {\n        // AND 紧于 OR：TRUE OR FALSE AND FALSE => TRUE OR (FALSE AND FALSE) = TRUE\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"TRUE OR FALSE AND FALSE\"));\n        // 若从左到右错误结合会是 (TRUE OR FALSE) AND FALSE = FALSE\n        // FALSE OR TRUE AND TRUE => FALSE OR TRUE = TRUE\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"FALSE OR TRUE AND TRUE\"));\n        // a AND b OR c AND d == (a AND b) OR (c AND d)\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE, tri(\"FALSE AND TRUE OR FALSE AND TRUE\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"TRUE AND FALSE OR TRUE AND TRUE\"));\n    }\n\n    private static void notPrecedence() {\n        // NOT 紧于 AND：NOT FALSE AND FALSE => (NOT FALSE) AND FALSE = TRUE AND FALSE = FALSE\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE, tri(\"NOT FALSE AND FALSE\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"NOT FALSE AND TRUE\"));\n        // 比较紧于 NOT（SQL 语义）：NOT 1 = 2 => NOT (1 = 2) = TRUE\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"NOT 1 = 2\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE, tri(\"NOT 1 = 1\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"NOT NOT 1 = 1\"));\n    }\n\n    private static void isNullPrecedence() {\n        // IS NULL 与 AND：col IS NULL AND TRUE\n        var schema = Harness.schema(\"x\", DataType.INTEGER);\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"x IS NULL AND TRUE\", schema,\n                        new String[]{\"x\"}, Harness.rowV(Value.NULL)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                Harness.logic(\"x IS NULL AND TRUE\", schema,\n                        new String[]{\"x\"}, Harness.rowV(Value.ofInteger(1))));\n        // NOT 作用于 IS NULL：NOT x IS NULL 等价 NOT (x IS NULL)\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                Harness.logic(\"NOT x IS NULL\", schema,\n                        new String[]{\"x\"}, Harness.rowV(Value.NULL)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"NOT x IS NULL\", schema,\n                        new String[]{\"x\"}, Harness.rowV(Value.ofInteger(1))));\n        // 显式 IS NOT NULL\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"x IS NOT NULL\", schema,\n                        new String[]{\"x\"}, Harness.rowV(Value.ofInteger(1))));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                Harness.logic(\"x IS NOT NULL\", schema,\n                        new String[]{\"x\"}, Harness.rowV(Value.NULL)));\n    }\n\n    private static void parentheses() {\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE, tri(\"(TRUE OR FALSE) AND FALSE\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"NOT (FALSE AND TRUE)\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(10L, Harness.value(\"(2 + 3) * (6 - 4)\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void unaryMinus() {\n        TF.assertEquals(-6L, Harness.value(\"-2 * 3\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(6L, Harness.value(\"-2 * -3\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(-5L, Harness.value(\"-(2 + 3)\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(6L, Harness.value(\"3 - -3\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void keywordsCaseInsensitive() {\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"true or false\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE, tri(\"True And False\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"not false\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN, tri(\"NOT Null\"));\n    }\n\n    private static void comments() {\n        TF.assertEquals(3L, Harness.value(\"1 + -- line comment\\n2\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(3L, Harness.value(\"1 /* block */ + 2\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                tri(\"TRUE -- keep going\\n OR FALSE\"));\n    }\n\n    private static TriBool tri(String src) {\n        return Harness.value(src).isNull()\n                ? TriBool.UNKNOWN\n                : (Harness.value(src).bool() ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE);\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_0bcd7ecb939ebc69a51e46a7","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2048,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":71480,"output_tokens":2569,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_8hntt4vu7zcly8hzg2xg8lqk":{"content":"package Harness.rowV(Value.NULL)));\n    }\n\n    private static void parentheses() {\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE, tri(\"(TRUE OR FALSE) AND FALSE\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"NOT (FALSE AND TRUE)\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(10L, Harness.value(\"(2 + 3) * (6 - 4)\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void unaryMinus() {\n        TF.assertEquals(-6L, TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE, tri(\"True And False\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"not false\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN, tri(\"NOT Null\"));\n    }\n\n    private
