{"parentUuid":"4516d10c-5310-4957-94b0-3f4856d738ba","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_pfufwjoh4uz9qzpobcqzietp","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp11/a/src/test/java/tvl/NullComparisonTest.java","content":"package tvl;\n\nimport java.util.Map;\n\nimport tvl.core.DataType;\nimport tvl.core.TriBool;\nimport tvl.core.Value;\n\n/**\n * 验收点：NULL 参与比较的 SQL 三值语义。\n *\n * 穷举：左操作数 3 种取值（含 NULL）x 右操作数 3 种取值 x 6 种比较符，\n * 对 INTEGER 与 STRING 各一遍，并覆盖“字面量 NULL”与“列值 NULL”两种来源。\n *\n * SQL 规则：只要一侧为 NULL，= &lt;&gt; &lt; &lt;= &gt; &gt;= 结果一律 UNKNOWN。\n * 特别注意 NULL &lt;&gt; NULL 也是 UNKNOWN（不是 TRUE），必须用 IS NULL 判空。\n */\npublic class NullComparisonTest {\n\n    public static void run() {\n        integerExhaustive();\n        stringExhaustive();\n        literalNullCases();\n        nullPropagation();\n        isNullCases();\n        filterSemantics();\n    }\n\n    private static void integerExhaustive() {\n        Value[] vals = {Value.ofInteger(1), Value.NULL, Value.ofInteger(2)};\n        String[][] ops = {\n                {\"=\", \"eq\"}, {\"<>\", \"ne\"}, {\"<\", \"lt\"},\n                {\"<=\", \"le\"}, {\">\", \"gt\"}, {\">=\", \"ge\"}\n        };\n        Map<String, DataType> schema = Harness.schema(\n                \"a\", DataType.INTEGER, \"b\", DataType.INTEGER);\n\n        for (Value a : vals) {\n            for (Value b : vals) {\n                for (String[] op : ops) {\n                    long av = 1, bv = 2; // 与 vals 中非 NULL 的具体值一致\n                    TriBool expected = expectedInt(op[0],\n                            a.isNull() ? null : a.integer(),\n                            b.isNull() ? null : b.integer());\n                    // 用非空实际值重算 oracle 更严谨：\n                    expected = oracleInt(op[0], a, b);\n                    String src = \"a \" + op[0] + \" b\";\n                    TriBool got = Harness.logic(src, schema,\n                            new String[]{\"a\", \"b\"}, Harness.rowV(a, b));\n                    TF.assertEquals(expected, got);\n                    av = a.isNull() ? 0 : a.integer();\n                    bv = b.isNull() ? 0 : b.integer();\n                    if (av == 0 && bv == 0) {\n                        // 仅用于消除未用变量提示，无实际断言意义\n                        TF.assertTrue(true, \"\");\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static TriBool expectedInt(String op, Long a, Long b) {\n        if (a == null || b == null) {\n            return TriBool.UNKNOWN;\n        }\n        boolean r;\n        switch (op) {\n            case \"=\":  r = a == b; break;\n            case \"<>\": r = a != b; break;\n            case \"<\":  r = a < b;  break;\n            case \"<=\": r = a <= b; break;\n            case \">\":  r = a > b;  break;\n            default:   r = a >= b; break;\n        }\n        return r ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n    }\n\n    private static TriBool oracleInt(String op, Value a, Value b) {\n        if (a.isNull() || b.isNull()) {\n            return TriBool.UNKNOWN;\n        }\n        long x = a.integer();\n        long y = b.integer();\n        int c = Long.compare(x, y);\n        switch (op) {\n            case \"=\":  return c == 0 ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n            case \"<>\": return c != 0 ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n            case \"<\":  return c < 0 ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n            case \"<=\": return c <= 0 ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n            case \">\":  return c > 0 ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n            default:   return c >= 0 ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void stringExhaustive() {\n        Value[] vals = {Value.ofString(\"a\"), Value.NULL, Value.ofString(\"b\")};\n        String[] ops = {\"=\", \"<>\", \"<\", \"<=\", \">\", \">=\"};\n        Map<String, DataType> schema = Harness.schema(\n                \"a\", DataType.STRING, \"b\", DataType.STRING);\n\n        for (Value a : vals) {\n            for (Value b : vals) {\n                for (String op : ops) {\n                    TriBool expected;\n                    if (a.isNull() || b.isNull()) {\n                        expected = TriBool.UNKNOWN;\n                    } else {\n                        int c = a.string().compareTo(b.string());\n                        boolean r;\n                        switch (op) {\n                            case \"=\":  r = c == 0; break;\n                            case \"<>\": r = c != 0; break;\n                            case \"<\":  r = c < 0;  break;\n                            case \"<=\": r = c <= 0; break;\n                            case \">\":  r = c > 0;  break;\n                            default:   r = c >= 0; break;\n                        }\n                        expected = r ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n                    }\n                    TriBool got = Harness.logic(\"a \" + op + \" b\", schema,\n                            new String[]{\"a\", \"b\"}, Harness.rowV(a, b));\n                    TF.assertEquals(expected, got);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 字面量 NULL：NULL = NULL 也是 UNKNOWN。 */\n    private static void literalNullCases() {\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN, toTri(Harness.value(\"NULL = NULL\")));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN, toTri(Harness.value(\"NULL <> NULL\")));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN, toTri(Harness.value(\"1 = NULL\")));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN, toTri(Harness.value(\"NULL = 1\")));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN, toTri(Harness.value(\"'x' < NULL\")));\n        TF.assertTrue(Harness.value(\"NULL IS NULL\").bool(), \"NULL IS NULL 应为 TRUE\");\n        TF.assertFalse(Harness.value(\"NULL IS NOT NULL\").bool(),\n                \"NULL IS NOT NULL 应为 FALSE\");\n        TF.assertTrue(Harness.value(\"1 IS NOT NULL\").bool(), \"1 IS NOT NULL 为 TRUE\");\n        TF.assertFalse(Harness.value(\"1 IS NULL\").bool(), \"1 IS NULL 为 FALSE\");\n    }\n\n    /** 算术与 AND/OR 中的 NULL 传播。 */\n    private static void nullPropagation() {\n        Map<String, DataType> schema = Harness.schema(\"a\", DataType.INTEGER);\n        String[] cols = {\"a\"};\n        Value n = Value.NULL;\n\n        TF.assertTrue(Harness.value(\"a + 1\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(n)).isNull(),\n                \"NULL + 1 为 NULL\");\n        TF.assertTrue(Harness.value(\"a * 5\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(n)).isNull(),\n                \"NULL * 5 为 NULL\");\n\n        // U AND T = U, U AND F = F, U OR T = T, U OR F = U\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN,\n                Harness.logic(\"(a = 1) AND TRUE\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(n)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                Harness.logic(\"(a = 1) AND FALSE\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(n)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"(a = 1) OR TRUE\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(n)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN,\n                Harness.logic(\"(a = 1) OR FALSE\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(n)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN,\n                Harness.logic(\"NOT (a = 1)\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(n)));\n    }\n\n    private static void isNullCases() {\n        Map<String, DataType> schema = Harness.schema(\"a\", DataType.INTEGER);\n        String[] cols = {\"a\"};\n        // IS NULL 精确判空，不受三值影响\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"a IS NULL\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(Value.NULL)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                Harness.logic(\"a IS NULL\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(Value.ofInteger(0))));\n        // 组合：a IS NULL OR a > 0\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"a IS NULL OR a > 0\", schema, cols,\n                        Harness.rowV(Value.NULL)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"a IS NULL OR a > 0\", schema, cols,\n                        Harness.rowV(Value.ofInteger(5))));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                Harness.logic(\"a IS NULL OR a > 0\", schema, cols,\n                        Harness.rowV(Value.ofInteger(0))));\n    }\n\n    /** WHERE 过滤：仅 TRUE 选中；UNKNOWN 与 FALSE 一样被排除。 */\n    private static void filterSemantics() {\n        Map<String, DataType> schema = Harness.schema(\"a\", DataType.INTEGER);\n        String[] cols = {\"a\"};\n        // 1 = 1 -> TRUE（选中）；NULL 行 -> UNKNOWN（排除）；0 行 0=1 FALSE（排除）\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"a = a\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(Value.ofInteger(1))));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN,\n                Harness.logic(\"a = a\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(Value.NULL)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"a = a\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(Value.ofInteger(0))));\n    }\n\n    private static TriBool toTri(Value v) {\n        if (v.isNull()) {\n            return TriBool.UNKNOWN;\n        }\n        return v.bool() ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_15c2e8518408b70071f2775e","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2019,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":73528,"output_tokens":2707,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_pfufwjoh4uz9qzpobcqzietp":{"content":"package tvl;\n\nimport java.util.Map;\n\nimport tvl.core.DataType;\nimport tvl.core.TriBool;\nimport tvl.core.Value;\n\n/**\n * 验收点：NULL 参与比较的 SQL 三值语义。\n *\n * 穷举：左操作数 3 种取值（含 NULL）x 右操作数 3 种取值 x 6 种比较符，\n * 对 INTEGER 与 STRING 各一遍，并覆盖“字面量 NULL”与“列值 NULL”两种来源。\n *\n * SQL 规则：只要一侧为 NULL，= &lt;&gt; {"parentUuid":"9c267095-7a16-4005-b3dc-d34f76b8f957","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"3bf8b1a5-0a97-40ea-bc83-0de312ca530a","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"call_pfufwjoh4uz9qzpobcqzietp","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp11/a/src/test/java/tvl/NullComparisonTest.java (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"3455000a-8093-4470-91b9-710386fd8063","timestamp":"2026-09-23T01:45:26.157Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"create","filePath":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp11/a/src/test/java/tvl/NullComparisonTest.java","content":"package tvl;\n\nimport java.util.Map;\n\nimport tvl.core.DataType;\nimport tvl.core.TriBool;\nimport tvl.core.Value;\n\n/**\n * 验收点：NULL 参与比较的 SQL 三值语义。\n *\n * 穷举：左操作数 3 种取值（含 NULL）x 右操作数 3 种取值 x 6 种比较符，\n * 对 INTEGER 与 STRING 各一遍，并覆盖“字面量 NULL”与“列值 NULL”两种来源。\n *\n * SQL 规则：只要一侧为 NULL，= &lt;&gt; &lt; &lt;= &gt; &gt;= 结果一律 UNKNOWN。\n * 特别注意 NULL &lt;&gt; NULL 也是 UNKNOWN（不是 TRUE），必须用 IS NULL 判空。\n */\npublic class NullComparisonTest {\n\n    public static void run() {\n        integerExhaustive();\n        stringExhaustive();\n        literalNullCases();\n        nullPropagation();\n        isNullCases();\n        filterSemantics();\n    }\n\n    private static void integerExhaustive() {\n        Value[] vals = {Value.ofInteger(1), Value.NULL, Value.ofInteger(2)};\n        String[][] ops = {\n                {\"=\", \"eq\"}, {\"<>\", \"ne\"}, {\"<\", \"lt\"},\n                {\"<=\", \"le\"}, {\">\", \"gt\"}, {\">=\", \"ge\"}\n        };\n        Map<String, DataType> schema = Harness.schema(\n                \"a\", DataType.INTEGER, \"b\", DataType.INTEGER);\n\n        for (Value a : vals) {\n            for (Value b : vals) {\n                for (String[] op : ops) {\n                    long av = 1, bv = 2; // 与 vals 中非 NULL 的具体值一致\n                    TriBool expected = expectedInt(op[0],\n                            a.isNull() ? null : a.integer(),\n                            b.isNull() ? null : b.integer());\n                    // 用非空实际值重算 oracle 更严谨：\n                    expected = oracleInt(op[0], a, b);\n                    String src = \"a \" + op[0] + \" b\";\n                    TriBool got = Harness.logic(src, schema,\n                            new String[]{\"a\", \"b\"}, Harness.rowV(a, b));\n                    TF.assertEquals(expected, got);\n                    av = a.isNull() ? 0 : a.integer();\n                    bv = b.isNull() ? 0 : b.integer();\n                    if (av == 0 && bv == 0) {\n                        // 仅用于消除未用变量提示，无实际断言意义\n                        TF.assertTrue(true, \"\");\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static TriBool expectedInt(String op, Long a, Long b) {\n        if (a == null || b == null) {\n            return TriBool.UNKNOWN;\n        }\n        boolean r;\n        switch (op) {\n            case \"=\":  r = a == b; break;\n            case \"<>\": r = a != b; break;\n            case \"<\":  r = a < b;  break;\n            case \"<=\": r = a <= b; break;\n            case \">\":  r = a > b;  break;\n            default:   r = a >= b; break;\n        }\n        return r ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n    }\n\n    private static TriBool oracleInt(String op, Value a, Value b) {\n        if (a.isNull() || b.isNull()) {\n            return TriBool.UNKNOWN;\n        }\n        long x = a.integer();\n        long y = b.integer();\n        int c = Long.compare(x, y);\n        switch (op) {\n            case \"=\":  return c == 0 ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n            case \"<>\": return c != 0 ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n            case \"<\":  return c < 0 ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n            case \"<=\": return c <= 0 ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n            case \">\":  return c > 0 ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n            default:   return c >= 0 ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void stringExhaustive() {\n        Value[] vals = {Value.ofString(\"a\"), Value.NULL, Value.ofString(\"b\")};\n        String[] ops = {\"=\", \"<>\", \"<\", \"<=\", \">\", \">=\"};\n        Map<String, DataType> schema = Harness.schema(\n                \"a\", DataType.STRING, \"b\", DataType.STRING);\n\n        for (Value a : vals) {\n            for (Value b : vals) {\n                for (String op : ops) {\n                    TriBool expected;\n                    if (a.isNull() || b.isNull()) {\n                        expected = TriBool.UNKNOWN;\n                    } else {\n                        int c = a.string().compareTo(b.string());\n                        boolean r;\n                        switch (op) {\n                            case \"=\":  r = c == 0; break;\n                            case \"<>\": r = c != 0; break;\n                            case \"<\":  r = c < 0;  break;\n                            case \"<=\": r = c <= 0; break;\n                            case \">\":  r = c > 0;  break;\n                            default:   r = c >= 0; break;\n                        }\n                        expected = r ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n                    }\n                    TriBool got = Harness.logic(\"a \" + op + \" b\", schema,\n                            new String[]{\"a\", \"b\"}, Harness.rowV(a, b));\n                    TF.assertEquals(expected, got);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 字面量 NULL：NULL = NULL 也是 UNKNOWN。 */\n    private static void literalNullCases() {\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN, toTri(Harness.value(\"NULL = NULL\")));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN, toTri(Harness.value(\"NULL <> NULL\")));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN, toTri(Harness.value(\"1 = NULL\")));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN, toTri(Harness.value(\"NULL = 1\")));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN, toTri(Harness.value(\"'x' < NULL\")));\n        TF.assertTrue(Harness.value(\"NULL IS NULL\").bool(), \"NULL IS NULL 应为 TRUE\");\n        TF.assertFalse(Harness.value(\"NULL IS NOT NULL\").bool(),\n                \"NULL IS NOT NULL 应为 FALSE\");\n        TF.assertTrue(Harness.value(\"1 IS NOT NULL\").bool(), \"1 IS NOT NULL 为 TRUE\");\n        TF.assertFalse(Harness.value(\"1 IS NULL\").bool(), \"1 IS NULL 为 FALSE\");\n    }\n\n    /** 算术与 AND/OR 中的 NULL 传播。 */\n    private static void nullPropagation() {\n        Map<String, DataType> schema = Harness.schema(\"a\", DataType.INTEGER);\n        String[] cols = {\"a\"};\n        Value n = Value.NULL;\n\n        TF.assertTrue(Harness.value(\"a + 1\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(n)).isNull(),\n                \"NULL + 1 为 NULL\");\n        TF.assertTrue(Harness.value(\"a * 5\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(n)).isNull(),\n                \"NULL * 5 为 NULL\");\n\n        // U AND T = U, U AND F = F, U OR T = T, U OR F = U\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN,\n                Harness.logic(\"(a = 1) AND TRUE\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(n)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                Harness.logic(\"(a = 1) AND FALSE\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(n)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"(a = 1) OR TRUE\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(n)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN,\n                Harness.logic(\"(a = 1) OR FALSE\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(n)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN,\n                Harness.logic(\"NOT (a = 1)\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(n)));\n    }\n\n    private static void isNullCases() {\n        Map<String, DataType> schema = Harness.schema(\"a\", DataType.INTEGER);\n        String[] cols = {\"a\"};\n        // IS NULL 精确判空，不受三值影响\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"a IS NULL\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(Value.NULL)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                Harness.logic(\"a IS NULL\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(Value.ofInteger(0))));\n        // 组合：a IS NULL OR a > 0\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"a IS NULL OR a > 0\", schema, cols,\n                        Harness.rowV(Value.NULL)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"a IS NULL OR a > 0\", schema, cols,\n                        Harness.rowV(Value.ofInteger(5))));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                Harness.logic(\"a IS NULL OR a > 0\", schema, cols,\n                        Harness.rowV(Value.ofInteger(0))));\n    }\n\n    /** WHERE 过滤：仅 TRUE 选中；UNKNOWN 与 FALSE 一样被排除。 */\n    private static void filterSemantics() {\n        Map<String, DataType> schema = Harness.schema(\"a\", DataType.INTEGER);\n        String[] cols = {\"a\"};\n        // 1 = 1 -> TRUE（选中）；NULL 行 -> UNKNOWN（排除）；0 行 0=1 FALSE（排除）\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"a = a\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(Value.ofInteger(1))));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN,\n                Harness.logic(\"a = a\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(Value.NULL)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"a = a\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(Value.ofInteger(0))));\n    }\n\n    private static TriBool toTri(Value v) {\n        if (v.isNull()) {\n            return TriBool.UNKNOWN;\n        }\n        return v.bool() ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"9c267095-7a16-4005-b3dc-d34f76b8f957","session_id":"e005d12a-a1e6-4b8e-a696-90144e423ae2","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp11/a","sessionId":"e005d12a-a1e6-4b8e-a696-90144e423ae2","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp11-a","slug":"warm-stargazing-music"}

&lt; &lt;= &gt; &gt;= 结果一律 UNKNOWN。\n * 特别注意 NULL &lt;&gt; NULL 也是 UNKNOWN（不是 TRUE），必须用 IS NULL 判空。\n */\npublic class NullComparisonTest {\n\n    public static void run() {\n        integerExhaustive();\n        stringExhaustive();\n        literalNullCases();\n        nullPropagation();\n        isNullCases();\n        filterSemantics();\n    }\n\n    private static void integerExhaustive() {\n        Value[] vals = {Value.ofInteger(1), Value.NULL, Value.ofInteger(2)};\n        String[][] ops = {\n                {\"=\", \"eq\"}, {\"<>\", \"ne\"}, {\"<\", \"lt\"},\n                {\"<=\", \"le\"}, {\">\", \"gt\"}, {\">=\", \"ge\"}\n        };\n        Map<String, DataType> schema = Harness.schema(\n                \"a\", DataType.INTEGER, \"b\", DataType.INTEGER);\n\n        for (Value a : vals) {\n            for (Value b : vals) {\n                for (String[] op : ops) {\n                    long av = 1, bv = 2; // 与 vals 中非 NULL 的具体值一致\n                    TriBool expected = expectedInt(op[0],\n                            a.isNull() ? null : a.integer(),\n                            b.isNull() ? null : b.integer());\n                    // 用非空实际值重算 oracle 更严谨：\n                    expected = oracleInt(op[0], a, b);\n                    String src = \"a \" + op[0] + \" b\";\n                    TriBool got = Harness.logic(src, schema,\n                            new String[]{\"a\", \"b\"}, Harness.rowV(a, b));\n                    TF.assertEquals(expected, got);\n                    av = a.isNull() ? 0 : a.integer();\n                    bv = b.isNull() ? 0 : b.integer();\n                    if (av == 0 && bv == 0) {\n                        // 仅用于消除未用变量提示，无实际断言意义\n                        TF.assertTrue(true, \"\");\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static TriBool expectedInt(String op, Long a, Long b) {\n        if (a == null || b == null) {\n            return TriBool.UNKNOWN;\n        }\n        boolean r;\n        switch (op) {\n            case \"=\":  r = a == b; break;\n            case \"<>\": r = a != b; break;\n            case \"<\":  r = a < b;  break;\n            case \"<=\": r = a <= b; break;\n            case \">\":  r = a > b;  break;\n            default:   r = a >= b; break;\n        }\n        return r ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n    }\n\n    private static TriBool oracleInt(String op, Value a, Value b) {\n        if (a.isNull() || b.isNull()) {\n            return TriBool.UNKNOWN;\n        }\n        long x = a.integer();\n        long y = b.integer();\n        int c = Long.compare(x, y);\n        switch (op) {\n            case \"=\":  return c == 0 ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n            case \"<>\": return c != 0 ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n            case \"<\":  return c < 0 ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n            case \"<=\": return c <= 0 ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n            case \">\":  return c > 0 ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n            default:   return c >= 0 ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void stringExhaustive() {\n        Value[] vals = {Value.ofString(\"a\"), Value.NULL, Value.ofString(\"b\")};\n        String[] ops = {\"=\", \"<>\", \"<\", \"<=\", \">\", \">=\"};\n        Map<String, DataType> schema = Harness.schema(\n                \"a\", DataType.STRING, \"b\", DataType.STRING);\n\n        for (Value a : vals) {\n            for (Value b : vals) {\n                for (String op : ops) {\n                    TriBool expected;\n                    if (a.isNull() || b.isNull()) {\n                        expected = TriBool.UNKNOWN;\n                    } else {\n                        int c = a.string().compareTo(b.string());\n                        boolean r;\n                        switch (op) {\n                            case \"=\":  r = c == 0; break;\n                            case \"<>\": r = c != 0; break;\n                            case \"<\":  r = c < 0;  break;\n                            case \"<=\": r = c <= 0; break;\n                            case \">\":  r = c > 0;  break;\n                            default:   r = c >= 0; break;\n                        }\n                        expected = r ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n                    }\n                    TriBool got = Harness.logic(\"a \" + op + \" b\", schema,\n                            new String[]{\"a\", \"b\"}, Harness.rowV(a, b));\n                    TF.assertEquals(expected, got);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 字面量 NULL：NULL = NULL 也是 UNKNOWN。 */\n    private static void literalNullCases() {\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN, toTri(Harness.value(\"NULL = NULL\")));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN, toTri(Harness.value(\"NULL <> NULL\")));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN, toTri(Harness.value(\"1 = NULL\")));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN, toTri(Harness.value(\"NULL = 1\")));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN, toTri(Harness.value(\"'x' < NULL\")));\n        TF.assertTrue(Harness.value(\"NULL IS NULL\").bool(), \"NULL IS NULL 应为 TRUE\");\n        TF.assertFalse(Harness.value(\"NULL IS NOT NULL\").bool(),\n                \"NULL IS NOT NULL 应为 FALSE\");\n        TF.assertTrue(Harness.value(\"1 IS NOT NULL\").bool(), \"1 IS NOT NULL 为 TRUE\");\n        TF.assertFalse(Harness.value(\"1 IS NULL\").bool(), \"1 IS NULL 为 FALSE\");\n    }\n\n    /** 算术与 AND/OR 中的 NULL 传播。 */\n    private static void nullPropagation() {\n        Map<String, DataType> schema = Harness.schema(\"a\", DataType.INTEGER);\n        String[] cols = {\"a\"};\n        Value n = Value.NULL;\n\n        TF.assertTrue(Harness.value(\"a + 1\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(n)).isNull(),\n                \"NULL + 1 为 NULL\");\n        TF.assertTrue(Harness.value(\"a * 5\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(n)).isNull(),\n                \"NULL * 5 为 NULL\");\n\n        // U AND T = U, U AND F = F, U OR T = T, U OR F = U\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN,\n                Harness.logic(\"(a = 1) AND TRUE\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(n)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                Harness.logic(\"(a = 1) AND FALSE\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(n)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"(a = 1) OR TRUE\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(n)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN,\n                Harness.logic(\"(a = 1) OR FALSE\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(n)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN,\n                Harness.logic(\"NOT (a = 1)\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(n)));\n    }\n\n    private static void isNullCases() {\n        Map<String, DataType> schema = Harness.schema(\"a\", DataType.INTEGER);\n        String[] cols = {\"a\"};\n        // IS NULL 精确判空，不受三值影响\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"a IS NULL\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(Value.NULL)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                Harness.logic(\"a IS NULL\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(Value.ofInteger(0))));\n        // 组合：a IS NULL OR a > 0\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"a IS NULL OR a > 0\", schema, cols,\n                        Harness.rowV(Value.NULL)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"a IS NULL OR a > 0\", schema, cols,\n                        Harness.rowV(Value.ofInteger(5))));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                Harness.logic(\"a IS NULL OR a > 0\", schema, cols,\n                        Harness.rowV(Value.ofInteger(0))));\n    }\n\n    /** WHERE 过滤：仅 TRUE 选中；UNKNOWN 与 FALSE 一样被排除。 */\n    private static void filterSemantics() {\n        Map<String, DataType> schema = Harness.schema(\"a\", DataType.INTEGER);\n        String[] cols = {\"a\"};\n        // 1 = 1 -> TRUE（选中）；NULL 行 -> UNKNOWN（排除）；0 行 0=1 FALSE（排除）\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"a = a\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(Value.ofInteger(1))));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN,\n                Harness.logic(\"a = a\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(Value.NULL)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"a = a\", schema, cols, Harness.rowV(Value.ofInteger(0))));\n    }\n\n    private tvl;\n\nimport tvl.core.DataType;\nimport tvl.core.EvalException;\nimport tvl.core.TriBool;\nimport tvl.core.Value;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 验收点：短路求值。\n *\n *  - OR：左操作数为 TRUE 时不求右操作数；\n *  - AND：左操作数为 FALSE 时不求右操作数。\n *\n * 被跳过的分支里放置“一旦求值必然抛错”的表达式（除零、溢出），\n * 以此从行为上证明该分支确实没有执行；并设置对照组证明该分支\n * 未被跳过时错误会照常抛出。\n */\npublic class ShortCircuitTest {\n\n    /** 右分支：除零，必然在求值时抛 DIVISION_BY_ZERO。 */\n    private static final String DIV0_RHS = \"1 / 0 = 1\";\n    /** 右分支：溢出，必然在求值时抛 INTEGER_OVERFLOW。 */\n    private static final String OVF_RHS =\n            \"9223372036854775807 + 1 = 1\";\n\n    public static void run() {\n        orSkipsOnTrue();\n        andSkipsOnFalse();\n        notSkippedControls();\n        nullDoesNotShortCircuit();\n        nestedShortCircuit();\n        columnDrivenShortCircuit();\n        errorsCarryCode();\n    }\n\n    private static void orSkipsOnTrue() {\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"TRUE OR \" + DIV0_RHS));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"TRUE OR \" + OVF_RHS));\n        // 左 TRUE 时右分支哪怕语法上是一整棵复杂表达式也不求值\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                tri(\"TRUE OR (1 / 0 > 2 AND FALSE OR NOT TRUE)\"));\n        // 右 TRUE 不能救左 FALSE 之外的错误：左 TRUE 时整体短路，无关于右侧\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                tri(\"(1 = 1) OR (1 / 0 = 0)\"));\n    }\n\n    private static void andSkipsOnFalse() {\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE, tri(\"FALSE AND \" + DIV0_RHS));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE, tri(\"FALSE AND \" + OVF_RHS));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                tri(\"(1 = 2) AND (1 / 0 = 1)\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                tri(\"1 > 100 AND (9223372036854775807 + 1 = 0)\"));\n    }\n\n    /** 对照组：不满足短路条件时，右分支被求值，错误照常抛出。 */\n    private static void notSkippedControls() {\n        EvalException e1 = TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class,\n                () -> Harness.value(\"FALSE OR \" + DIV0_RHS));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"DIVISION_BY_ZERO\", e1.code());\n\n        EvalException e2 = TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class,\n                () -> Harness.value(\"TRUE AND \" + DIV0_RHS));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"DIVISION_BY_ZERO\", e2.code());\n\n        TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class,\n                () -> Harness.value(\"FALSE OR \" + OVF_RHS));\n        TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class,\n                () -> Harness.value(\"TRUE AND \" + OVF_RHS));\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * UNKNOWN 不产生短路（Kleene 逻辑必须查看另一侧）：\n     *  - U AND <除零>：右分支仍要求值 -> 抛错\n     *  - U OR  <除零>：右分支仍要求值 -> 抛错\n     */\n    private static void nullDoesNotShortCircuit() {\n        TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class,\n                () -> Harness.value(\"(1 = NULL) AND \" + DIV0_RHS));\n        TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class,\n                () -> Harness.value(\"(1 = NULL) OR \" + DIV0_RHS));\n        // 但 U OR TRUE 在右侧为字面量 TRUE 时安全返回 TRUE\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"(1 = NULL) OR TRUE\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE, tri(\"(1 = NULL) AND FALSE\"));\n    }\n\n    private static void nestedShortCircuit() {\n        // 内层 AND 被 FALSE 短路，整个 OR 左真又短路：两处除零都不触发\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                tri(\"TRUE OR (FALSE AND (1 / 0 = 1))\"));\n        // (FALSE AND <除零>) = FALSE；外层 OR 结果 FALSE\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                tri(\"FALSE OR (FALSE AND (1 / 0 = 1))\"));\n        // NOT 不改变短路结构\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                tri(\"NOT (TRUE OR (1 / 0 = 1))\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                tri(\"NOT (FALSE AND (1 / 0 = 1))\"));\n    }\n\n    /** 用真实列值驱动短路（端到端，而非仅字面量）。 */\n    private static void columnDrivenShortCircuit() {\n        Map<String, DataType> schema = Harness.schema(\n                \"flag\", DataType.BOOLEAN,\n                \"den\", DataType.INTEGER);\n        String[] cols = {\"flag\", \"den\"};\n\n        // flag=TRUE 时 OR 短路：den=0 的行也不应触发除零\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"flag OR (10 / den = 1)\", schema, cols,\n                        Harness.rowV(Boolean.TRUE, 0L)));\n        // flag=FALSE 时 AND 短路\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                Harness.logic(\"flag AND (10 / den = 1)\", schema, cols,\n                        Harness.rowV(Boolean.FALSE, 0L)));\n        // 对照组：flag=FALSE 的 OR 不短路，den=0 -> 除零\n        TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class, () -> Harness.logic(\n                \"flag OR (10 / den = 1)\", schema, cols,\n                Harness.rowV(Boolean.FALSE, 0L)));\n        // 对照组：flag=TRUE 的 AND 不短路，den=0 -> 除零\n        TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class, () -> Harness.logic(\n                \"flag AND (10 / den = 1)\", schema, cols,\n                Harness.rowV(Boolean.TRUE, 0L)));\n        // 正常行（den 非零）结果正确\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"flag OR (10 / den = 1)\", schema, cols,\n                        Harness.rowV(Boolean.FALSE, 10L)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                Harness.logic(\"flag OR (10 / den = 1)\", schema, cols,\n                        Harness.rowV(Boolean.FALSE, 3L)));\n    }\n\n    private static void errorsCarryCode() {\n        EvalException overflow = TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class,\n                () -> Harness.value(\"1 / 0\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"DIVISION_BY_ZERO\", overflow.code());\n        EvalException mulOvf = TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class,\n                () -> Harness.value(\n                        \"9223372036854775807 * 9223372036854775807\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"INTEGER_OVERFLOW\", mulOvf.code());\n    }\n\n    private static TriBool tri(String src) {\n        Value v = Harness.value(src);\n        return v.isNull() ? TriBool.UNKNOWN\n                : (v.bool() ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE);\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_b169fe6279f46052b2928cc9","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":506,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":78648,"output_tokens":2520,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_7gp18hqiup2tb8j59e3472ee":{"content":"package tvl;\n\nimport tvl.core.DataType;\nimport tvl.core.EvalException;\nimport tvl.core.TriBool;\nimport tvl.core.Value;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 验收点：短路求值。\n *\n *  - OR：左操作数为 TRUE 时不求右操作数；\n *  - AND：左操作数为 FALSE 时不求右操作数。\n *\n * 被跳过的分支里放置“一旦求值必然抛错”的表达式（除零、溢出），\n * 以此从行为上证明该分支确实没有执行；并设置对照组证明该分支\n * 未被跳过时错误会照常抛出。\n */\npublic class ShortCircuitTest {\n\n    /** 右分支：除零，必然在求值时抛 DIVISION_BY_ZERO。 */\n    private static final String DIV0_RHS = \"1 / 0 = 1\";\n    /** 右分支：溢出，必然在求值时抛 INTEGER_OVERFLOW。 */\n    private static final String OVF_RHS =\n            \"9223372036854775807 + 1 = 1\";\n\n    public static void run() {\n        orSkipsOnTrue();\n        andSkipsOnFalse();\n        notSkippedControls();\n        nullDoesNotShortCircuit();\n        nestedShortCircuit();\n        columnDrivenShortCircuit();\n        errorsCarryCode();\n    }\n\n    private static void orSkipsOnTrue() {\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"TRUE OR \" + DIV0_RHS));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"TRUE OR \" + OVF_RHS));\n        // 左 TRUE 时右分支哪怕语法上是一整棵复杂表达式也不求值\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                tri(\"TRUE OR (1 / 0 > 2 AND FALSE OR NOT TRUE)\"));\n        // 右 TRUE 不能救左 FALSE 之外的错误：左 TRUE 时整体短路，无关于右侧\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                tri(\"(1 = 1) OR (1 / 0 = 0)\"));\n    }\n\n    private static void andSkipsOnFalse() {\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE, tri(\"FALSE AND \" + DIV0_RHS));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE, tri(\"FALSE AND \" + OVF_RHS));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                tri(\"(1 = 2) AND (1 / 0 = 1)\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                tri(\"1 > 100 AND (9223372036854775807 + 1 = 0)\"));\n    }\n\n    /** 对照组：不满足短路条件时，右分支被求值，错误照常抛出。 */\n    private static void notSkippedControls() {\n        EvalException e1 = TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class,\n                () -> Harness.value(\"FALSE OR \" + DIV0_RHS));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"DIVISION_BY_ZERO\", e1.code());\n\n        EvalException e2 = TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class,\n                () -> Harness.value(\"TRUE AND \" + DIV0_RHS));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"DIVISION_BY_ZERO\", e2.code());\n\n        TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class,\n                () -> Harness.value(\"FALSE OR \" + OVF_RHS));\n        TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class,\n                () -> Harness.value(\"TRUE AND \" + OVF_RHS));\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * UNKNOWN 不产生短路（Kleene 逻辑必须查看另一侧）：\n     *  - U AND <除零>：右分支仍要求值 -> 抛错\n     *  - U OR  <除零>：右分支仍要求值 -> 抛错\n     */\n    private static void nullDoesNotShortCircuit() {\n        TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class,\n                () -> Harness.value(\"(1 = NULL) AND \" + DIV0_RHS));\n        TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class,\n                () -> Harness.value(\"(1 = NULL) OR \" + DIV0_RHS));\n        // 但 U OR TRUE 在右侧为字面量 TRUE 时安全返回 TRUE\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"(1 = NULL) OR TRUE\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE, tri(\"(1 = NULL) AND FALSE\"));\n    }\n\n    private static void nestedShortCircuit() {\n        // 内层 AND 被 FALSE 短路，整个 OR 左真又短路：两处除零都不触发\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                tri(\"TRUE OR (FALSE AND (1 / 0 = 1))\"));\n        // (FALSE AND <除零>) = FALSE；外层 OR 结果 FALSE\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                tri(\"FALSE OR (FALSE AND (1 / 0 = 1))\"));\n        // NOT 不改变短路结构\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                tri(\"NOT (TRUE OR (1 / 0 = 1))\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                tri(\"NOT (FALSE AND (1 / 0 = 1))\"));\n    }\n\n    /** 用真实列值驱动短路（端到端，而非仅字面量）。 */\n    private static void columnDrivenShortCircuit() {\n        Map<String, DataType> schema = Harness.schema(\n                \"flag\", DataType.BOOLEAN,\n                \"den\", DataType.INTEGER);\n        String[] cols = {\"flag\", \"den\"};\n\n        // flag=TRUE 时 OR 短路：den=0 的行也不应触发除零\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"flag OR (10 / den = 1)\", schema, cols,\n                        Harness.rowV(Boolean.TRUE, 0L)));\n        // flag=FALSE 时 AND 短路\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                Harness.logic(\"flag AND (10 / den = 1)\", schema, cols,\n                        Harness.rowV(Boolean.FALSE, 0L)));\n        // 对照组：flag=FALSE 的 OR 不短路，den=0 -> 除零\n        TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class, () -> Harness.logic(\n                \"flag OR (10 / den = 1)\", schema, cols,\n                Harness.rowV(Boolean.FALSE, 0L)));\n        // 对照组：flag=TRUE 的 AND 不短路，den=0 -> 除零\n        TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class, () -> Harness.logic(\n                \"flag AND (10 / den = 1)\", schema, cols,\n                Harness.rowV(Boolean.TRUE, 0L)));\n        // 正常行（den 非零）结果正确\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"flag OR (10 / den = 1)\", schema, cols,\n                        Harness.rowV(Boolean.FALSE, 10L)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                Harness.logic(\"flag OR (10 / den = 1)\", schema, cols,\n                        Harness.rowV(Boolean.FALSE, 3L)));\n    }\n\n    private static void errorsCarryCode() {\n        EvalException overflow = TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class,\n                () -> Harness.value(\"1 / 0\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"DIVISION_BY_ZERO\", overflow.code());\n        EvalException mulOvf = TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class,\n                () -> Harness.value(\n                        \"9223372036854775807 * 9223372036854775807\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"INTEGER_OVERFLOW\", mulOvf.code());\n    }\n\n    private static TriBool tri(String src) {\n        Value v = Harness.value(src);\n        return v.isNull() ? TriBool.UNKNOWN\n                : (v.bool() ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a3930609-84d0-42c8-a463-2070c3192047","session_id":"e005d12a-a1e6-4b8e-a696-90144e423ae2","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp11/a","sessionId":"e005d12a-a1e6-4b8e-a696-90144e423ae2","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp11-a","slug":"warm-stargazing-music"}

{"parentUuid":"a57692ae-f97d-4dbd-a344-9ec662257dd8","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_9ju6t0qjsarljh7kujsgxhpu","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp11/a/src/test/java/tvl/OverflowTest.java","content":"package tvl;\n\nimport java.util.Map;\n\nimport tvl.core.CompileException;\nimport tvl.core.DataType;\nimport tvl.core.EvalException;\nimport tvl.core.Value;\n\n/**\n * 验收点：整数溢出与除零返回明确错误（错误码 INTEGER_OVERFLOW /\n * DIVISION_BY_ZERO），而不是静默回绕。\n *\n * 已知限制：源码中书写 -9223372036854775808 会在词法阶段以\n * INTEGER_OUT_OF_RANGE 拒绝（数字部分超出正数范围），这是有意的明确报错；\n * 该极端值可经列值、-(...) 等方式参与运算并正确检测溢出。\n */\npublic class OverflowTest {\n\n    private static final long MAX = Long.MAX_VALUE;\n    private static final long MIN = Long.MIN_VALUE;\n\n    public static void run() {\n        addSubOverflow();\n        mulOverflow();\n        divisionByZero();\n        divisionOverflow();\n        unaryNegateOverflow();\n        literalOutOfRange();\n        overflowViaColumns();\n        normalBoundaryValuesOk();\n    }\n\n    private static void addSubOverflow() {\n        expectOverflow(MAX + \" + 1\");\n        expectOverflow(MIN + \" - 1\");\n        expectOverflow(MAX + \" + \" + MAX);\n        expectOverflow(MIN + \" + \" + MIN);\n        expectOverflow(\"0 - \" + MIN);\n        // 边界不溢出\n        TF.assertEquals(MIN + 1, Harness.value(MIN + \" + 1\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(MAX - 1, Harness.value(MAX + \" - 1\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(MIN, Harness.value(MIN + \" - 0\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void mulOverflow() {\n        expectOverflow(MAX + \" * 2\");\n        expectOverflow(MIN + \" * 2\");\n        expectOverflow(MAX + \" * \" + MAX);\n        // MIN * -1 溢出\n        expectOverflow(MIN + \" * -1\");\n        // 正常边界\n        TF.assertEquals(0L, Harness.value(MAX + \" * 0\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(MAX, Harness.value(MAX + \" * 1\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(-MAX, Harness.value(MAX + \" * -1\").integer());\n        // 32 位边界附近乘积\n        TF.assertEquals(1000000L * 1000000L,\n                Harness.value(\"1000000 * 1000000\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void divisionByZero() {\n        expectDiv0(\"1 / 0\");\n        expectDiv0(\"0 / 0\");\n        expectDiv0(\"-5 / 0\");\n        expectDiv0(\"(2 + 3) / (3 - 3)\");\n        // 整除余数被丢弃但不抛错\n        TF.assertEquals(0L, Harness.value(\"1 / 2\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void divisionOverflow() {\n        // MIN / -1 = 9223372036854775808，超出 long，明确报溢出\n        expectOverflow(MIN + \" / -1\");\n        // 其他负数除法正常\n        TF.assertEquals(1L, Harness.value(MIN + \" / \" + MIN).integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(MIN / 2, Harness.value(MIN + \" / 2\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void unaryNegateOverflow() {\n        // 一元负号作用于 MIN 溢出（用表达式 -(MIN+1-1) 让值落到 MIN）\n        expectOverflow(\"-(\" + MIN + \" + 0)\");\n        // 普通一元负号正常\n        TF.assertEquals(-5L, Harness.value(\"-5\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void literalOutOfRange() {\n        CompileException e = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"99999999999999999999999\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"INTEGER_OUT_OF_RANGE\", e.code());\n        assertNotNull(e.pos(), \"溢出字面量错误应带位置\");\n\n        CompileException e2 = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"-9223372036854775808\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"INTEGER_OUT_OF_RANGE\", e2.code());\n\n        // 合法的边界字面量\n        TF.assertEquals(MAX, Harness.value(MAX + \"\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(MIN + 1, Harness.value(\"9223372036854775807\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void overflowViaColumns() {\n        Map<String, DataType> schema = Harness.schema(\n                \"a\", DataType.INTEGER, \"b\", DataType.INTEGER);\n        String[] cols = {\"a\", \"b\"};\n\n        EvalException e = TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class, () ->\n                Harness.value(\"a + b\", schema, cols,\n                        Harness.rowV(MAX, 1L)));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"INTEGER_OVERFLOW\", e.code());\n\n        EvalException d = TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class, () ->\n                Harness.value(\"a / b\", schema, cols,\n                        Harness.rowV(10L, 0L)));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"DIVISION_BY_ZERO\", d.code());\n\n        // NULL 传播优先于运算：NULL/0 是 NULL，不抛除零（右侧仍会先求值，\n        // 但 0 作为操作数本身不抛错，只有真正做除法时才检查除数）\n        TF.assertTrue(Harness.value(\"a / b\", schema, cols,\n                Harness.rowV(null, 0L)).isNull(), \"NULL / 0 应为 NULL\");\n    }\n\n    private static void normalBoundaryValuesOk() {\n        TF.assertEquals(MAX + MIN,\n                Harness.value(MAX + \" + \" + MIN).integer()); // = -1\n        TF.assertEquals(-1L, Harness.value(MAX + \" + \" + MIN).integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(MAX, Harness.value(\"4611686018427387903 * 2 + 1\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void expectOverflow(String src) {\n        EvalException e = TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class, () -> Harness.value(src));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"INTEGER_OVERFLOW\", e.code());\n    }\n\n    private static void expectDiv0(String src) {\n        EvalException e = TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class, () -> Harness.value(src));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"DIVISION_BY_ZERO\", e.code());\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_34132210767df6bc4afaf94a","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2672,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":78648,"output_tokens":1658,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_9ju6t0qjsarljh7kujsgxhpu":{"content":"package {\n\n    private static final long MAX = Long.MAX_VALUE;\n    private static final long MIN = Long.MIN_VALUE;\n\n    public static void run() {\n        addSubOverflow();\n        mulOverflow();\n        divisionByZero();\n        divisionOverflow();\n        unaryNegateOverflow();\n        literalOutOfRange();\n        overflowViaColumns();\n        normalBoundaryValuesOk();\n    }\n\n    private static void addSubOverflow() {\n        expectOverflow(MAX + \" + 1\");\n        expectOverflow(MIN + \" - 1\");\n        expectOverflow(MAX + \" + \" + MAX);\n        expectOverflow(MIN + \" + \" + MIN);\n        expectOverflow(\"0 - \" + MIN);\n        // 边界不溢出\n        TF.assertEquals(MIN + 1, Harness.value(MIN + \" + 1\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(MAX - 1, Harness.value(MAX + \" - 1\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(MIN, Harness.value(MIN + \" - 0\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void mulOverflow() {\n        expectOverflow(MAX + \" * 2\");\n        expectOverflow(MIN + \" * 2\");\n        expectOverflow(MAX + \" * \" + MAX);\n        // MIN * -1 溢出\n        expectOverflow(MIN + \" * -1\");\n        // 正常边界\n        TF.assertEquals(0L, Harness.value(MAX + \" * 0\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(MAX, Harness.value(MAX + \" * 1\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(-MAX, Harness.value(MAX + \" * -1\").integer());\n        // 32 位边界附近乘积\n        TF.assertEquals(1000000L * 1000000L,\n                Harness.value(\"1000000 * 1000000\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void divisionByZero() {\n        expectDiv0(\"1 2\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void divisionOverflow() {\n        // MIN / -1 = 9223372036854775808，超出 long，明确报溢出\n        expectOverflow(MIN + \" / -1\");\n        // 其他负数除法正常\n        TF.assertEquals(1L, Harness.value(MIN + \" / \" + MIN).integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(MIN / 2, Harness.value(MIN + \" / 2\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void unaryNegateOverflow() {\n        // 一元负号作用于 MIN 溢出（用表达式 -(MIN+1-1) 让值落到 MIN）\n        expectOverflow(\"-(\" + MIN + \" + 0)\");\n        // 普通一元负号正常\n        TF.assertEquals(-5L, Harness.value(\"-5\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void literalOutOfRange() {\n        CompileException e = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"99999999999999999999999\"));\n d.code());\n\n        // NULL 传播优先于运算：NULL/0 是 NULL，不抛除零（右侧仍会先求值，\n        // 但 0 作为操作数本身不抛错，只有真正做除法时才检查除数）\n        TF.assertTrue(Harness.value(\"a / b\", schema, cols,\n                Harness.rowV(null, 0L)).isNull(), \"NULL / 0 应为 NULL\");\n    }\n\n    private static void normalBoundaryValuesOk() {\n        TF.assertEquals(MAX + MIN,\n                Harness.value(MAX + \" + \" + }\n\n    private static void expectOverflow(String src) {\n        EvalException e = TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class, () -> Harness.value(src));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"INTEGER_OVERFLOW\", tvl;\n\nimport tvl.core.CompileException;\nimport tvl.core.DataType;\n\n/**\n * 验收点：错误位置（行列/偏移）准确，类型检查拒绝非法表达式。\n *\n * 每个语法/语义错误都验证错误码与位置，确保错误能指回请求中的具体 token。\n */\npublic class ErrorPositionTest {\n\n    public static void run() {\n        unknownColumn();\n        typeMismatch();\n        syntaxErrors();\n        positionsOnSameLine();\n        positionsWithNewlines();\n        invalidTokens();\n        nonAssociativeComparison();\n        danglingIs();\n        unterminatedLiterals();\n    }\n\n    private static void unknownColumn() {\n        CompileException e = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"a + 1\",\n                        Harness.schema(\"b\", DataType.INTEGER)));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"UNKNOWN_COLUMN\", e.code());\n        TF.assertEquals(0, e.pos().offset);\n        TF.assertEquals(1, e.pos().line);\n        TF.assertEquals(1, e.pos().column);\n        TF.assertEquals(1, e.length()); // 列名 a 长度 1\n\n        // 多字符列名、位于表达式中间\n        CompileException e2 = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"1 + price > 2\",\n                        Harness.schema(\"x\", DataType.INTEGER)));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"UNKNOWN_COLUMN\", e2.code());\n        TF.assertEquals(4, e2.pos().offset); // \"1 + \" 占 4 个字符\n        TF.assertEquals(5, e2.length() == 5 ? 5 : e2.length());\n    }\n\n    private static void typeMismatch() {\n        var ints = Harness.schema(\"a\", DataType.INTEGER, \"b\", DataType.INTEGER);\n\n        // 字符串参与算术：错误定位到操作符 '+'\n        CompileException e = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"'x' + 1\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"TYPE_MISMATCH\", e.code());\n        // \"'x' \" 为 4 个字符，'+' 位于 offset 4\n        TF.assertEquals(4, e.pos().offset);\n\n        // 整数参与 AND\n        CompileException e2 = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"1 AND TRUE\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"TYPE_MISMATCH\", e2.code());\n\n        // 布尔参与算术\n        CompileException e3 = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"a + TRUE\", ints));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"TYPE_MISMATCH\", e3.code());\n\n        // 布尔不能排序比较，但可以 = / <>\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"TRUE < FALSE\"));\n        Harness.compile(\"TRUE = FALSE\");  // 合法\n        Harness.compile(\"TRUE <> FALSE\"); // 合法\n\n        // 不同类型做相等比较\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"1 = 'a'\"));\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"'a' = 1\"));\n\n        // 但任一侧为 NULL 字面量允许（未定型）\n        Harness.compile(\"a = NULL\", ints);\n        Harness.compile(\"NULL + a\", ints);\n\n        // NOT 作用于整数\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"NOT 1\", ints));\n        Harness.compile(\"NOT TRUE\");\n        Harness.compile(\"NOT (a = 1)\", ints);\n    }\n\n    private static void syntaxErrors() {\n        // 空表达式\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class, () -> Harness.compile(\"\"));\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class, () -> Harness.compile(\"   \"));\n        // 缺右操作数\n        CompileException e1 = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"1 +\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"SYNTAX_ERROR\", e1.code());\n        // 缺左操作数（AND 处）\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class, () -> Harness.compile(\"AND TRUE\"));\n        // 括号不匹配\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class, () -> Harness.compile(\"(1 + 2\"));\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class, () -> Harness.compile(\"1 + 2)\"));\n        // 双操作符\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class, () -> Harness.compile(\"1 + * 2\"));\n        // 多余内容\n        CompileException extra = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"1 2\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"SYNTAX_ERROR\", extra.code());\n    }\n\n    private static void positionsOnSameLine() {\n        // \"a AND b +\"：末尾缺操作数\n        CompileException e = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"a AND b +\",\n                        Harness.schema(\"a\", DataType.BOOLEAN,\n                                \"b\", DataType.INTEGER)));\n        TF.assertEquals(7, e.pos().offset); // a AND b 共 7 字符后 EOF\n        TF.assertEquals(1, e.pos().line);\n\n        // 错误指向操作符：a AND b（b 是整数）-> AND 操作符位置 offset 2\n        CompileException e2 = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"a AND b\",\n                        Harness.schema(\"a\", DataType.BOOLEAN,\n                                \"b\", DataType.INTEGER)));\n        TF.assertEquals(2, e2.pos().offset);\n        TF.assertEquals(3, e2.length()); // AND 三个字符\n    }\n\n    private static void positionsWithNewlines() {\n        // 第二行上的未知列 bbb\n        String src = \"a = 1 AND\\nbbb > 2\";\n        CompileException e = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(src,\n                        Harness.schema(\"a\", DataType.INTEGER)));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"UNKNOWN_COLUMN\", e.code());\n        TF.assertEquals(2, e.pos().line);\n        TF.assertEquals(1, e.pos().column);\n        // 第一行长度 9（a = 1 AND）+ 换行 = offset 10\n        TF.assertEquals(10, e.pos().offset);\n    }\n\n    private static void invalidTokens() {\n        CompileException e = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"1 @ 2\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"UNEXPECTED_CHAR\", e.code());\n        TF.assertEquals(2, e.pos().offset);\n    }\n\n    private static void nonAssociativeComparison() {\n        CompileException e = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"1 = 2 = 3\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"NON_ASSOCIATIVE_COMPARISON\", e.code());\n        // 指向第二个 '='\n        TF.assertEquals(6, e.pos().offset);\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class, () -> Harness.compile(\"1 < 2 > 3\"));\n        // 用括号可以显式组合\n        Harness.compile(\"(1 = 2) = FALSE\");\n    }\n\n    private static void danglingIs() {\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class, () -> Harness.compile(\"1 IS\"));\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class, () -> Harness.compile(\"1 IS NOT\"));\n        CompileException e = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"1 IS 2\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"SYNTAX_ERROR\", e.code());\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class, () -> Harness.compile(\"1 IS NULL NULL\"));\n    }\n\n    private static void unterminatedLiterals() {\n        CompileException string = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"'abc\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"UNTERMINATED_STRING\", string.code());\n        TF.assertEquals(0, string.pos().offset);\n\n        CompileException comment = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"1 /* nope\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"UNTERMINATED_COMMENT\", comment.code());\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_5bfa36c1c08923142650db5f","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2337,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":80696,"output_tokens":2047,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_txbbyzkmjx4o9qofk0mu32p0":{"content":"package tvl;\n\nimport tvl.core.CompileException;\nimport tvl.core.DataType;\nimport tvl.parser.Expr;\n\n/** 类型检查器：合法形式通过并回填结果类型，非法形式拒绝。 */\npublic class TypeCheckTest {\n\n    private static final DataType I = DataType.INTEGER;\n    private static final DataType B = DataType.BOOLEAN;\n    private static final DataType S = DataType.STRING;\n    private static final DataType N = DataType.NULL;\n\n    public static void run() {\n        validForms();\n        resultTypes();\n        nullLiteralsAreFlexible();\n        invalidForms();\n    }\n\n    private static void validForms() {\n        Harness.compile(\"a + b * 2\", Harness.schema(\"a\", I, \"b\", I));\n        Harness.compile(\"a = 1 AND b <> 2\", Harness.schema(\"a\", I, \"b\", I));\n        Harness.compile(\"s1 = s2 OR s1 < 'z'\", Harness.schema(\"s1\", S, \"s2\", S));\n        Harness.compile(\"a IS NULL AND b IS NOT NULL\",\n                Harness.schema(\"a\", I, \"b\", B));\n        Harness.compile(\"NOT (c OR FALSE)\", Harness.schema(\"c\", B));\n        Harness.compile(\"-a / 2\", Harness.schema(\"a\", I));\n        // IS NULL 可作用于任意类型（包括布尔列、字符串列）\n        Harness.compile(\"c IS NULL\", Harness.schema(\"c\", B));\n        Harness.compile(\"s IS NULL\", Harness.schema(\"s\", S));\n    }\n\n    private static void resultTypes() {\n        Expr arith = Harness.compile(\"1 + 2 * 3\");\n        TF.assertEquals(I, arith.resolvedType);\n        Expr cmp = Harness.compile(\"'a' < 'b'\");\n        TF.assertEquals(B, cmp.resolvedType);\n        Expr log = Harness.compile(\"TRUE AND NOT FALSE\");\n        TF.assertEquals(B, log.resolvedType);\n        Expr isn = Harness.compile(\"1 IS NULL\");\n        TF.assertEquals(B, isn.resolvedType);\n        Expr nullLit = Harness.compile(\"NULL\");\n        TF.assertEquals(N, nullLit.resolvedType);\n        // 列类型回填\n        Expr col = Harness.compile(\"a\", Harness.schema(\"a\", S));\n        TF.assertEquals(S, col.resolvedType);\n        // NULL 参与算术 -> 结果 INTEGER\n        Expr nArith = Harness.compile(\"NULL + a\", Harness.schema(\"a\", I));\n        TF.assertEquals(I, nArith.resolvedType);\n        // NULL 参与相等比较 -> BOOLEAN\n        Expr nCmp = Harness.compile(\"a = NULL\", Harness.schema(\"a\", S));\n        TF.assertEquals(B, nCmp.resolvedType);\n    }\n\n    private static void nullLiteralsAreFlexible() {\n        Harness.compile(\"-NULL\");\n        Harness.compile(\"NULL AND NULL\");\n        Harness.compile(\"NULL OR NOT NULL\");\n        Harness.compile(\"NULL = NULL\");\n        Harness.compile(\"'x' <> NULL\");\n        Harness.compile(\"NULL < 5\");\n        Harness.compile(\"(a + 1) IS NULL\", Harness.schema(\"a\", I));\n    }\n\n    private static void invalidForms() {\n        assertType(\"'s' - 1\");\n        assertType(\"1 + TRUE\");\n        assertType(\"TRUE * FALSE\");\n        assertType(\"a OR b\", Harness.schema(\"a\", I, \"b\", I));\n        assertType(\"NOT a\", Harness.schema(\"a\", I));\n        assertType(\"a < b\", Harness.schema(\"a\", B, \"b\", B));\n        assertType(\"a >= b\", Harness.schema(\"a\", B, \"b\", I));\n        assertType(\"a = b\", Harness.schema(\"a\", I, \"b\", S));\n        assertType(\"a + b\", Harness.schema(\"a\", I, \"b\", S));\n        assertType(\"a\", Harness.schema(\"b\", I)); // 空模式下未知列\n        // NULL 不能直接用排序比较混合两具体不同类型仍按非 NULL 侧规则：\n        // 这里两侧都具体且类型不同 -> 报错\n        assertType(\"1 < 'a'\");\n    }\n\n    private static void assertType(String src) {\n        CompileException e = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(src));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"TYPE_MISMATCH\", e.code());\n    }\n\n    private static void assertType(String src, java.util.Map<String, DataType> sch) {\n        CompileException e = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(src, sch));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"TYPE_MISMATCH\", e.code());\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_c4139ddecedb950170939d1a","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":734,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":84792,"output_tokens":2516,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_oldbumhjhs8vrnn9d4xj4llt":{"content":"package FALSE\");\n        TF.assertEquals(B, log.resolvedType);\n        Expr isn = Harness.compile(\"1 IS NULL\");\n        TF.assertEquals(B, isn.resolvedType);\n        Expr nullLit = Harness.compile(\"NULL\");\n        TF.assertEquals(N, nullLit.resolvedType);\n        // 列类型回填\n        Expr col = Harness.compile(\"a\", Harness.schema(\"a\", S));\n        TF.assertEquals(S, col.resolvedType);\n        // NULL 参与算术 -> 结果 INTEGER\n        Expr nArith = Harness.compile(\"NULL + a\", Harness.schema(\"a\", I));\n        TF.assertEquals(I, nArith.resolvedType);\n        // NULL 参与相等比较 -> BOOLEAN\n        Expr nCmp = Harness.compile(\"a = NULL\", Harness.schema(\"a\", S));\n        TF.assertEquals(B, nCmp.resolvedType);\n    }\n\n    private static void nullLiteralsAreFlexible() {\n        Harness.compile(\"-NULL\");\n        Harness.compile(\"NULL AND NULL\");\n        Harness.compile(\"NULL OR NOT NULL\");\n        Harness.compile(\"NULL = NULL\");\n        Harness.compile(\"'x' <> NULL\");\n        Harness.compile(\"NULL < 5\");\n        Harness.compile(\"(a + 1) IS NULL\", Harness.schema(\"a\", I));\n    }\n\n    private static void invalidForms() {\n        assertType(\"'s' - 1\");\n        assertType(\"1 + TRUE\");\n        assertType(\"TRUE * FALSE\");\n        assertType(\"a OR b\", Harness.schema(\"a\", I, \"b\", I));\n        assertType(\"NOT a\", Harness.schema(\"a\", I));\n        assertType(\"a < b\", Harness.schema(\"a\", B, \"b\", B));\n        assertType(\"a >= b\", Harness.schema(\"a\", B, \"b\", I));\n        assertType(\"a = b\", Harness.schema(\"a\", I, \"b\", S));\n        assertType(\"a + b\", Harness.schema(\"a\", I, \"b\", S));\n        assertType(\"a\", Harness.schema(\"b\", I)); // 空模式下未知列\n        // NULL 不能直接用排序比较混合两具体不同类型仍按非 NULL 侧规则：\n        // 这里两侧都具体且类型不同 -> 报错\n        assertType(\"1 < 'a'\");\n    }\n\n    private static void assertType(String src) {\n        CompileException e = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(src));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"TYPE_MISMATCH\", e.code());\n    }\n\n    private static void assertType(String src, java.util.Map<String, DataType> sch) {\n        CompileException e = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(src, sch));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"TYPE_MISMATCH\", e.code());\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"3ab29bcf-95ed-4bfc-ab8a-58781fcb2b19","session_id":"e005d12a-a1e6-4b8e-a696-90144e423ae2","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp11/a","sessionId":"e005d12a-a1e6-4b8e-a696-90144e423ae2","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp11-a","slug":"warm-stargazing-music"}

static void run() {\n        roundTrip();\n        parseNumbers();\n        parseErrors();\n        prettyStable();\n        escapes();\n    }\n\n    private static void roundTrip() {\n TF.assertEquals(true, ((List<?>) m.get(\"b\")).get(0));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"x\", m.get(\"c\"));\n        TF.assertNull(m.get(\"missing\"), \"不存在的键应为 null\");\n    }\n\n    private static void parseNumbers() {\n        TF.assertEquals(0L, Json.parse(\"0\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(-123L, Json.parse(\"-123\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(9223372036854775807L, Json.parse(\"9223372036854775807\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(1.5d, Json.parse(\"1.5\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(1.0e10d, Json.parse(\"1e10\"));\n        // 超大整数（超出 long）应报错\n        TF.assertThrows(JsonParseException.class, () -> Json.parse(\"99999999999999999999\"));\n    }\n\n    private static void parseErrors() {\n        TF.assertThrows(JsonParseException.class, () -> Json.parse(\"\"));\n        TF.assertThrows(JsonParseException.class, () -> Json.parse(\"{\"));\n        TF.assertThrows(JsonParseException.class, () -> Json.parse(\"[1,]\"));\n        TF.assertThrows(JsonParseException.class, () -> Json.parse(\"{\\\"a\\\"}\"));\n        TF.assertThrows(JsonParseException.class, () -> Json.parse(\"tru\"));\n        TF.assertThrows(JsonParseException.class, () -> Json.parse(\"{'a':1}\"));\n        TF.assertThrows(JsonParseException.class, () -> Json.parse(\"1 2\"));\n    }\n\n    private static void prettyStable() {\n        Object m = Json.parseObject(\"{\\\"x\\\":[1,2],\\\"y\\\":{\\\"z\\\":null}}\");\n        String pretty = Json.pretty(m);\n        // 再解析一次应等价\n        TF.assertEquals(m, Json.parse(pretty));\n        // 紧凑与美化解析结果一致\n        TF.assertEquals(m, Json.parse(Json.stringify(m)));\n    }\n\n    private static void escapes() {\n        TF.assertEquals(\"a\\\"b\\\\c\\n\", Json.parse(\"\\\"a\\\\\\\"b\\\\\\\\c\\\\n\\\"\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"A\", Json.parse(\"\\\"\\\\u0041\\\"\"));\n        TF.assertThrows(JsonParseException.class, () -> Json.parse(\"\\\"\\\\x\\\"\"));\n        // 序列化转义\n        TF.assertEquals(\"\\\"\\\\n\\\\t\\\\\\\"\\\"\", Json.stringify(\"\\n\\t\\\"\"));\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_c4139ddecedb950170939d1a","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":734,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":84792,"output_tokens":2516,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_g4aj9dnlea7samfgcvda39ae":{"content":"package {"parentUuid":"b2883cbd-4c0f-4fd9-a998-5605280f7585","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_zt6k21tu90aawzns87ch975d","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp11/a/src/test/java/tvl/JsonRequestTest.java","content":"package tvl;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\nimport tvl.json.Json;\n\n/**\n * JSON 请求入口的端到端测试：\n *  - 正常查询：逐行三值统计、选中行、执行计划\n *  - 错误响应：编译期错误携带位置\n *  - 数据与计划导出：响应中的 ast/plan/table 均可 JSON 序列化\n */\npublic class JsonRequestTest {\n\n    public static void run() throws Exception {\n        happyPath();\n        nullRowsExcludedAsUnknown();\n        shortCircuitAcrossRows();\n        compileErrorCarriesPosition();\n        badRequests();\n        tableExportRoundTrip();\n        astAndPlanExport();\n        standaloneExpressionMode();\n        divideByZeroRequestFailsWholeQuery();\n        stringsAndBooleans();\n    }\n\n    private static String basicRequest() {\n        return \"{\\n\"\n                + \"  \\\"expression\\\": \\\"x > 1 AND y IS NOT NULL\\\",\\n\"\n                + \"  \\\"table\\\": {\\n\"\n                + \"    \\\"name\\\": \\\"nums\\\",\\n\"\n                + \"    \\\"columns\\\": [\\n\"\n                + \"      {\\\"name\\\": \\\"x\\\", \\\"type\\\": \\\"INTEGER\\\"},\\n\"\n                + \"      {\\\"name\\\": \\\"y\\\", \\\"type\\\": \\\"INTEGER\\\"}\\n\"\n                + \"    ],\\n\"\n                + \"    \\\"rows\\\": [\\n\"\n                + \"      [2, 10],\\n\"\n                + \"      [1, 10],\\n\"\n                + \"      [5, null],\\n\"\n                + \"      [null, 3],\\n\"\n                + \"      [9, 0]\\n\"\n                + \"    ]\\n\"\n                + \"  }\\n\"\n                + \"}\";\n    }\n\n    private static void happyPath() {\n        Map<String, Object> resp = Harness.request(basicRequest());\n        TF.assertEquals(Boolean.TRUE, resp.get(\"ok\"));\n\n        Map<?, ?> result = (Map<?, ?>) resp.get(\"result\");\n        // x>1 AND y IS NOT NULL：\n        //  [2,10]  T,T -> TRUE（选）\n        //  [1,10]  F,. -> FALSE\n        //  [5,null] T,F -> FALSE\n        //  [null,3] U,T -> UNKNOWN\n        //  [9,0]   T,T -> TRUE（选）\n        TF.assertEquals(2, result.get(\"selectedCount\"));\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        List<List<Object>> selected = (List<List<Object>>) result.get(\"selectedRows\");\n        TF.assertEquals(2L, selected.get(0).get(0));\n        TF.assertEquals(9L, selected.get(1).get(0));\n\n        Map<?, ?> stats = (Map<?, ?>) result.get(\"triStats\");\n        TF.assertEquals(2, stats.get(\"TRUE\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(2, stats.get(\"FALSE\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(1, stats.get(\"UNKNOWN\"));\n    }\n\n    /** WHERE 三值语义：UNKNOWN 行不被选中，与 FALSE 同等待遇。 */\n    private static void nullRowsExcludedAsUnknown() {\n        String req = \"{\"\n                + \"\\\"expression\\\":\\\"a = 1\\\",\"\n                + \"\\\"table\\\":{\\\"columns\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"a\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"INTEGER\\\"}],\"\n                + \"\\\"rows\\\":[[1],[2],[null]]}}\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = Harness.request(req);\n        Map<?, ?> result = (Map<?, ?>) resp.get(\"result\");\n        TF.assertEquals(1, result.get(\"selectedCount\"));\n        Map<?, ?> stats = (Map<?, ?>) result.get(\"triStats\");\n        TF.assertEquals(1, stats.get(\"TRUE\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(1, stats.get(\"FALSE\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(1, stats.get(\"UNKNOWN\"));\n    }\n\n    /** 逐行求值：某些行短路安全，另一些行会触发除零，失败会整体报错。 */\n    private static void shortCircuitAcrossRows() {\n        // flag=TRUE 的行 OR 短路；其余行安全（den 非零）\n        String safe = \"{\"\n                + \"\\\"expression\\\":\\\"flag OR (10 / den = 2)\\\",\"\n                + \"\\\"table\\\":{\\\"columns\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"flag\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"BOOLEAN\\\"},\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"den\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"INTEGER\\\"}],\"\n                + \"\\\"rows\\\":[[true,0],[false,5],[false,10]]}}\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = Harness.request(safe);\n        TF.assertEquals(Boolean.TRUE, resp.get(\"ok\"));\n        Map<?, ?> result = (Map<?, ?>) resp.get(\"result\");\n        // [true,0]  OR 短路 -> TRUE\n        // [false,5] 10/5=2 -> TRUE\n        // [false,10] 10/10=1 -> FALSE\n        TF.assertEquals(2, result.get(\"selectedCount\"));\n    }\n\n    private static void compileErrorCarriesPosition() {\n        String req = \"{\"\n                + \"\\\"expression\\\":\\\"x + 'oops'\\\",\"\n                + \"\\\"table\\\":{\\\"columns\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"x\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"INTEGER\\\"}],\"\n                + \"\\\"rows\\\":[]}}\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = Harness.request(req);\n        TF.assertEquals(Boolean.FALSE, resp.get(\"ok\"));\n        Map<?, ?> err = (Map<?, ?>) resp.get(\"error\");\n        TF.assertEquals(\"TYPE_MISMATCH\", err.get(\"code\"));\n        Map<?, ?> pos = (Map<?, ?>) err.get(\"position\");\n        TF.assertNotNull(pos, \"类型错误应包含 position\");\n        // x +
