tvl;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\nimport tvl.json.Json;\n\n/**\n * JSON 请求入口的端到端测试：\n *  - 正常查询：逐行三值统计、选中行、执行计划\n *  - 错误响应：编译期错误携带位置\n *  - 数据与计划导出：响应中的 ast/plan/table 均可 JSON 序列化\n */\npublic class JsonRequestTest {\n\n    public static void run() throws Exception {\n        happyPath();\n        nullRowsExcludedAsUnknown();\n        shortCircuitAcrossRows();\n        compileErrorCarriesPosition();\n        badRequests();\n        tableExportRoundTrip();\n        astAndPlanExport();\n        standaloneExpressionMode();\n        divideByZeroRequestFailsWholeQuery();\n        stringsAndBooleans();\n    }\n\n    private static String basicRequest() {\n        return \"{\\n\"\n                + \"  \\\"expression\\\": \\\"x > 1 AND y IS NOT NULL\\\",\\n\"\n                + \"  \\\"table\\\": {\\n\"\n                + \"    \\\"name\\\": \\\"nums\\\",\\n\"\n                + \"    \\\"columns\\\": [\\n\"\n                + \"      {\\\"name\\\": \\\"x\\\", \\\"type\\\": \\\"INTEGER\\\"},\\n\"\n                + \"      {\\\"name\\\": \\\"y\\\", \\\"type\\\": \\\"INTEGER\\\"}\\n\"\n                + \"    ],\\n\"\n                + \"    \\\"rows\\\": [\\n\"\n                + \"      [2, 10],\\n\"\n                + \"      [1, 10],\\n\"\n                + \"      [5, null],\\n\"\n                + \"      [null, 3],\\n\"\n                + \"      [9, 0]\\n\"\n                + \"    ]\\n\"\n                + \"  }\\n\"\n                + \"}\";\n    }\n\n    private static void happyPath() {\n        Map<String, Object> resp = Harness.request(basicRequest());\n        TF.assertEquals(Boolean.TRUE, resp.get(\"ok\"));\n\n        Map<?, ?> result = (Map<?, ?>) resp.get(\"result\");\n        // x>1 AND y IS NOT NULL：\n        //  [2,10]  T,T -> TRUE（选）\n        //  [1,10]  F,. -> FALSE\n        //  [5,null] T,F -> FALSE\n        //  [null,3] U,T -> UNKNOWN\n        //  [9,0]   T,T -> TRUE（选）\n        TF.assertEquals(2, result.get(\"selectedCount\"));\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        List<List<Object>> selected = (List<List<Object>>) result.get(\"selectedRows\");\n        TF.assertEquals(2L, selected.get(0).get(0));\n        TF.assertEquals(9L, selected.get(1).get(0));\n\n        Map<?, ?> stats = (Map<?, ?>) result.get(\"triStats\");\n        TF.assertEquals(2, stats.get(\"TRUE\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(2, stats.get(\"FALSE\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(1, stats.get(\"UNKNOWN\"));\n    }\n\n    /** WHERE 三值语义：UNKNOWN 行不被选中，与 FALSE 同等待遇。 */\n    private static void nullRowsExcludedAsUnknown() {\n        String req = \"{\"\n                + \"\\\"expression\\\":\\\"a = 1\\\",\"\n                + \"\\\"table\\\":{\\\"columns\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"a\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"INTEGER\\\"}],\"\n                + \"\\\"rows\\\":[[1],[2],[null]]}}\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = Harness.request(req);\n        Map<?, ?> result = (Map<?, ?>) resp.get(\"result\");\n        TF.assertEquals(1, result.get(\"selectedCount\"));\n        Map<?, ?> stats = (Map<?, ?>) result.get(\"triStats\");\n        TF.assertEquals(1, stats.get(\"TRUE\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(1, stats.get(\"FALSE\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(1, stats.get(\"UNKNOWN\"));\n    }\n\n    /** 逐行求值：某些行短路安全，另一些行会触发除零，失败会整体报错。 */\n    private static void shortCircuitAcrossRows() {\n        // flag=TRUE 的行 OR 短路；其余行安全（den 非零）\n        String safe = \"{\"\n                + \"\\\"expression\\\":\\\"flag OR (10 / den = 2)\\\",\"\n                + \"\\\"table\\\":{\\\"columns\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"flag\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"BOOLEAN\\\"},\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"den\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"INTEGER\\\"}],\"\n                + \"\\\"rows\\\":[[true,0],[false,5],[false,10]]}}\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = Harness.request(safe);\n        TF.assertEquals(Boolean.TRUE, resp.get(\"ok\"));\n        Map<?, ?> result = (Map<?, ?>) resp.get(\"result\");\n        // [true,0]  OR 短路 -> TRUE\n        // [false,5] 10/5=2 -> TRUE\n        // [false,10] 10/10=1 -> FALSE\n        TF.assertEquals(2, result.get(\"selectedCount\"));\n    }\n\n    private static void compileErrorCarriesPosition() {\n        String req = \"{\"\n                + \"\\\"expression\\\":\\\"x + 'oops'\\\",\"\n                + \"\\\"table\\\":{\\\"columns\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"x\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"INTEGER\\\"}],\"\n                + \"\\\"rows\\\":[]}}\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = Harness.request(req);\n        TF.assertEquals(Boolean.FALSE, resp.get(\"ok\"));\n        Map<?, ?> err = (Map<?, ?>) resp.get(\"error\");\n        TF.assertEquals(\"TYPE_MISMATCH\", err.get(\"code\"));\n        Map<?, ?> pos = (Map<?, ?>) err.get(\"position\");\n        TF.assertNotNull(pos, \"类型错误应包含 position\");\n        // x + 'oops'，'+' 位于 offset 2\n        TF.assertEquals(2, pos.get(\"offset\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(1, pos.get(\"line\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(3, pos.get(\"column\"));\n\n        // 未知列\n        String req2 = \"{\\\"expression\\\":\\\"missing = 1\\\",\\\"table\\\":{\"\n                + \"\\\"columns\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"x\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"INTEGER\\\"}],\\\"rows\\\":[]}}\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp2 = Harness.request(req2);\n        Map<?, ?> err2 = (Map<?, ?>) resp2.get(\"error\");\n        TF.assertEquals(\"UNKNOWN_COLUMN\", err2.get(\"code\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(0, ((Map<?, ?>) err2.get(\"position\")).get(\"offset\"));\n    }\n\n    private static void badRequests() {\n        // 非法 JSON\n        Map<String, Object> r1 = Harness.request(\"{not json\");\n        TF.assertEquals(\"INVALID_JSON\", ((Map<?, ?>) r1.get(\"error\")).get(\"code\"));\n\n        // 缺少 expression\n        Map<String, Object> r2 = Harness.request(\"{\\\"table\\\":{\\\"columns\\\":[]}}\");\n        TF.assertEquals(\"BAD_REQUEST\", ((Map<?, ?>) r2.get(\"error\")).get(\"code\"));\n\n        // 行长度不匹配\n        String r3src = \"{\\\"expression\\\":\\\"TRUE\\\",\\\"table\\\":{\"\n                + \"\\\"columns\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"a\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"INTEGER\\\"}],\"\n                + \"\\\"rows\\\":[[1,2]]}}\";\n        Map<String, Object> r3 = Harness.request(r3src);\n        TF.assertEquals(\"BAD_REQUEST\", ((Map<?, ?>) r3.get(\"error\")).get(\"code\"));\n\n        // INTEGER 列收到字符串\n        String r4src = \"{\\\"expression\\\":\\\"TRUE\\\",\\\"table\\\":{\"\n                + \"\\\"columns\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"a\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"INTEGER\\\"}],\"\n                + \"\\\"rows\\\":[[\\\"no\\\"]]}}\";\n        Map<String, Object> r4 = Harness.request(r4src);\n        TF.assertEquals(\"BAD_REQUEST\", ((Map<?, ?>) r4.get(\"error\")).get(\"code\"));\n\n        // 不支持的列类型\n        String r5src = \"{\\\"expression\\\":\\\"TRUE\\\",\\\"table\\\":{\"\n                + \"\\\"columns\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"a\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"FLOAT\\\"}],\\\"rows\\\":[]}}\";\n        Map<String, Object> r5 = Harness.request(r5src);\n        TF.assertEquals(\"BAD_REQUEST\", ((Map<?, ?>) r5.get(\"error\")).get(\"code\"));\n\n        // 重复列名\n        String r6src = \"{\\\"expression\\\":\\\"TRUE\\\",\\\"table\\\":{\"\n                + \"\\\"columns\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"a\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"INTEGER\\\"},\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"a\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"INTEGER\\\"}],\\\"rows\\\":[]}}\";\n        Map<String, Object> r6 = Harness.request(r6src);\n        TF.assertEquals(\"BAD_REQUEST\", ((Map<?, ?>) r6.get(\"error\")).get(\"code\"));\n    }\n\n    /** includeTable=true 时响应携带完整数据；导出内容可再次被 JSON 解析。 */\n    private static void tableExportRoundTrip() {\n        String req = basicRequest().replace(\"}\",\n                \",\\\"includeTable\\\":true}\").replaceFirst(\"\\\\}\\\\s*$\", \"}}\");\n        // 上面替换容易出错，改为显式构造：\n        req = \"{\"\n                + \"\\\"expression\\\":\\\"x > 1\\\",\"\n                + \"\\\"includeTable\\\":true,\"\n                + \"\\\"table\\\":{\\\"name\\\":\\\"nums\\\",\"\n                + \"\\\"columns\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"x\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"INTEGER\\\"}],\"\n                + \"\\\"rows\\\":[[1],[null],[3]]}}\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = Harness.request(req);\n        Map<?, ?> table = (Map<?, ?>) resp.get(\"table\");\n        TF.assertEquals(\"nums\", table.get(\"name\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(3, table.get(\"rowCount\"));\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        List<List<Object>> rows = (List<List<Object>>) table.get(\"rows\");\n        TF.assertNull(rows.get(1).get(0), \"导出表中的 NULL 应为 JSON null\");\n        // 整个响应可序列化为 JSON 并再解析（可导出保证）\n        String serialized = Json.stringify(resp);\n        Map<String, Object> reparsed = Json.parseObject(serialized);\n        TF.assertEquals(Boolean.TRUE, reparsed.get(\"ok\"));\n    }\n\n    private static void astAndPlanExport() {\n        Map<String, Object> resp = Harness.request(basicRequest());\n        Map<?, ?> plan = (Map<?, ?>) resp.get(\"plan\");\n        TF.assertEquals(\"Filter\", plan.get(\"operator\"));\n        Map<?, ?> pred = (Map<?, ?>) predOf(plan);\n        TF.assertEquals(\"Binary\", pred.get(\"node\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"AND\", pred.get(\"op\"));\n        Map<?, ?> scan = (Map<?, ?>) plan.get(\"input\");\n        TF.assertEquals(\"TableScan\", scan.get(\"operator\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"nums\", scan.get(\"table\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(5, scan.get(\"estimatedRows\"));\n\n        // AST 节点带类型与位置\n        Map<?, ?> ast = (Map<?, ?>) resp.get(\"ast\");\n        TF.assertEquals(\"BOOLEAN\", ast.get(\"resolvedType\"));\n    }\n\n    private static Map<?, ?> predOf(Map<?, ?> plan) {\n        return (Map<?, ?>) plan.get(\"predicate\");\n    }\n\n    private static void standaloneExpressionMode() {\n        Map<String, Object> resp = Harness.request(\n                \"{\\\"expression\\\":\\\"NOT (TRUE AND FALSE) OR NULL\\\"}\");\n        TF.assertEquals(Boolean.TRUE, resp.get(\"ok\"));\n        Map<?, ?> result = (Map<?, ?>) resp.get(\"result\");\n        TF.assertEquals(\"standaloneExpression\", result.get(\"mode\"));\n        Map<?, ?> value = (Map<?, ?>) result.get(\"value\");\n        TF.assertEquals(\"BOOLEAN\", value.get(\"type\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(Boolean.TRUE, value.get(\"value\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"TRUE\", result.get(\"triValue\"));\n\n        // 纯算术表达式返回整数值，不产生 triValue\n        Map<String, Object> r2 = Harness.request(\"{\\\"expression\\\":\\\"6 * 7\\\"}\");\n        Map<?, ?> v2 = (Map<?, ?>) ((Map<?, ?>) r2.get(\"result\")).get(\"value\");\n        TF.assertEquals(42L, v2.get(\"value\"));\n    }\n\n    /** 求值期错误：任一行除零 -> 整个请求失败并返回错误码。 */\n    private static void divideByZeroRequestFailsWholeQuery() {\n        String req = \"{\\\"expression\\\":\\\"10 / d = 1\\\",\\\"table\\\":{\"\n                + \"\\\"columns\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"d\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"INTEGER\\\"}],\"\n                + \"\\\"rows\\\":[[5],[0]]}}\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = Harness.request(req);\n        TF.assertEquals(Boolean.FALSE, resp.get(\"ok\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"DIVISION_BY_ZERO\",\n                ((Map<?, ?>) resp.get(\"error\")).get(\"code\"));\n    }\n\n    private static void stringsAndBooleans() {\n        String req = \"{\\\"expression\\\":\\\"name >= 'c' AND active\\\",\"\n                + \"\\\"table\\\":{\\\"columns\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"name\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"STRING\\\"},\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"active\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"BOOLEAN\\\"}],\"\n                + \"\\\"rows\\\":[[\\\"alice\\\",true],[\\\"dave\\\",true],[\\\"zoe\\\",false],[null,true]]}}\";\n        Map<String, Object> resp = Harness.request(req);\n        TF.assertEquals(Boolean.TRUE, resp.get(\"ok\"));\n        Map<?, ?> result = (Map<?, ?>) resp.get(\"result\");\n        // alice>=c FALSE; dave TRUE&TRUE 选; zoe TRUE&FALSE 不选; null->UNKNOWN\n        TF.assertEquals(1, result.get(\"selectedCount\"));\n        Map<?, ?> stats = (Map<?, ?>) result.get(\"triStats\");\n        TF.assertEquals(1, stats.get(\"TRUE\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(2, stats.get(\"FALSE\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(1, stats.get(\"UNKNOWN\"));\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"53bfe75b-fcd3-4684-a9a3-abddc00386b3","session_id":"e005d12a-a1e6-4b8e-a696-90144e423ae2","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp11/a","sessionId":"e005d12a-a1e6-4b8e-a696-90144e423ae2","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp11-a","slug":"warm-stargazing-music"}

unaryNegateOverflow();\n29\t        literalOutOfRange();\n30\t        overflowViaColumns();\n31\t        normalBoundaryValuesOk();\n32\t    }\n33\t\n34\t    private static void addSubOverflow() {\n35\t        expectOverflow(MAX + \" + 1\");\n36\t        expectOverflow(MIN + \" - 1\");\n37\t        expectOverflow(MAX + \" + \" + MAX);\n38\t        expectOverflow(MIN + \" + \" + MIN);\n39\t        expectOverflow(\"0 - \" + MIN);\n40\t        // 边界不溢出\n41\t        TF.assertEquals(MIN + 1, Harness.value(MIN + \" + 1\").integer());\n42\t        TF.assertEquals(MAX - 1, Harness.value(MAX + \" - 1\").integer());\n43\t        TF.assertEquals(MIN, Harness.value(MIN + \" - 0\").integer());\n44\t    }\n45\t\n46\t    private static void mulOverflow() {\n47\t        expectOverflow(MAX + \" * 2\");\n48\t        expectOverflow(MIN + \" * 2\");\n49\t        expectOverflow(MAX + \" * \" + MAX);\n50\t        // MIN * -1 溢出\n51\t        expectOverflow(MIN + \" * -1\");\n52\t        // 正常边界\n53\t        TF.assertEquals(0L, Harness.value(MAX + \" * 0\").integer());\n54\t        TF.assertEquals(MAX, Harness.value(MAX + \" * 1\").integer());\n55\t        TF.assertEquals(-MAX, Harness.value(MAX + \" * -1\").integer());\n56\t        // 32 位边界附近乘积\n57\t        TF.assertEquals(1000000L * 1000000L,\n58\t                Harness.value(\"1000000 * 1000000\").integer());\n59\t    }\n60\t\n61\t    private static void divisionByZero() {\n62\t        expectDiv0(\"1 / 0\");\n63\t        expectDiv0(\"0 / 0\");\n64\t        expectDiv0(\"-5 / 0\");\n65\t        expectDiv0(\"(2 + 3) / (3 - 3)\");\n66\t        // 整除余数被丢弃但不抛错\n67\t        TF.assertEquals(0L, Harness.value(\"1 / 2\").integer());\n68\t    }\n69\t\n70\t    private static void divisionOverflow() {\n71\t        // MIN / -1 = 9223372036854775808，超出 long，明确报溢出\n72\t        expectOverflow(MIN + \" / -1\");\n73\t        // 其他负数除法正常\n74\t        TF.assertEquals(1L, Harness.value(MIN + \" / \" + MIN).integer());\n75\t        TF.assertEquals(MIN / 2, Harness.value(MIN + \" / 2\").integer());\n76\t    }\n77\t\n78\t    private static void unaryNegateOverflow() {\n79\t        // 一元负号作用于 MIN 溢出（用表达式 -(MIN+1-1) 让值落到 MIN）\n80\t        expectOverflow(\"-(\" + MIN + \" + 0)\");\n81\t        // 普通一元负号正常\n82\t        TF.assertEquals(-5L, Harness.value(\"-5\").integer());\n83\t    }\n84\t\n85\t    private static void literalOutOfRange() {\n86\t        CompileException e = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n87\t                () -> Harness.compile(\"99999999999999999999999\"));\n88\t        TF.assertEquals(\"INTEGER_OUT_OF_RANGE\", e.code());\n89\t        assertNotNull(e.pos(), \"溢出字面量错误应带位置\");\n90\t\n91\t        CompileException e2 = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n92\t                () -> Harness.compile(\"-9223372036854775808\"));\n93\t        TF.assertEquals(\"INTEGER_OUT_OF_RANGE\", e2.code());\n94\t\n95\t        // 合法的边界字面量\n96\t        TF.assertEquals(MAX, Harness.value(MAX + \"\").integer());\n97\t        TF.assertEquals(MIN + 1, Harness.value(\"9223372036854775807\").integer());\n98\t    }\n99\t\n100\t    private static void overflowViaColumns() {\n101\t        Map<String, DataType> schema = Harness.schema(\n102\t                \"a\", DataType.INTEGER, \"b\", DataType.INTEGER);\n103\t        String[] cols = {\"a\", \"b\"};\n104\t\n105\t        EvalException e = TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class, () ->\n106\t                Harness.value(\"a + b\", schema, cols,\n107\t                        Harness.cells(MAX, 1L)));\n108\t        TF.assertEquals(\"INTEGER_OVERFLOW\", e.code());\n109\t\n110\t        EvalException d = TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class, () ->\n111\t                Harness.value(\"a / b\", schema, cols,\n112\t                        Harness.cells(10L, 0L)));\n113\t        TF.assertEquals(\"DIVISION_BY_ZERO\", d.code());\n114\t\n115\t        // NULL 传播优先于运算：NULL/0 是 NULL，不抛除零（右侧仍会先求值，\n116\t        // 但 0 作为操作数本身不抛错，只有真正做除法时才检查除数）\n117\t        TF.assertTrue(Harness.value(\"a / b\", schema, cols,\n118\t                Harness.cells(null, 0L)).isNull(), \"NULL / 0 应为 NULL\");\n119\t    }\n120\t\n121\t    private static void normalBoundaryValuesOk() {\n122\t        TF.assertEquals(MAX + MIN,\n123\t                Harness.value(MAX + \" + \" + MIN).integer()); // = -1\n124\t        TF.assertEquals(-1L, Harness.value(MAX + \" + \" + MIN).integer());\n125\t        TF.assertEquals(MAX, Harness.value(\"4611686018427387903 * 2 + 1\").integer());\n126\t    }\n127\t\n128\t    private static void expectOverflow(String src) {\n129\t        EvalException e = TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class, () -> Harness.value(src));\n130\t        TF.assertEquals(\"INTEGER_OVERFLOW\", e.code());\n131\t    }\n132\t\n133\t    private static void expectDiv0(String src) {\n134\t        EvalException e = TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class, () -> Harness.value(src));\n135\t        TF.assertEquals(\"DIVISION_BY_ZERO\", e.code());\n136\t    }\n137\t}"},"type":"attachment","uuid":"dad17db4-92a7-4122-a383-aa90b80dce70","timestamp":"2026-09-23T01:52:59.167Z","rendered":[{"content":"<system-reminder>\nNote: {"parentUuid":"dad17db4-92a7-4122-a383-aa90b80dce70","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"edited_text_file","filename":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp11/a/src/test/java/tvl/ShortCircuitTest.java","snippet":"1\tpackage tvl;\n2\t\n3\timport tvl.core.DataType;\n4\timport tvl.core.EvalException;\n5\timport tvl.core.TriBool;\n6\timport tvl.core.Value;\n7\timport java.util.Map;\n8\t\n9\t/**\n10\t * 验收点：短路求值。\n11\t *\n12\t *  - OR：左操作数为 TRUE 时不求右操作数；\n13\t *  - AND：左操作数为 FALSE 时不求右操作数。\n14\t *\n15\t * 被跳过的分支里放置“一旦求值必然抛错”的表达式（除零、溢出），\n16\t * 以此从行为上证明该分支确实没有执行；并设置对照组证明该分支\n17\t * 未被跳过时错误会照常抛出。\n18\t */\n19\tpublic class ShortCircuitTest {\n20\t\n21\t    /** 右分支：除零，必然在求值时抛 DIVISION_BY_ZERO。 */\n22\t    private static final String DIV0_RHS = \"1 / 0 = 1\";\n23\t    /** 右分支：溢出，必然在求值时抛 INTEGER_OVERFLOW。 */\n24\t    private static final String OVF_RHS =\n25\t            \"9223372036854775807 + 1 = 1\";\n26\t\n27\t    public static void run() {\n28\t        orSkipsOnTrue();\n29\t        andSkipsOnFalse();\n30\t        notSkippedControls();\n31\t        nullDoesNotShortCircuit();\n32\t        nestedShortCircuit();\n33\t        columnDrivenShortCircuit();\n34\t        errorsCarryCode();\n35\t    }\n36\t\n37\t    private static void orSkipsOnTrue() {\n38\t        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"TRUE OR \" + DIV0_RHS));\n39\t        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"TRUE OR \" + OVF_RHS));\n40\t        // 左 TRUE 时右分支哪怕语法上是一整棵复杂表达式也不求值\n41\t        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n42\t                tri(\"TRUE OR (1 / 0 > 2 AND FALSE OR NOT TRUE)\"));\n43\t        // 右 TRUE 不能救左 FALSE 之外的错误：左 TRUE 时整体短路，无关于右侧\n44\t        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n45\t                tri(\"(1 = 1) OR (1 / 0 = 0)\"));\n46\t    }\n47\t\n48\t    private static void andSkipsOnFalse() {\n49\t        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE, tri(\"FALSE AND \" + DIV0_RHS));\n50\t        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE, tri(\"FALSE AND \" + OVF_RHS));\n51\t        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n52\t                tri(\"(1 = 2) AND (1 / 0 = 1)\"));\n53\t        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n54\t                tri(\"1 > 100 AND (9223372036854775807 + 1 = 0)\"));\n55\t    }\n56\t\n57\t    /** 对照组：不满足短路条件时，右分支被求值，错误照常抛出。 */\n58\t    private static void notSkippedControls() {\n59\t        EvalException e1 = TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class,\n60\t                () -> Harness.value(\"FALSE OR \" + DIV0_RHS));\n61\t        TF.assertEquals(\"DIVISION_BY_ZERO\", e1.code());\n62\t\n63\t        EvalException e2 = TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class,\n64\t                () -> Harness.value(\"TRUE AND \" + DIV0_RHS));\n65\t        TF.assertEquals(\"DIVISION_BY_ZERO\", e2.code());\n66\t\n67\t        TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class,\n68\t                () -> Harness.value(\"FALSE OR \" + OVF_RHS));\n69\t        TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class,\n70\t                () -> Harness.value(\"TRUE AND \" + OVF_RHS));\n71\t    }\n72\t\n73\t    /**\n74\t     * UNKNOWN 不产生短路（Kleene 逻辑必须查看另一侧）：\n75\t     *  - U AND <除零>：右分支仍要求值 -> 抛错\n76\t     *  - U OR  <除零>：右分支仍要求值 -> 抛错\n77\t     */\n78\t    private static void nullDoesNotShortCircuit() {\n79\t        TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class,\n80\t                () -> Harness.value(\"(1 = NULL) AND \" + DIV0_RHS));\n81\t        TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class,\n82\t                () -> Harness.value(\"(1 = NULL) OR \" + DIV0_RHS));\n83\t        // 但 U OR TRUE 在右侧为字面量 TRUE 时安全返回 TRUE\n84\t        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"(1 = NULL) OR TRUE\"));\n85\t        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE, tri(\"(1 = NULL) AND FALSE\"));\n86\t    }\n87\t\n88\t    private static void nestedShortCircuit() {\n89\t        // 内层 AND 被 FALSE 短路，整个 OR 左真又短路：两处除零都不触发\n90\t        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n91\t                tri(\"TRUE OR (FALSE AND (1 / 0 = 1))\"));\n92\t        // (FALSE AND <除零>) = FALSE；外层 OR 结果 FALSE\n93\t        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n94\t                tri(\"FALSE OR (FALSE AND (1 / 0 = 1))\"));\n95\t        // NOT 不改变短路结构\n96\t        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n97\t                tri(\"NOT (TRUE OR (1 / 0 = 1))\"));\n98\t        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n99\t                tri(\"NOT (FALSE AND (1 / 0 = 1))\"));\n100\t    }\n101\t\n102\t    /** 用真实列值驱动短路（端到端，而非仅字面量）。 */\n103\t    private static void columnDrivenShortCircuit() {\n104\t        Map<String, DataType> schema = Harness.schema(\n105\t                \"flag\", DataType.BOOLEAN,\n106\t                \"den\", DataType.INTEGER);\n107\t        String[] cols = {\"flag\", \"den\"};\n108\t\n109\t        // flag=TRUE 时 OR 短路：den=0 的行也不应触发除零\n110\t        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n111\t                Harness.logic(\"flag OR (10 / den = 1)\", schema, cols,\n112\t                        Harness.cells(Boolean.TRUE, 0L)));\n113\t        // flag=FALSE 时 AND 短路\n114\t        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n115\t                Harness.logic(\"flag AND (10 / den = 1)\", schema, cols,\n116\t                        Harness.cells(Boolean.FALSE, 0L)));\n117\t        // 对照组：flag=FALSE 的 OR 不短路，den=0 -> 除零\n118\t        TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class, () -> Harness.logic(\n119\t                \"flag OR (10 / den = 1)\", schema, cols,\n120\t                Harness.cells(Boolean.FALSE, 0L)));\n121\t        // 对照组：flag=TRUE 的 AND 不短路，den=0 -> 除零\n122\t        TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class, () -> Harness.logic(\n123\t                \"flag AND (10 / den = 1)\", schema, cols,\n124\t                Harness.cells(Boolean.TRUE, 0L)));\n125\t        // 正常行（den 非零）结果正确\n126\t        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n127\t                Harness.logic(\"flag OR (10 / den = 1)\", schema, cols,\n128\t                        Harness.cells(Boolean.FALSE, 10L)));\n129\t        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n130\t                Harness.logic(\"flag OR (10 / den = 1)\", schema, cols,\n131\t                        Harness.cells(Boolean.FALSE, 3L)));\n132\t    }\n133\t\n134\t    private static void errorsCarryCode() {\n135\t        EvalException overflow = TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class,\n136\t Long.MAX_VALUE;\n    private static final long MIN = Long.MIN_VALUE;\n\n    public static void run() {\n        addSubOverflow();\n        mulOverflow();\n        divisionByZero();\n        divisionOverflow();\n        unaryNegateOverflow();\n        literalOutOfRange();\n        overflowViaColumns();\n        normalBoundaryValuesOk();\n    }\n\n    private static void addSubOverflow() {\n        expectOverflow(MAX + \" + 1\");\n        expectOverflow(MIN + \" - 1\");\n        expectOverflow(MAX + \" + \" + MAX);\n        expectOverflow(MIN + \" + \" + MIN);\n        expectOverflow(\"0 - \" + MIN);\n        // 边界不溢出\n        TF.assertEquals(MIN + 1, Harness.value(MIN + \" + 1\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(MAX - 1, Harness.value(MAX + \" - 1\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(MIN, Harness.value(MIN + \" - 0\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void mulOverflow() {\n        expectOverflow(MAX + \" * 2\");\n        expectOverflow(MIN + \" * 2\");\n        expectOverflow(MAX + \" * \" + MAX);\n        // MIN * -1 溢出\n        expectOverflow(MIN + \" * -1\");\n        // 正常边界\n        TF.assertEquals(0L, Harness.value(MAX + \" * 0\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(MAX, Harness.value(MAX + \" * 1\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(-MAX, Harness.value(MAX + \" * -1\").integer());\n        // 32 位边界附近乘积\n        TF.assertEquals(1000000L * 1000000L,\n                Harness.value(\"1000000 * 1000000\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void divisionByZero() {\n        expectDiv0(\"1 / 0\");\n        expectDiv0(\"0 / 0\");\n        expectDiv0(\"-5 / 0\");\n        expectDiv0(\"(2 + 3) / (3 - 3)\");\n        // 整除余数被丢弃但不抛错\n        TF.assertEquals(0L, Harness.value(\"1 / 2\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void divisionOverflow() {\n        // MIN / -1 = 9223372036854775808，超出 long，明确报溢出\n        expectOverflow(MIN + \" / -1\");\n        // 其他负数除法正常\n        TF.assertEquals(1L, Harness.value(MIN + \" / \" + MIN).integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(MIN / 2, Harness.value(MIN + \" / 2\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void unaryNegateOverflow() {\n        // 一元负号作用于 MIN 溢出（用表达式 -(MIN+1-1) 让值落到 MIN）\n        expectOverflow(\"-(\" + MIN + \" + 0)\");\n        // 普通一元负号正常\n        TF.assertEquals(-5L, Harness.value(\"-5\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void literalOutOfRange() {\n        CompileException e = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"99999999999999999999999\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"INTEGER_OUT_OF_RANGE\", e.code());\n        assertNotNull(e.pos(), \"溢出字面量错误应带位置\");\n\n        CompileException e2 = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"-9223372036854775808\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"INTEGER_OUT_OF_RANGE\", e2.code());\n\n        // 合法的边界字面量\n        TF.assertEquals(MAX, Harness.value(MAX + \"\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(MIN + 1, Harness.value(\"9223372036854775807\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void overflowViaColumns() {\n        Map<String, DataType> schema = Harness.schema(\n                \"a\", DataType.INTEGER, \"b\", DataType.INTEGER);\n        String[] cols = {\"a\", \"b\"};\n\n        EvalException e = TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class, () ->\n                Harness.value(\"a + b\", schema, cols,\n                        Harness.cells(MAX, 1L)));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"INTEGER_OVERFLOW\", e.code());\n\n        EvalException d = TF.assertThrows(EvalException.class, () ->\n                Harness.value(\"a / b\", schema, cols,\n                        Harness.cells(10L, 0L)));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"DIVISION_BY_ZERO\", tvl.core.Value;\n\n/**\n * 验收点：运算符优先级、结合性与括号。\n *\n * 优先级（低 -> 高）：OR < AND < NOT < 比较 < + - < * / < 一元 - < 原子。\n * 这与 SQL 的惯例一致（比较紧于 NOT；NOT 紧于 AND；AND 紧于 OR）。\n */\npublic class PrecedenceTest {\n\n    public static void run() {\n        arithmetic();\n        comparisonVsArithmetic();\n        logicPrecedence();\n        notPrecedence();\n        isNullPrecedence();\n        parentheses();\n        unaryMinus();\n        keywordsCaseInsensitive();\n        comments();\n    }\n\n    private static void arithmetic() {\n        // 乘除高于加减\n        TF.assertEquals(14L, Harness.value(\"2 + 3 * 4\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(20L, Harness.value(\"(2 + 3) * 4\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(-5L, Harness.value(\"10 / 2 - 10\").integer());\n        // 左结合\n        TF.assertEquals(5L, Harness.value(\"10 - 2 - 3\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(1L, Harness.value(\"20 / 4 / 5\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(14L, Harness.value(\"2 * 3 + 4 * 2\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(2L, Harness.value(\"7 / 3\").integer());          // 整除向零\n        TF.assertEquals(-2L, Harness.value(\"-7 / 3\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(2L, Harness.value(\"7 / -3\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void comparisonVsArithmetic() {\n        TF.assertEquals(true, Harness.value(\"2 + 3 = 5\").bool());\n        TF.assertEquals(true, Harness.value(\"2 * 3 > 2 + 1\").bool());\n        TF.assertEquals(false, Harness.value(\"10 - 2 * 3 = 24\").bool()); // 4 = 24 -> false\n        TF.assertEquals(true, Harness.value(\"10 - 2 * 3 = 4\").bool());\n        // != 与 <> 等价\n        TF.assertEquals(true, Harness.value(\"1 <> 2\").bool());\n        TF.assertEquals(true, Harness.value(\"1 != 2\").bool());\n        TF.assertEquals(false, Harness.value(\"1 <> 1\").bool());\n        TF.assertEquals(true, Harness.value(\"3 >= 3\").bool());\n        TF.assertEquals(false, Harness.value(\"3 > 3\").bool());\n        TF.assertEquals(true, Harness.value(\"'b' >= 'a'\").bool());\n        TF.assertEquals(true, Harness.value(\"'abc' < 'abd'\").bool());\n    }\n\n    private static void logicPrecedence() {\n        // AND 紧于 OR：TRUE OR FALSE AND FALSE => TRUE OR (FALSE AND FALSE) = TRUE\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"TRUE OR FALSE AND FALSE\"));\n        // 若从左到右错误结合会是 (TRUE OR FALSE) AND FALSE = FALSE\n        // FALSE OR TRUE AND TRUE => FALSE OR TRUE = TRUE\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"FALSE OR TRUE AND TRUE\"));\n        // a AND b OR c AND d == (a AND b) OR (c AND d)\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE, tri(\"FALSE AND TRUE OR FALSE AND TRUE\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"TRUE AND FALSE OR TRUE AND TRUE\"));\n    }\n\n    private static void notPrecedence() {\n        // NOT 紧于 AND：NOT FALSE AND FALSE => (NOT FALSE) AND FALSE = TRUE AND FALSE = FALSE\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE, tri(\"NOT FALSE AND FALSE\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"NOT FALSE AND TRUE\"));\n        // 比较紧于 NOT（SQL 语义）：NOT 1 = 2 => NOT (1 = 2) = TRUE\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"NOT 1 = 2\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE, tri(\"NOT 1 = 1\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"NOT NOT 1 = 1\"));\n    }\n\n    private static void isNullPrecedence() {\n        // IS NULL 与 AND：col IS NULL AND TRUE\n        var schema = Harness.schema(\"x\", DataType.INTEGER);\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"x IS NULL AND TRUE\", schema,\n                        new String[]{\"x\"}, Harness.rowV(Value.NULL)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                Harness.logic(\"x IS NULL AND TRUE\", schema,\n                        new String[]{\"x\"}, Harness.rowV(Value.ofInteger(1))));\n        // NOT 作用于 IS NULL：NOT x IS NULL 等价 NOT (x IS NULL)\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                Harness.logic(\"NOT x IS NULL\", schema,\n                        new String[]{\"x\"}, Harness.rowV(Value.NULL)));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"NOT x IS NULL\", schema,\n                        new String[]{\"x\"}, Harness.rowV(Value.ofInteger(1))));\n        // 显式 IS NOT NULL\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                Harness.logic(\"x IS NOT NULL\", schema,\n                        new String[]{\"x\"}, Harness.rowV(Value.ofInteger(1))));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE,\n                Harness.logic(\"x IS NOT NULL\", schema,\n                        new String[]{\"x\"}, Harness.rowV(Value.NULL)));\n    }\n\n    private static void parentheses() {\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE, tri(\"(TRUE OR FALSE) AND FALSE\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"NOT (FALSE AND TRUE)\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(10L, Harness.value(\"(2 + 3) * (6 - 4)\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void unaryMinus() {\n        TF.assertEquals(-6L, Harness.value(\"-2 * 3\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(6L, Harness.value(\"-2 * -3\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(-5L, Harness.value(\"-(2 + 3)\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(6L, Harness.value(\"3 - -3\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void keywordsCaseInsensitive() {\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"true or false\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.FALSE, tri(\"True And False\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE, tri(\"not false\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.UNKNOWN, tri(\"NOT Null\"));\n    }\n\n    private static void comments() {\n        TF.assertEquals(3L, Harness.value(\"1 + -- line comment\\n2\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(3L, Harness.value(\"1 /* block */ + 2\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(TriBool.TRUE,\n                tri(\"TRUE -- keep going\\n OR FALSE\"));\n    }\n\n    private static TriBool tri(String src) {\n        return Harness.value(src).isNull()\n                ?   private static final long MAX = Long.MAX_VALUE;\n    private static final long MIN = Long.MIN_VALUE;\n\n    public static void run() {\n        addSubOverflow();\n        mulOverflow();\n static void addSubOverflow() {\n        expectOverflow(MAX + \" + 1\");\n        expectOverflow(MIN + \" - 1\");\n        expectOverflow(MAX + \" + \" + MAX);\n        expectOverflow(MIN + \" + \" + MIN);\n        expectOverflow(\"0 - \" + MIN);\n        // 边界不溢出\n        TF.assertEquals(MIN + 1, Harness.value(MIN + \" + 1\").integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(MAX - 1, Harness.value(MAX + \" - 32 位边界附近乘积\n        TF.assertEquals(1000000L * 1000000L,\n                Harness.value(\"1000000 * 1000000\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void divisionByZero() {\n        expectDiv0(\"1 2\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void divisionOverflow() {\n        // MIN / -1 = 9223372036854775808，超出 long，明确报溢出\n        expectOverflow(MIN + \" / -1\");\n        // 其他负数除法正常\n        TF.assertEquals(1L, Harness.value(MIN + \" / \" + MIN).integer());\n        TF.assertEquals(MIN / 2, Harness.value(MIN + \" / 2\").integer());\n    }\n\n    private static void unaryNegateOverflow() {\n        // 一元负号作用于 MIN 溢出（用表达式 -(MIN+1-1) 让值落到 MIN）\n        expectOverflow(\"-(\" + MIN + \" + 0)\");\n        // 普通一元负号正常\n        TF.assertEquals(-5L, Harness.value(\"-5\").integer());\n TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n    }\n\n    /** 对表达式求值，得到通用值。 */\n    public Value eval(Expr e, Value[] row) {\n        if (e instanceof LiteralExpr) {\n            return evalLiteral((LiteralExpr) e);\n        }\n        if (e instanceof ColumnExpr) {\n            return evalColumn((ColumnExpr) e, row);\n        }\n        if (e instanceof UnaryMinusExpr) {\n            UnaryMinusExpr u = (UnaryMinusExpr) e;\n            Value v = eval(u.operand, row);\n            if (v.isNull()) {\n                return Value.NULL;\n            }\n            return Value.ofInteger(negateExact(v.integer()));\n        }\n        if (e instanceof NotExpr) {\n            // 值语境下求 NOT：UNKNOWN 仍以 NULL 布尔表示\n            return triToValue(evalLogic(e, row));\n        }\n        if (e instanceof IsNullExpr) {\n            IsNullExpr i = (IsNullExpr) e;\n            boolean isNull = eval(i.operand, row).isNull();\n            return Value.ofBoolean(i.negated ? !isNull : isNull);\n        }\n        if (e instanceof BinaryExpr) {\n            return evalBinary((BinaryExpr) e, row);\n        }\n        throw new IllegalStateException(\"未知表达式节点：\" + e.getClass());\n    }\n\n    private Value evalLiteral(LiteralExpr e) {\n        switch (e.kind) {\n            case INTEGER: return Value.ofInteger((Long) e.value);\n            case STRING:  return Value.ofString((String) e.value);\n            case BOOLEAN: return Value.ofBoolean((Boolean) e.value);\n            case NULL:    return Value.NULL;\n            default: throw new IllegalStateException();\n        }\n    }\n\n    private Value evalColumn(ColumnExpr e, Value[] row) {\n        for (int i = 0; i < columns.length; i++) {\n            if (columns[i].equals(e.name)) {\n                return row[i];\n            }\n        }\n        // 类型检查阶段已保证列存在\n        throw new EvalException(\"UNKNOWN_COLUMN\", \"未知列：\" + e.name);\n    }\n\n    private Value evalBinary(BinaryExpr e, Value[] row) {\n        // AND / OR：走三值逻辑，UNKNOWN 表示为布尔 NULL\n        if (e.isLogic()) {\n            return triToValue(evalLogic(e, row));\n        }\n\n        Value l = eval(e.left, row);\n        Value r = eval(e.right, row);\n\n        if (e.isArithmetic()) {\n            if (l.isNull() || r.isNull()) {\n                return Value.NULL;\n            }\n            return Value.ofInteger(arith(e, l.integer(), r.integer()));\n        }\n\n        // 比较：任一为 NULL -> UNKNOWN（布尔 NULL）\n        if (l.isNull() || r.isNull()) {\n            return Value.NULL;\n        }\n        return Value.ofBoolean(compare(e, l, r));\n    }\n\n    private static Value triToValue(TriBool t) {\n        return t == TriBool.UNKNOWN ? b;\n        if (((a ^ b) & (a ^ r)) < 0) {\n            throw overflow(a, b, \"-\");\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private static long mulExact(long a, long b) {\n        long r = a * b;\n        long ax = Math.abs(a);\n        long bx = Math.abs(b);\n        if ((ax | bx) >>> 31 != 0 && b != 0 && r / b != a) {\n            throw overflow(a, b, \"*\");\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private static long negateExact(long a) {","newString":"    // ---------- 一元负号溢出检测 ----------\n\n    private static long negateExact(long a) {","originalFile":"package tvl.eval;\n\nimport java.util.List;\n\nimport tvl.core.DataType;\nimport tvl.core.EvalException;\nimport tvl.core.TriBool;\nimport tvl.core.Value;\nimport tvl.parser.BinaryExpr;\nimport tvl.parser.ColumnExpr;\nimport tvl.parser.Expr;\nimport tvl.parser.IsNullExpr;\nimport tvl.parser.LiteralExpr;\nimport tvl.parser.NotExpr;\nimport tvl.parser.UnaryMinusExpr;\n\n/**\n * 表达式求值器：对一行数据求一个已通过类型检查的 AST。\n *\n * 两条求值路径：\n *  - {@link #eval} 求“值”，返回 {@link Value}（可以是任意类型，含 NULL）。\n *  - {@link #evalLogic} 求“逻辑条件”，返回 {@link TriBool}。\n *    布尔值 NULL 在逻辑语境下解释为 UNKNOWN（SQL 3VL）。\n *\n * AND/OR 使用 Kleene 三值逻辑并真正短路：未选择的分支中的\n * 除零、溢出都不会发生（短路测试的核心保证）。\n */\npublic final class Evaluator {\n\n    private final String[] columns;\n\n    public Evaluator(List<String> columns) {\n        this(columns.toArray(new String[0]));\n    }\n\n    public Evaluator(String[] columns) {\n        this.columns = columns.clone();\n    }\n\n    /** WHERE 过滤：只选中结果为 TRUE 的行（FALSE、UNKNOWN 均不选中）。 */\n    public boolean selected(Expr e, Value[] row) {\n        return evalLogic(e, row) == TriBool.TRUE;\n    }\n\n    /** 把逻辑表达式求值为三值。 */\n    public TriBool evalLogic(Expr e, Value[] row) {\n        if (e instanceof NotExpr) {\n            NotExpr n = (NotExpr) e;\n            return evalLogic(n.operand, row).not();\n        }\n        if (e instanceof BinaryExpr) {\n            BinaryExpr b = (BinaryExpr) e;\n            if (b.op.name().equals(\"AND\")) {\n                TriBool l = evalLogic(b.left, row);\n                if (l == TriBool.FALSE) {\n                    return TriBool.FALSE; // 短路：右分支不求值\n                }\n                return l.and(evalLogic(b.right, row));\n            }\n            if (b.op.name().equals(\"OR\")) {\n                TriBool l = evalLogic(b.left, row);\n                if (l == TriBool.TRUE) {\n                    return TriBool.TRUE; // 短路：右分支不求值\n                }\n                return l.or(evalLogic(b.right, row));\n            }\n        }\n        if (e instanceof IsNullExpr) {\n            IsNullExpr i = (IsNullExpr) e;\n            boolean isNull = eval(i.operand, row).isNull();\n            TriBool tb = isNull ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n            return i.negated ? tb.not() : tb;\n        }\n        // 比较表达式 / 布尔列 / 布尔字面量：NULL -> UNKNOWN\n        Value v = eval(e, row);\n        if (v.isNull()) {\n            return TriBool.UNKNOWN;\n        }\n        return v.bool() ? TriBool.TRUE : TriBool.FALSE;\n    }\n\n    /** 对表达式求值，得到通用值。 */\n    public Value eval(Expr e, Value[] row) {\n        if (e instanceof LiteralExpr) {\n            return evalLiteral((LiteralExpr) e);\n        }\n        if (e instanceof ColumnExpr) {\n            return evalColumn((ColumnExpr) e, row);\n        }\n        if (e instanceof UnaryMinusExpr) {\n            UnaryMinusExpr u = (UnaryMinusExpr) e;\n            Value v = eval(u.operand, row);\n            if (v.isNull()) {\n                return Value.NULL;\n            }\n            return Value.ofInteger(negateExact(v.integer()));\n        }\n        if (e instanceof NotExpr) {\n            // 值语境下求 NOT：UNKNOWN 仍以 NULL 布尔表示\n            return triToValue(evalLogic(e, row));\n        }\n        if (e instanceof IsNullExpr) {\n            IsNullExpr i = (IsNullExpr) e;\n            boolean isNull = eval(i.operand, row).isNull();\n            return Value.ofBoolean(i.negated ? !isNull : isNull);\n        }\n        if (e instanceof BinaryExpr) {\n            return evalBinary((BinaryExpr) e, row);\n        }\n        throw new IllegalStateException(\"未知表达式节点：\" + e.getClass());\n    }\n\n    private Value evalLiteral(LiteralExpr e) {\n        switch (e.kind) {\n            case INTEGER: return Value.ofInteger((Long) e.value);\n            case STRING:  return Value.ofString((String) e.value);\n            case BOOLEAN: return Value.ofBoolean((Boolean) e.value);\n            case NULL:    return Value.NULL;\n            default: throw new IllegalStateException();\n        }\n    }\n\n    private Value evalColumn(ColumnExpr e, Value[] row) {\n        for (int i = 0; i < columns.length; i++) {\n            if (columns[i].equals(e.name)) {\n                return row[i];\n            }\n        }\n        // 类型检查阶段已保证列存在\n        throw new EvalException(\"UNKNOWN_COLUMN\", \"未知列：\" + e.name);\n    }\n\n    private Value evalBinary(BinaryExpr e, Value[] row) {\n        // AND / OR：走三值逻辑，UNKNOWN 表示为布尔 NULL\n        if (e.isLogic()) {\n            return triToValue(evalLogic(e, row));\n        }\n\n        Value l = eval(e.left, row);\n        Value r = eval(e.right, row);\n\n        if (e.isArithmetic()) {\n            if (l.isNull() || r.isNull()) {\n                return Value.NULL;\n            }\n            return Value.ofInteger(arith(e, l.integer(), r.integer()));\n        }\n\n        // 比较：任一为 NULL -> UNKNOWN（布尔 NULL）\n        if (l.isNull() || r.isNull()) {\n            return Value.NULL;\n        }\n        return Value.ofBoolean(compare(e, l, r));\n    }\n\n    private static Value triToValue(TriBool t) {\n        return t == TriBool.UNKNOWN ? Value.NULL : Value.ofBoolean(t == TriBool.TRUE);\n    }\n\n    private long arith(BinaryExpr e, long a, long b) {\n        try {\n            switch (e.op) {\n                case PLUS:  return Math.addExact(a, b);\n                case MINUS: return Math.subtractExact(a, b);\n                case STAR:  return Math.multiplyExact(a, b);\n                case SLASH:\n                    if (b == 0L) {\n                        throw new EvalException(\"DIVISION_BY_ZERO\",\n                                \"整数除以零（被除数 \" + a + \"）\");\n                    }\n                    if (a == Long.MIN_VALUE && b == -1L) {\n                        throw new EvalException(\"INTEGER_OVERFLOW\",\n                                \"整数除法溢出：\" + a + \" / \" + b\n                                        + \" 超出 64 位有符号整数范围\");\n                    }\n                    // Java long / long 向零截断，符合 SQL 整除语义\n                    return a / b;\n                default:\n                    throw new IllegalStateException();\n            }\n        } catch (ArithmeticException ex) {\n            // Math.*Exact 以 ArithmeticException 报告溢出，转换为明确错误码\n            throw new EvalException(\"INTEGER_OVERFLOW\",\n                    \"整数运算溢出：\" + a + \" \" + e.opText + \" \" + b\n                            + \" 的结果超出 64 位有符号整数范围（\"\n                            + Long.MIN_VALUE + \" ~ \" + Long.MAX_VALUE + \"）\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 通用比较入口，按两侧类型分派（此时均非 NULL 且类型已校验一致）。 */\n    private boolean compare(BinaryExpr e, Value l, Value r) {\n        int cmp;\n        if (l.type() == DataType.STRING) {\n            cmp = l.string().compareTo(r.string());\n        } else {\n            cmp = Long.compare(l.integer(), r.integer());\n        }\n        switch (e.op) {\n            case EQ: return cmp == 0;\n            case NE: return cmp != 0;\n            case LT: return cmp < 0;\n            case LE: return cmp <= 0;\n            case GT: return cmp > 0;\n            case GE: return cmp >= 0;\n            default: throw new IllegalStateException();\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 显式溢出检测（给出明确错误码与信息） ----------\n\n    private static long addExact(long a, long b) {\n        long r = a + b;\n        if (((a ^ r) & (b ^ r)) < 0) {\n            throw overflow(a, b, \"+\");\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private static long subExact(long a, long b) {\n        long r = a - b;\n        if (((a ^ b) & (a ^ r)) < 0) {\n            throw overflow(a, b, \"-\");\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private static long mulExact(long a, long b) {\n        long r = a * b;\n        long ax = Math.abs(a);\n        long bx = Math.abs(b);\n        if ((ax | bx) >>> 31 != 0 && b != 0 && r / b != a) {\n            throw overflow(a, b, \"*\");\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    private static long negateExact(long a) {\n        try {\n            return Math.negateExact(a);\n        } catch        TF.assertEquals(1, e.pos().line);","originalFile":"package tvl;\n\nimport tvl.core.CompileException;\nimport tvl.core.DataType;\n\n/**\n * 验收点：错误位置（行列/偏移）准确，类型检查拒绝非法表达式。\n *\n * 每个语法/语义错误都验证错误码与位置，确保错误能指回请求中的具体 token。\n */\npublic class ErrorPositionTest {\n\n    public static void run() {\n        unknownColumn();\n        typeMismatch();\n        syntaxErrors();\n        positionsOnSameLine();\n        positionsWithNewlines();\n        invalidTokens();\n        nonAssociativeComparison();\n        danglingIs();\n        unterminatedLiterals();\n    }\n\n    private static void unknownColumn() {\n        CompileException e = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"a + 1\",\n                        Harness.schema(\"b\", DataType.INTEGER)));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"UNKNOWN_COLUMN\", e.code());\n        TF.assertEquals(0, e.pos().offset);\n        TF.assertEquals(1, e.pos().line);\n        TF.assertEquals(1, e.pos().column);\n        TF.assertEquals(1, e.length()); // 列名 a 长度 1\n\n        // 多字符列名、位于表达式中间\n        CompileException e2 = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"1 + price > 2\",\n                        Harness.schema(\"x\", DataType.INTEGER)));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"UNKNOWN_COLUMN\", e2.code());\n        TF.assertEquals(4, e2.pos().offset); // \"1 + \" 占 4 个字符\n        TF.assertEquals(5, e2.length());     // price 长度 5\n    }\n\n    private static void typeMismatch() {\n        var ints = Harness.schema(\"a\", DataType.INTEGER, \"b\", DataType.INTEGER);\n\n        // 字符串参与算术：错误定位到操作符 '+'\n        CompileException e = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"'x' + 1\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"TYPE_MISMATCH\", e.code());\n        // \"'x' \" 为 4 个字符，'+' 位于 offset 4\n        TF.assertEquals(4, e.pos().offset);\n\n        // 整数参与 AND\n        CompileException e2 = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"1 AND TRUE\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"TYPE_MISMATCH\", e2.code());\n\n        // 布尔参与算术\n        CompileException e3 = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"a + TRUE\", ints));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"TYPE_MISMATCH\", e3.code());\n\n        // 布尔不能排序比较，但可以 = / <>\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"TRUE < FALSE\"));\n        Harness.compile(\"TRUE = FALSE\");  // 合法\n        Harness.compile(\"TRUE <> FALSE\"); // 合法\n\n        // 不同类型做相等比较\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"1 = 'a'\"));\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"'a' = 1\"));\n\n        // 但任一侧为 NULL 字面量允许（未定型）\n        Harness.compile(\"a = NULL\", ints);\n        Harness.compile(\"NULL + a\", ints);\n\n        // NOT 作用于整数\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"NOT 1\", ints));\n        Harness.compile(\"NOT TRUE\");\n        Harness.compile(\"NOT (a = 1)\", ints);\n    }\n\n    private static void syntaxErrors() {\n        // 空表达式\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class, () -> Harness.compile(\"\"));\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class, () -> Harness.compile(\"   \"));\n        // 缺右操作数\n        CompileException e1 = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"1 +\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"SYNTAX_ERROR\", e1.code());\n        // 缺左操作数（AND 处）\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class, () -> Harness.compile(\"AND TRUE\"));\n        // 括号不匹配\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class, () -> Harness.compile(\"(1 + 2\"));\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class, () -> Harness.compile(\"1 + 2)\"));\n        // 双操作符\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class, () -> Harness.compile(\"1 + * 2\"));\n        // 多余内容\n        CompileException extra = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"1 2\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"SYNTAX_ERROR\", extra.code());\n    }\n\n    private static void positionsOnSameLine() {\n        // \"a AND b +\"：末尾缺操作数\n        CompileException e = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"a AND b +\",\n                        Harness.schema(\"a\", DataType.BOOLEAN,\n                                \"b\", DataType.INTEGER)));\n        TF.assertEquals(7, e.pos().offset); // a AND b 共 7 字符后 EOF\n        TF.assertEquals(1, e.pos().line);\n\n        // 错误指向操作符：a AND b（b 是整数）-> AND 操作符位置 offset 2\n        CompileException e2 = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"a AND b\",\n                        Harness.schema(\"a\", DataType.BOOLEAN,\n                                \"b\", DataType.INTEGER)));\n        TF.assertEquals(2, e2.pos().offset);\n        TF.assertEquals(3, e2.length()); // AND 三个字符\n    }\n\n    private static void positionsWithNewlines() {\n        // 第二行上的未知列 bbb\n        String src = \"a = 1 AND\\nbbb > 2\";\n        CompileException e = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(src,\n                        Harness.schema(\"a\", DataType.INTEGER)));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"UNKNOWN_COLUMN\", e.code());\n        TF.assertEquals(2, e.pos().line);\n        TF.assertEquals(1, e.pos().column);\n        // 第一行长度 9（a = 1 AND）+ 换行 = offset 10\n        TF.assertEquals(10, e.pos().offset);\n    }\n\n    private static void invalidTokens() {\n        CompileException e = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"1 @ 2\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"UNEXPECTED_CHAR\", e.code());\n        TF.assertEquals(2, e.pos().offset);\n    }\n\n    private static void nonAssociativeComparison() {\n        CompileException e = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"1 = 2 = 3\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"NON_ASSOCIATIVE_COMPARISON\", e.code());\n        // 指向第二个 '='\n        TF.assertEquals(6, e.pos().offset);\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class, () -> Harness.compile(\"1 < 2 > 3\"));\n        // 用括号可以显式组合\n        Harness.compile(\"(1 = 2) = FALSE\");\n    }\n\n    private static void danglingIs() {\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class, () -> Harness.compile(\"1 IS\"));\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class, () -> Harness.compile(\"1 IS NOT\"));\n        CompileException e = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"1 IS 2\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"SYNTAX_ERROR\", e.code());\n        TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class, () -> Harness.compile(\"1 IS NULL NULL\"));\n    }\n\n    private static void unterminatedLiterals() {\n        CompileException string = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"'abc\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"UNTERMINATED_STRING\", string.code());\n        TF.assertEquals(0, string.pos().offset);\n\n        CompileException comment = TF.assertThrows(CompileException.class,\n                () -> Harness.compile(\"1 /* nope\"));\n        TF.assertEquals(\"UNTERMINATED_COMMENT\", comment.code());\n op.start.offset,\n                    endOffsetOf(right));\n        }\n        return left;\n    }","originalFile":"package tvl.parser;\n\nimport java.util.List;\n\nimport tvl.core.CompileException;\nimport tvl.core.Pos;\n\n/**\n * 递归下降解析器，产生表达式 AST。\n *\n * 优先级从低到高：\n * <pre>\n * orExpr    := andExpr (OR andExpr)*\n * andExpr   := notExpr (AND notExpr)*\n * notExpr   := NOT notExpr | isNullExpr\n * isNullExpr := compareExpr (IS [NOT] NULL)?\n * compareExpr := additiveExpr (compareOp additiveExpr)?   // 比较不允许连写\n * additiveExpr := mulExpr ((+|-) mulExpr)*\n * mulExpr   := unaryExpr ((*|/) unaryExpr)*\n * unaryExpr := - unaryExpr | primary\n * primary   := 整数 | 字符串 | TRUE | FALSE | NULL | 列名 | '(' orExpr ')'\n * </pre>\n *\n * 比较运算符为非结合：{@code a = b = c} 会在第二个 = 处报错。\n */\npublic final class Parser {\n\n    private final List<Token> tokens;\n    private int cur = 0;\n\n    public Parser(List<Token> tokens) {\n        this.tokens = tokens;\n    }\n\n    public static Expr parse(String source) {\n        List<Token> toks = new Lexer(source).tokenize();\n        Parser p = new Parser(toks);\n        Expr e = p.parseOr();\n        Token t = p.peek();\n        if (t.type != TokenType.EOF) {\n            throw p.error(\"SYNTAX_ERROR\",\n                    \"表达式结束后仍有多余内容：'\" + t.text + \"'\", t);\n        }\n        return e;\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 各优先级层级 ----------\n\n    private Expr parseOr() {\n        Expr left = parseAnd();\n        while (match(TokenType.OR)) {\n            Token op = last();\n            Expr right = parseAnd();\n            left = new BinaryExpr(TokenType.OR, op.text, left, right,\n                    left.pos(), op.start, op.endOffset - op.start.offset,\n                    endOffsetOf(right));\n        }\n        return left;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseAnd() {\n        Expr left = parseNot();\n        while (match(TokenType.AND)) {\n            Token op = last();\n            Expr right = parseNot();\n            left = new BinaryExpr(TokenType.AND, op.text, left, right,\n                    left.pos(), op.start, op.endOffset - op.start.offset,\n                    endOffsetOf(right));\n        }\n        return left;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseNot() {\n        if (match(TokenType.NOT)) {\n            Token not = last();\n            Expr operand = parseNot();\n            return new NotExpr(operand, not.start, endOffsetOf(operand));\n        }\n        return parseIsNull();\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseIsNull() {\n        Expr operand = parseComparison();\n        if (match(TokenType.IS)) {\n            Token is = last();\n            boolean negated = match(TokenType.NOT);\n            Token nullTok = expect(TokenType.NULL_KW,\n                    \"IS [NOT] 之后必须为 NULL\");\n            int end = nullTok.endOffset;\n            return new IsNullExpr(operand, negated, operand.pos(), end);\n        }\n        return operand;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseComparison() {\n        Expr left = parseAdditive();\n        if (isCompareOp(peek().type)) {\n            Token op = advance();\n            if (isCompareOp(peek().type)) {\n                // 例如 a = b > c、a = b = c\n                throw error(\"NON_ASSOCIATIVE_COMPARISON\",\n                        \"比较运算符不能连续使用（第二个运算符 '\" + peek().text\n                                + \"'），请用括号明确结合方式\", peek());\n            }\n            Expr right = parseAdditive();\n            return new BinaryExpr(op.type, op.text, left, right,\n                    left.pos(), op.start, op.endOffset - op.start.offset,\n                    endOffsetOf(right));\n        }\n        return left;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseAdditive() {\n        Expr left = parseMul();\n        while (peek().type == TokenType.PLUS || peek().type == TokenType.MINUS) {\n            Token op = advance();\n            Expr right = parseMul();\n            left = new BinaryExpr(op.type, op.text, left, right,\n                    left.pos(), op.start, op.endOffset - op.start.offset,\n                    endOffsetOf(right));\n        }\n        return left;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseMul() {\n        Expr left = parseUnary();\n        while (peek().type == TokenType.STAR || peek().type == TokenType.SLASH) {\n            Token op = advance();\n            Expr right = parseUnary();\n            left = new BinaryExpr(op.type, op.text, left, right,\n                    left.pos(), op.start, op.endOffset - op.start.offset,\n                    endOffsetOf(right));\n        }\n        return left;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseUnary() {\n        if (match(TokenType.MINUS)) {\n            Token minus = last();\n            Expr operand = parseUnary();\n            return new UnaryMinusExpr(operand, minus.start, endOffsetOf(operand));\n        }\n        return parsePrimary();\n    }\n\n    private Expr parsePrimary() {\n        Token t = peek();\n        switch (t.type) {\n            case INTEGER: {\n                advance();\n                long v;\n                try {\n                    v = Long.parseLong(t.text);\n                } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {\n                    throw new CompileException(\"INTEGER_OUT_OF_RANGE\",\n                            \"整数字面量超出 64 位有符号整数范围（\"\n                                    + Long.MIN_VALUE + \" ~ \" + Long.MAX_VALUE + \"）\",\n                            t.start, t.endOffset - t.start.offset);\n                }\n                return new LiteralExpr(LiteralExpr.Kind.INTEGER, t.text, v,\n                        t.start, t.endOffset - t.start.offset);\n            }\n            case STRING:\n                advance();\n                return new LiteralExpr(LiteralExpr.Kind.STRING, t.text, t.text,\n                        t.start, t.endOffset - t.start.offset);\n            case TRUE:\n            case FALSE:\n                advance();\n                return new LiteralExpr(LiteralExpr.Kind.BOOLEAN, t.text,\n                        t.type == TokenType.TRUE,\n                        t.start, t.endOffset - t.start.offset);\n            case NULL_KW:\n                advance();\n                return new LiteralExpr(LiteralExpr.Kind.NULL, t.text, null,\n                        t.start, t.endOffset - t.start.offset);\n            case IDENT:\n                advance();\n                return new ColumnExpr(t.text, t.start,\n                        t.endOffset - t.start.offset);\n            case LPAREN: {\n                advance();\n                Expr inner = parseOr();\n                expect(TokenType.RPAREN, \"缺少右括号 ')'\");\n                // 括号本身不产生 AST 节点；但节点位置只覆盖内部表达式，\n                // 这不影响类型检查与求值。\n                return inner;\n            }\n            case EOF:\n                throw error(\"SYNTAX_ERROR\", \"表达式不完整：此处应有一个操作数\", t);\n            default:\n                throw error(\"SYNTAX_ERROR\",\n                        \"此处不应出现 '\" + t.text + \"'，应为操作数（数字、字符串、列名、括号表达式）\",\n                        t);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- Token 游标工具 ----------\n\n    private Token peek() {\n        return tokens.get(cur);\n    }\n\n    private Token last() {\n        return tokens.get(cur - 1);\n    }\n\n    private Token advance() {\n        Token t = tokens.get(cur);\n        if (cur < tokens.size() - 1) {\n            cur++;\n        }\n        return t;\n    }\n\n    private boolean match(TokenType type) {\n        if (peek().type == type) {\n            advance();\n            return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    private Token expect(TokenType type, String message) {\n        if (peek().type != type) {\n            throw error(\"SYNTAX_ERROR\", message + \"，实际遇到 '\" + peek().text + \"'\", peek());\n        }\n        return advance();\n    }\n\n    private boolean isCompareOp(TokenType t) {\n        return t == TokenType.EQ || t == TokenType.NE\n                || t == TokenType.LT || t == TokenType.LE\n                || t == TokenType.GT || t == TokenType.GE;\n    }\n\n    private int endOffsetOf(Expr e) {\n        return e.pos().offset + e.length();\n    }\n\n    private CompileException error(String code, String msg, Token t) {\n        int len = Math.max(1, t.endOffset - t.start.offset);\n        Pos pos = t.type == TokenType.EOF ? t.start : t.start;\n        return new CompileException(code, msg, pos, len);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":96,"oldLines":13,"newStart":96,"newLines":14,"lines":["         Expr left = parseAdditive();","         if (isCompareOp(peek().type)) {","             Token op = advance();","+            Expr right = parseAdditive();","+            // 比较运算符非结合：右操作数解析完后若又出现比较符，报错","+            // （例如 a = b = c、a < b > c；请用括号明确含义）","             if (isCompareOp(peek().type)) {","-                // 例如 a = b > c、a = b = c","                 throw error(\"NON_ASSOCIATIVE_COMPARISON\",","                         \"比较运算符不能连续使用（第二个运算符 '\" + peek().text","                                 + \"'），请用括号明确结合方式\", peek());","             }","-            Expr right = parseAdditive();","             return new BinaryExpr(op.type, op.text, left, right,","                     left.pos(), op.start, op.endOffset -   c.run();\n        } catch (Throwable t) {\n            if (type.isInstance(t)) {\n                return (T) t;\n            }\n            throw new AssertionError(\"期望抛出 \" + }\n\n    public static int passed() {\n        return passed;\n    }\n\n    public static int failed() {\n        return failed;\n    }\n\n    public static List<String> failures() {\n        return }","originalFile":"package tvl.cli;\n\nimport java.io.IOException;\nimport java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;\nimport java.nio.file.Files;\nimport java.nio.file.Paths;\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\nimport tvl.core.TriBool;\nimport tvl.engine.RequestHandler;\nimport tvl.eval.Evaluator;\nimport tvl.core.Value;\nimport tvl.json.Json;\nimport tvl.parser.Expr;\nimport tvl.parser.Parser;\nimport tvl.parser.TypeChecker;\n\n/**\n * 命令行入口（无网络服务，仅处理 JSON 请求文本）：\n *\n *  java tvl.cli.Main query [request.json]          不提供文件则从标准输入读取\n *  java tvl.cli.Main parse \"expr\"                  解析并输出 AST\n *  java tvl.cli.Main truth-table                  输出 NOT/AND/OR 穷举真值表\n *\n * 退出码：0 成功；2 请求/表达式错误；1 用法或 IO 错误。\n */\npublic final class Main {\n\n    public static void main(String[] args) {\n        if (args.length == 0) {\n            usage();\n            System.exit(1);\n        }\n        try {\n            switch (args[0]) {\n                case \"query\":\n                    doQuery(args.length > 1 ? args[1] : null);\n                    break;\n                case \"parse\":\n                    doParse(args);\n                    break;\n                case \"truth-table\":\n                    doTruthTable();\n                    break;\n                case \"--help\":\n                case \"-h\":\n                case \"help\":\n                    usage();\n                    break;\n                default:\n                    System.err.println(\"未知子命令：\" + args[0]);\n                    usage();\n                    System.exit(1);\n            }\n        } catch (IOException ex) {\n            System.err.println(\"IO 错误：\" + ex.getMessage());\n            System.exit(1);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void doQuery(String file) throws IOException {\n        String request = file == null\n                ? readAll(System.in)\n                : new String(Files.readAllBytes(Paths.get(file)), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n\n        RequestHandler handler = new RequestHandler();\n        RequestHandler.Response resp = handler.handle(request);\n        System.out.print(resp.toJson());\n        System.out.flush();\n        System.exit(resp.ok ? 0 : 2);\n    }\n\n    private static void doParse(String[] args) {\n        if (args.length < 2) {\n            System.err.println(\"用法：parse \\\"<表达式>\\\"\");\n            System.exit(1);\n        }\n        String source = args[1];\n        Expr ast = Parser.parse(source);\n        TypeChecker.checkStandalone(ast);\n        System.out.println(Json.pretty(ast.toJson()));\n    }\n\n    /** 穷举三值真值表：NOT(3) + AND(9) + OR(9) = 21 行。 */\n    private static void doTruthTable() {\n        TriBool[] vals = {TriBool.TRUE, TriBool.UNKNOWN, TriBool.FALSE};\n        Evaluator ev = new Evaluator(new String[0]);\n\n        List<Map<String, Object>> notRows = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (TriBool a : vals) {\n            Map<String, Object> r = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            r.put(\"a\", a.name());\n            r.put(\"NOT_a\", a.not().name());\n            notRows.add(r);\n        }\n\n        List<Map<String, Object>> andRows = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<Map<String, Object>> orRows = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (TriBool a : vals) {\n            for (TriBool b : vals) {\n                Map<String, Object> ra = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                ra.put(\"a\", a.name());\n                ra.put(\"b\", b.name());\n                ra.put(\"a_AND_b\", a.and(b).name());\n                andRows.add(ra);\n\n                Map<String, Object> ro = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                ro.put(\"a\", a.name());\n                ro.put(\"b\", b.name());\n                ro.put(\"a_OR_b\", a.or(b).name());\n                orRows.add(ro);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 同时用真实表达式引擎验证一遍，确保表不是手写的\n        verifyTruthTablesByEngine(ev);\n\n        Map<String, Object> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        out.put(\"logic\", \"Kleene SQL 3VL (TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN)\");\n        out.put(\"NOT\", notRows);\n        out.put(\"AND\", andRows);\n        out.put(\"OR\", orRows);\n        System.out.println(Json.pretty(out));\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 用表达式 a AND b / a OR B / NOT a 对 9+9+3 种取值实际求值，\n     * 与枚举表核对（a、b 是用布尔字面量经 NULL 构造的逻辑值）。\n     */\n    private static void verifyTruthTablesByEngine(Evaluator ev) {\n        // 该方法为内部一致性断言；真正的穷举测试在测试套件中进行。\n        Value t = Value.ofBoolean(true);\n        Value f = Value.ofBoolean(false);\n        Value u = Value.NULL;\n        Value[] vals = {t, u, f};\n        TriBool[] tris = {TriBool.TRUE, TriBool.UNKNOWN, TriBool.FALSE};\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n            if (tris[i].not() != notByEval(ev, vals[i])) {\n                throw new AssertionError(\"NOT 真值表引擎不一致\");\n            }\n            for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {\n                if (tris[i].and(tris[j]) != andByEval(ev, vals[i], vals[j])) {\n                    throw new AssertionError(\"AND 真值表引擎不一致\");\n                }\n                if (tris[i].or(tris[j]) != orByEval(ev, vals[i], vals[j])) {\n                    throw new AssertionError(\"OR 真值表引擎不一致\");\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static TriBool notByEval(Evaluator ev, Value a) {\n        // 构造 NOT TRUE / NOT FALSE / NOT NULL 常量表达式实际求值\n        String operand = a.isNull() ? \"NULL\"\n                : (a.bool() ? \"TRUE\" : \"FALSE\");\n        Expr e = Parser.parse(\"NOT \" + operand);\n        TypeChecker.checkStandalone(e);\n        return ev.evalLogic(e, new Value[0]);\n    }\n\n    private static TriBool andByEval(Evaluator ev, Value a, Value b) {\n        String la = a.isNull() ? \"NULL\" : (a.bool() ? \"TRUE\" : \"FALSE\");\n        String lb = b.isNull() ? \"NULL\" : (b.bool() ? \"TRUE\" : \"FALSE\");\n        Expr e = Parser.parse(la + \" AND \" + lb);\n        TypeChecker.checkStandalone(e);\n        return ev.evalLogic(e, new Value[0]);\n    }\n\n    private static TriBool orByEval(Evaluator ev, Value a, Value b) {\n        String la = a.isNull() ? \"NULL\" : (a.bool() ? \"TRUE\" : \"FALSE\");\n        String lb = b.isNull() ? \"NULL\" : (b.bool() ? \"TRUE\" : \"FALSE\");\n        Expr e = Parser.parse(la + \" OR \" + lb);\n        TypeChecker.checkStandalone(e);\n        return ev.evalLogic(e, new Value[0]);\n    }\n\n    private static String readAll(java.io.InputStream in) throws IOException {\n        byte[] data = in.readAllBytes();\n        return new String(data, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n    }\n\n    private static void usage() {\n        System.err.println(\"用法：\");\n        System.err.println(\"  query [request.json]   执行 JSON 查询请求（缺省文件则读标准输入）\");\n        System.err.println(\"  parse \\\"<expr>\\\"          解析表达式并输出 AST JSON\");\n        System.err.println(\"  truth-table            输出 NOT/AND/OR 穷举三值真值表\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":79,"oldLines":8,"newStart":79,"newLines":9,"lines":[" {"parentUuid":"4a1d2ba4-36c5-45b2-9820-977416711eed","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_m7seyqgodzklfgmpm2tw0nl2","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp11/a/README.md","content":"# 三值逻辑表达式查询引擎（3VL Query Engine）\n\n一个**纯后端、单机内存**的查询引擎与表达式求值器。用 Java 17 实现，\n**零外部依赖**（不使用任何现成 SQL 引擎 / 解析器生成器 / JSON 库 / 测试框架），\n核心运算（词法、语法、类型检查、三值逻辑求值、溢出检测、JSON 处理）全部手写。\n不包含任何前端代码。\n\n表达式通过 **JSON 请求**提交，引擎返回选中行、每行的**三值判定**、\n**AST** 与可导出的**执行计划**；表数据与计划均可导出为 JSON。\n\n---\n\n## 1. 它实现了什么\n\n- 带**类型检查**的表达式解析器：\n  - 比较：`=  <>  !=  <  <=  >  >=`\n  - 逻辑：`AND  OR  NOT`\n  - 判空：`x IS NULL`、`x IS NOT NULL`\n  - 整数算术：`+  -  *  /`（一元负号、整除向零截断）\n  - 字面量：整数、单引号字符串、`TRUE / FALSE / NULL`\n  - 括号、SQL 风格注释（`-- 行注释`、`/* 块注释 */`），关键字大小写不敏感\n- **SQL 三值逻辑（3VL）**：`TRUE / FALSE / UNKNOWN`，采用 Kleene 真值表；\n  `NULL` 参与任何比较结果为 `UNKNOWN`，算术为 `NULL` 传播。\n- **短路求值**：`TRUE OR x`、`FALSE AND x` 不求值 `x`；\n  被跳过分支中的除零 / 溢出不会触发。\n- **整数溢出 / 除零**返回**明确错误码**（`INTEGER_OVERFLOW` /\n  `DIVISION_BY_ZERO`），绝不静默回绕。\n- WHERE 过滤语义：**仅结果为 TRUE 的行被选中**，FALSE 与 UNKNOWN 都排除。\n- 错误带**源码位置**（offset / line / column / 出错 token 长度）。\n\n---\n\n## 2. 环境与构建\n\n要求 JDK 17+（仅用 `javac` / `java`，无需 Maven/Gradle，无需联网）。\n\n```bash\nbash build.sh        # 编译主代码与测试代码到 build/\nbash run-tests.sh    # 运行全部自动化测试（失败时退出码非 0）\n```\n\n---\n\n## 3. 快速开始\n\n### 3.1 执行一个 JSON 查询（从文件）\n\n```bash\njava -cp build/classes tvl.cli.Main query samples/query-basic.json\n```\n\n### 3.2 从标准输入读取\n\n```bash\necho '{\"expression\":\"a = 1 OR a IS NULL\",\n       \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[{\"name\":\"a\",\"type\":\"INTEGER\"}],\n                \"rows\":[[1],[2],[null]]}}' \\\n  | java -cp build/classes tvl.cli.Main query\n```\n\n### 3.3 穷举三值真值表\n\n```bash\njava -cp build/classes tvl.cli.Main truth-table\n```\n\n### 3.4 只看表达式 AST（语法解析）\n\n```bash\njava -cp build/classes tvl.cli.Main parse \"x > 1 AND NOT y IS NULL\"\n```\n\n退出码：`0` 成功；`2` 请求或表达式错误（错误体为 JSON）；`1` 用法 / IO 错误。\n\n---\n\n## 4. 表达式语法与优先级\n\n优先级从**低到高**：\n\n```\nOR\nAND\nNOT                      （一元前缀）\nIS [NOT] NULL\n比较  = <> != < <= > >=   （非结合，不允许 a = b = c）\n+  -\n*  /\n一元 -\n原子  整数 | '字符串' | TRUE | FALSE | NULL | 列名 | ( 表达式 )\n```\n\n> 说明：比较紧于 `NOT`（`NOT 1 = 2` 等价 `NOT (1 = 2)`，标准 SQL 行为）；\n> `AND` 紧于 `OR`（`TRUE OR FALSE AND FALSE == TRUE`）。\n\n---\n\n## 5. 三值逻辑语义\n\nNULL 表示“未知”。布尔表达式的 NULL 被解释为 `UNKNOWN`。\n\n| a | NOT a |\n|---|---|\n| TRUE | FALSE |\n| UNKNOWN | UNKNOWN |\n| FALSE | TRUE |\n\n| AND | T | U | F |     | OR | T | U | F |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n| **T** | T | U | F |     | **T** | T | T | T |\n| **U** | U | U | F |     | **U** | T | U | U |\n| **F** | F | F | F |     | **F** | T | U | F |\n\n关键规则：\n\n- `NULL = NULL` → **UNKNOWN**（不是 TRUE；判空必须用 `IS NULL`）\n- `NULL <> NULL` → **UNKNOWN**\n- 任何比较只要一侧为 NULL → **UNKNOWN**\n- `NULL` 参与算术 → `NULL`（如 `NULL + 1 = NULL`）\n- `U AND F = F`、`U OR T = T`（UNKNOWN 不总是传播到底）\n- WHERE 只保留 TRUE：UNKNOWN 与 FALSE 一样被过滤掉\n\n短路（关键验收点）：\n\n- `TRUE OR  (1/0 = 1)` → TRUE，**不除零**\n- `FALSE AND (1/0 = 1)` → FALSE，**不除零**\n- `(1 = NULL) OR (1/0 = 1)` → UNKNOWN 不能定结果，**右侧仍要求值 → 抛除零错误**\n\n---\n\n## 6. JSON 请求 / 响应\n\n### 6.1 请求\n\n```json\n{\n  \"expression\": \"x > 1 AND y IS NOT NULL\",\n  \"includeTable\": false,\n  \"table\": {\n    \"name\": \"nums\",\n    \"columns\": [\n      { \"name\": \"x\", \"type\": \"INTEGER\" },\n      { \"name\": \"y\", \"type\": \"INTEGER\" }\n    ],\n    \"rows\": [\n      [2, 10],\n      [5, null]\n    ]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n- `expression`（必填，字符串）：过滤表达式。\n- `table`（可选）：\n  - `columns[].type` 仅支持 `INTEGER` / `BOOLEAN` / `STRING`；\n  - `rows` 为二维数组，单元值用 JSON `null` 表示 SQL NULL；\n  - INTEGER 列只接受 JSON 整数（小数会被拒绝）。\n- `includeTable`（可选，布尔）：为 true 时响应回带完整表数据。\n- 不提供 `table` 时为**纯表达式模式**：编译通过后对空行求值一次，\n  返回表达式自身标量值（布尔表达式另附 `triValue`）。\n\n### 6.2 成功响应\n\n```json\n{\n  \"ok\": true,\n  \"expression\": \"x > 1 AND y IS NOT NULL\",\n  \"ast\": { \"...\": \"带节点类型/位置/resolvedType 的语法树\" },\n  \"plan\": {\n    \"operator\": \"Filter\",\n    \"predicate\": { \"...\": \"AST\" },\n    \"input\": { \"operator\": \"TableScan\", \"table\": \"nums\",\n               \"columns\": [\"x\", \"y\"], \"estimatedRows\": 5 }\n  },\n  \"result\": {\n    \"selectedCount\": 2,\n    \"selectedRows\": [[2, 10]],\n    \"evaluatedRows\": [\n      { \"rowIndex\": 0, \"triValue\": \"TRUE\", \"selected\": true, \"row\": [2, 10] }\n    ],\n    \"triStats\": { \"TRUE\": 2, \"FALSE\": 2, \"UNKNOWN\": 1 }\n  },\n  \"table\": { \"...\": \"includeTable=true 时出现，含全部列与行\" }\n}\n```\n\n### 6.3 错误响应（HTTP 无关，用退出码 2 表达）\n\n```json\n{\n  \"ok\": false,\n  \"error\": {\n    \"code\": \"TYPE_MISMATCH\",\n    \"message\": \"算术运算 '+' 要求 INTEGER 操作数，右侧为 STRING\",\n    \"position\": { \"offset\": 2, \"line\": 1, \"column\": 3 },\n    \"length\": 1\n  }\n}\n```\n\n错误码：\n\n| code | 阶段 | 含义 |\n|---|---|---|\n| `INVALID_JSON` | 请求解析 | 请求文本不是合法 JSON |\n| `BAD_REQUEST` | 请求装载 | 结构/列类型/行列数/单元值不合法 |\n| `SYNTAX_ERROR` | 语法 | 缺操作数、括号不匹配、多余内容等 |\n| `UNEXPECTED_CHAR` | 词法 | 非法字符 |\n| `UNTERMINATED_STRING` / `UNTERMINATED_COMMENT` | 词法 | 字符串 / 块注释未闭合 |\n| `NON_ASSOCIATIVE_COMPARISON` | 语法 | 比较运算符连写（如 `a = b = c`） |\n| `UNKNOWN_COLUMN` | 语义 | 列名不存在（位置指向该标识符） |\n| `TYPE_MISMATCH` | 语义 | 操作数类型不匹配（位置指向操作符/操作数） |\n| `INTEGER_OUT_OF_RANGE` | 语法 | 整数字面量超出 64 位范围 |\n| `INTEGER_OVERFLOW` | 求值 | 算术/一元负号/除法溢出 |\n| `DIVISION_BY_ZERO` | 求值 | 整数除以零 |\n\n---\n\n## 7. 数据与执行计划导出\n\n- AST：每个节点含 `node`、`pos`、`length`，类型检查后含 `resolvedType`。\n- 执行计划：物理算子树 `Filter -> TableScan`，`predicate` 内嵌完整 AST。\n- 表数据：`includeTable: true` 时响应中的 `table` 含列定义、`rowCount`、全部行。\n- `docs/output/` 下保存了对 `samples/` 每个样例的**真实运行响应**。\n\n---\n\n## 8. 自动化测试\n\n```bash\nbash run-tests.sh\n```\n\n零依赖手写迷你断言框架（`src/test/java/tvl/TF.java`）。测试分组：\n\n| 套件 | 覆盖 |\n|---|---|\n| `TruthTableTest` | **穷举** NOT(3) + AND(3×3) + OR(3×3)，用独立数值编码 oracle（min/max/取负）验证，操作数走真实布尔列 |\n| `NullComparisonTest` | NULL 参与 6 种比较的 3×3 穷举（INTEGER 与 STRING）、`NULL = NULL`、NULL 算术/逻辑传播、IS NULL、WHERE 三值过滤 |\n| `PrecedenceTest` | 全部优先级层级、左结合、括号、一元负号、整除取整、关键字大小写、注释 |\n| `ShortCircuitTest` | OR/AND 短路、被跳过分支除零/溢出不触发、UNKNOWN 不短路、嵌套短路、列驱动短路、对照组 |\n| `OverflowTest` | 加减乘/一元负号/除法溢出、除零、边界值、字面量越界、列值触发、NULL/0 传播 |\n| `ErrorPositionTest` | 错误码与 offset/line/column/length，含跨行定位、非结合比较、未闭合字面量 |\n| `TypeCheckTest` | 合法形式、结果类型回填、NULL 未定型兼容性、非法形式 |\n| `JsonParserTest` | JSON 解析/序列化往返、数字、转义、畸形输入 |\n| `JsonRequestTest` | 端到端：选择结果、三值统计、短路跨多行、错误定位、数据/计划导出、纯表达式模式 |\n\n最近一次完整运行：**471 个断言全部通过，0 失败**（见 `docs/RUNLOG.md`）。\n\n---\n\n## 9. 目录结构\n\n```\n.\n├── build.sh / run-tests.sh      # 构建 / 测试脚本（仅依赖 JDK）\n├── src/main/java/tvl/\n│   ├── core/      # DataType / Value / TriBool / Pos / 异常\n│   ├── parser/    # Lexer / Token / Parser(递归下降) / AST / TypeChecker\n│   ├── eval/      # Evaluator（三值逻辑 + 短路 + 溢出检测）\n│   ├── engine/    # Table / QueryEngine / RequestHandler(JSON 入口)\n│   ├── json/      # 手写 JSON 解析器与序列化器\n│   └── cli/       # Main（query / parse / truth-table）\n├── src/test/java/tvl/           # 迷你测试框架 + 9 个测试套件 + TestRunner\n├── samples/                     # JSON 请求样例（含成功与错误样例）\n└── docs/\n    ├── output/                  # 样例的真实运行响应\n    └── RUNLOG.md                # 实际运行命令与结果记录\n```\n\n---\n\n## 10. 设计取舍与已知限制\n\n- 整数统一为 64 位有符号 `long`；整除向零截断（与 Java `/`、SQL 常规一致）。\n- 源码中直接书写 `-9223372036854775808` 会在词法期以 `INTEGER_OUT_OF_RANGE`\n  明确拒绝（数字部分超出正数范围，一元负号是独立节点）。该最小值可经列值或\n  等价表达式 `(-9223372036854775807 - 1)` 参与运算，溢出仍被正确检测。\n- 比较运算符刻意设计为**非结合**：`a = b = c` 报错，需用括号明确。\n- 布尔类型只支持 `= / <>`，不支持排序比较（与多数 SQL 一致）。\n- 字符串为字典序（Java UTF-16 序），不做 locale/排序规则。\n- 纯内存单机引擎，无持久化、无网络服务；JSON 入口为“请求文本 → 响应文本”，\n  方便接入任意传输层（HTTP/WebSocket/文件）而不耦合。\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_98ba55baa208568939ee25bf","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":946,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":120632,"output_tokens":3464,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_m7seyqgodzklfgmpm2tw0nl2":{"content":"#
